This page is blighted with mold and the imprint of a memory…

The words seep experience into your open mind…

THROUGH THE EYES OF AN EMPTY VESSEL…

Dormant. Bound.

[Knock]

Threat.

Storm outside.

Rain soft thirst.

Flashes show shapes.

Shapes I know.

[The Knock is stronger]

Gentle whispers reach from me.

To all.

As Father, as Fikrul.

Barons. Kells.

Gone.

Another voice…

[The Knock is insistent]

Pressing.

FearandConfusion.

No.

The mind beneath this one screams to the surface.

Nothing, Scorn, a Son… Fallen… Eliksni…King…

Akriis does not bow.

Arise, commands the voice buried in whispers.

Akriis does not bow, but Akriis is dead.

Peeled away.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

The spine of the Glykon breaks, its vertebrae now interchanging.

Scorn howl to herald the crossing into Nothing.

Through the Locus, they hear the whispers and obey:

"Meet Salvation."


FRENETIC SCRAWL INKED IN THE MARGIN READS: There's a scanner array off the hull near the hangar. I patched a line through to it to check Qinziq's feed. Needed somewhere to listen.
entries.text_zh:
这页已经被霉菌侵蚀，上面刻着某些记忆的印迹…

文字缓缓将原主人的经验传输给你…

透过一具容器的双眼...

休眠。绑定。

[敲]

威胁。

外面暴风骤雨。

大雨即将来临。

天空电闪雷鸣。

一切是那么熟悉。

[敲击声愈发响亮了]

我的脑中响起低语。

至所有人。

作为父亲，作为费克鲁。

公爵，凯尔。

消失了。

另一个声音响起...

[敲击声依然没有停下]

压得我喘不过气。

恐惧，迷惑。

不。

在表面之下，思想在尖叫。

虚无，嗤魅，儿子....堕落者...埃里克斯尼...国王...

阿克力斯永不屈服。

起来，这些耳语声像是不容置疑的命令。

阿克力斯永不屈服，但是阿克力斯已经死了。

被剥开。

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

格力康的龙骨断了，正在进行替换。

嗤魅的嚎叫，只化作了一片虚无。

通过轨迹，他们听到了低语，并服从于这些低语：

“去迎接救赎。”


页边有一行潦草的手书：机库附近的船体外有一个扫描阵列，我接了一条线过去，用它来探测奎恩兹克的信号。需要个收听的地方。

entries.name: ENTRY 10 - Blood in the Barrel
entries.text:
This page is blighted with mold and the imprint of a memory…

The words seep experience into your open mind…

THROUGH THE EYES OF KATABASIS…

Weeks bleed away.

"Where is your Ghost?" Bahto grunts as he throws a crushed Scorn into a tangle of festering dark tendrils. These fungal growths had grown across the Glykon during the timeless expanse since their plunge, and only continued to spread.

"I don't know," I sputter as I pull a ragged blade from my gut. "Off fraternizing somewhere."

"I'm here. What do you need?" Gilly says, appearing.

"Fewer holes," I groan.

Bahto looks to the three Scorn that had ambushed us, now returned to the grave. "The rest will feel their deaths. How much farther?"

"Assuming the ship hasn't shifted again, not far once this one gets up." Gilly gestures to me. "Is Qinziq certain severing the crown will send us back?"

"It'll work. We better not have dug up this command key for nothing," I reply, holding up a Imperial security key.

"You said it was to stop the Scorn!" Bahto roars.

"Stopping them doesn't matter if we don't get out."

"I pledged my life to Calus, and you want me to forsake him!" He towers over me.

"I know a thing or two about abandonment. He used you to get what he wanted, just like he used me. He's gone, Bahto, and we're close to follow. Where does that leave your bloodline?"

I stand as a wave wracks the Glykon. It isn't something you see, more like a lightbulb bursting. A long blink before the pins and shivers wash over. Numb. I can hear it moving through the ship like cold metal tension.

The three Scorn snap and contort in grotesque reanimation.

"You're welcome to stay, skull-cracker."

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

We make it to the ship's bridge, howls tracking us down every hall. I seal the door with the command key and meet Qinziq beneath the command console at the entrance to the viewing chamber. She stands, encircled by 15 loyalist soldiers.

"This is everyone?" I ask.

Qinziq nods. I insert the command key into the viewing chamber door. After a moment, pistons disengage, and the door opens. Qinziq focuses for a moment. "Empty…" her voice rings from her.

We enter the viewing chamber. The soldiers take up positions around the room. Bahto strides past the Darkness-infested crown and drops to his knees at the open viewing window.

He stares into the endless. "How do we choose who deserves our loyalty?"

I walk to his side. "Everyone's got their own way. No one's right. You don't owe anyone anything, Bahto."

Qinziq signals that she is ready. As I approach the crown, I watch her eye trace the scorched handprints of each Councilor that last communed here.

Shrieks echo down the steps leading to the bridge. Metallic scraping heralds the flame.

"I will do this so that others may live," Qinziq's voice flows. "I did not intend suffering but should have expected Calus's deceit. Ambition to steal away his secrets damned us all."

"Get us out and we're square."

She plants her next words into my mind: 'I will, because you do not belong here.' She places her palms on the crown.

Velocity surges backward into infinity, tearing away the surrounding reality. We stand in nothing, 17 defenders back to back around Qinziq and the crown. The shrieks grow louder, and through the whines of bending steel, the trembling flesh of Scorn pour into the nothing with us.

Slug Rifles unleash a salvo in all directions from behind a handful of Phalanx shields, tearing line after line of Scorn down with explosive force. Incendiors step forward to cremate the remains between volleys. I add my gun to line, dropping Raiders before they can align shots on our ring and slinging Voidwall grenades to stem the flood. Qinziq screams, straining to sever the link as the Glykon thrashes against Dark waves. Black fire scalds her hands as Nothing twists around us. We fight until the floor is lined with dead Scorn and empty magazines.

The shrieking recedes. Scraping metal echoes through the viewing chambers as a wave of Darkness tremors through the Glykon. Every unburnt Scorn seizes and begins to reconstitute. Soldiers panic and fire into heaps of writhing bodies, hoping to stop the process.

In the chaos, lightning rips through the air, cutting through three Legionaries and rupturing an Incendior tank. The blast kills seven; the circle tightens. We return fire in the direction of the lightning and are met with two fetid Abominations. They burst into the chamber and rear back with crackling fists. I charge one, slipping into the Void to draw blades from it its sheath. Bahto snatches a Phalanx shield resting at his feet and challenges the other. Its bolts break on the shield. Our remaining guns harry them with slug-fire until we close the gap. I cut through hands and head, then pivot to see Bahto driving his shield into the other's face.

Qinziq cries out. I spin on my heel to see her engulfed in black flame and the cosmos racing around us. She spreads her pain to us to hold on a few moments longer, to no avail.

I look back to Bahto. Deeper past him, in the nothing, to the hulking silhouette dragging a flaming censer and I know: this is where we die.


FRENETIC SCRAWL INKED IN THE MARGIN READS: Cut out a hideaway under the knife. Stowed some lab tech nearby.
entries.text_zh:
这页已经被霉菌侵蚀，上面刻着某些记忆的印迹…

文字缓缓将原主人的经验传输给你…

透过冥旅之眼...

一眨眼，几周就过去了。

“你的机灵呢？”巴托一边嘟囔，一边将一个粉碎的嗤魅丢进一团黑色触须中去。这些菌类在整个舰船内部疯狂生长，而且在不断蔓延。

“我不知道”，我啐了一口，把一块锯齿状的刀片从肚子上拔了出来：“大概是跟我绝交了吧。”

“我在这里，你需要帮助吗？”吉力不知道从哪里冒了出来。

“帮我把身上的洞补一补，”我呻吟道。

巴托望着埋伏我们的三只嗤魅，确认它们已经死透了。“其他嗤魅也应该知道这三只死了。还有多远？”

“如果这艘船没有变化，就应该不远了。”吉力朝我示意：“奎恩兹克确认只要破坏王冠就能把我们送回去？”

“会的。我们费这么大力气才挖出这把命令密钥，最好能派上用场，”我回答道，手里捏着一把皇家的安保密钥。

巴托吼到：“你之前说这玩意是用来阻止嗤魅的！”

“如果我们出不去，光阻止它们一点意义都没有。”

“我已经将我的生命献给卡鲁斯，而你现在要我背叛他！”他站了起来，怒视着我。

“我知道什么叫做抛弃。他利用你达到自己的目的，我不也被他利用了吗？然后呢？他死了，巴托，我们也快死了。想想你的家族血脉会如何呢？”

一阵冲击波撞在格力康的船体上。你根本看不见是什么力量，就像是灯泡突然爆裂开来一样。努力了很久才睁开眼睛，浑身像是被针扎了一样疼，脑子里昏昏沉沉的。身体有些麻木，我能听见那种力量在船体内移动，周围的金属都发出扭曲的声音。

三个嗤魅噼里啪啦地变换形态，再次重生。

“你愿意留下来就随便你吧。”

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

我们到达舰桥，身后是不断接近的嚎叫声。我用指挥密匙锁住了门，在观景室入口处的指挥台见到了奎恩兹克。她站在那里，身边有15名忠诚的士兵。

“就剩这么多人了？”我问。

奎恩兹克点了点头。我将密钥插入观察室的门，过了一会儿，门上的活塞开始收缩、脱离，门打开了。奎恩兹克低头集中精神，一阵沉默之后，她说：“没人...”我们进入观景室，士兵们在房间各处就位。巴托走到被黑暗侵袭的王冠面前，单膝跪地望着窗外。

他凝视着无尽的黑暗，说到：“我们该如何选择效忠的对象呢？”

我走到他身边，说：“每个人都有自己的路要走。没人能告诉你答案，巴托，你也不必理会别人的意见。”

奎恩兹克示意她已经准备好。当我靠近王冠的时候，我发现她在观察王冠上留下的议员手印。

在通往桥的台阶上，突然传来一阵尖叫。 金属的摩擦声预示着战斗即将到来。

“我这样做是为了其他人能活下来，”奎恩兹克接着说：“我本不想遭受这种苦难，我早该预料到卡鲁斯欺骗了我。但我一心想要窃取他的秘密，是野心让我受到了诅咒。”

“让我们出去，这样我们就扯平了。”

接下来她把话直接传进了我的脑子：“我会的，因为你不属于这里。”随即她把手掌贴在了王冠之上。

周围的现实再次被撕裂，我们立于虚空之上，17位卫士背靠背环绕在奎恩兹克和王冠的周围。尖啸声越来越大，穿透了那些弯曲的钢铁，嗤魅那些扭曲的血肉跟我们一同涌入了虚无之中。

重击步枪架在盾牌上，以爆炸性的威力撕碎了一排又一排嗤魅。手持喷火器的士兵上前，将残存的敌人烧成灰烬。我也举枪加入，在敌人冲散我们阵型之前，将那些突击者干掉，抽空扔出虚空墙手雷，阻止敌人的冲锋。奎恩兹克痛苦得怒吼着，想要切断连接，而此时格力康则遭受着黑暗冲击波的摧残。黑色的火焰灼伤了她的手，我们的周围充满了虚无能量。整个地上躺满了嗤魅的尸体和打光的弹匣。

尖啸声退去，金属的刮擦声还在观察室内回荡，格力康刚刚遭受了一波黑暗的冲击。没被烧焦的嗤魅又开始彼此纠缠、重组。士兵们惊慌失措，向那些蠕动的尸体开火，希望能拖慢这一进程。

在混乱中，一道闪电划过，将三个军团士兵烧了焦炭，又引爆了一个装着液化燃气的罐子。这次爆炸杀死了七个人，阵型不得不向内收缩。我们朝闪电传来的方向开火还击，却遭遇了两只恶臭的憎恶。它们冲进房间，双手闪着火花。我冲向其中一只，从虚空中抽出一把刀。巴托抢过一面盾牌，然后向另一只发起了挑战。闪电撞击在盾牌上，立刻便消散了。剩余的士兵们疯狂地开火掩护我们，直到我们靠近敌人。我一刀将眼前的这只砍成了两半，回头刚好看到巴托将盾牌砸进了另一只的脑壳。

奎恩兹克大喊一声。我一转头，发现她周遭满是黑色的火焰，周围的空间飞速旋转了起来。她把自己的痛苦分离出一部分，转移到我们身上，想要再撑久一些，但是依然无济于事。

我望向巴托。在他身后的虚空之中，我看到一个巨大的黑影拖着一个燃烧火炉，我知道：我们的死期到了。


页边有一行潦草的手书：用刀在下面切一个洞，把实验室的科技藏在附近。

entries.name: ENTRY 11 - Sullen
entries.text:
This page is blighted with mold and the imprint of a memory…

The words seep experience into your open mind…

THROUGH THE EYES OF KATABASIS…

It didn't work. Truth be told, I have no way of knowing if Qinziq even finished what she was doing. Gilly said it took days to find a safe place to bring me back. The big one they all follow was hunting for him.

I make a task of committing the Cabal bodies to burial. The costs are heavy, and I don't get everyone.

We try to keep hidden, using the smuggler's hovels where I stashed go bags across the ship.

All it takes is one of them seeing you.

Been keeping track for what I think is a month… three months. The waves are random. When one hits, it rearranges pieces of the ship, and I have to find my way again.

Gilgamesh is becoming more distant. Talking less. He wanders off for days at a time. So far, he always comes back.

When I die, I dream of a City burning. Death dreams are a first. When I wake up, I don't know how long it's been. Gilly… won't say.

There have been a hundred lives between this and the last one I remember.

I live in a charnel house.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

I'm alive. And old.

"Get up." Gilly's voice is thin.

"Why? There's nothing to do but starve."

"Giving up again? You'd rather I just left you here?"

I roll myself to face him. "I'm not giving up. Just… take my Light and hold it until… until there's a way out."

"You know, I used to think we were the way out—us, together. But we're just stuck in another cycle."

"There's nothing to eat, Gil. You don't feel that emptiness chewing at you. Promise you'll leave me be until we're out."

Gilgamesh looks at me for a long time without speaking. I close my eyes.

"I promise."


FRENETIC SCRAWL INKED IN THE MARGIN READS: Maze of vents. It's somewhere in there. That fungus crap keeps blocking my path.
entries.text_zh:
这页已经被霉菌侵蚀，上面刻着某些记忆的印迹…

文字缓缓将原主人的经验传输给你…

透过冥旅之眼...

这一点用也没有。说实话，我都不知道奎恩兹克有没有完成她的“仪式”。吉力说他花了几天才找到一个安全的位置把我复活。有个大家伙，似乎是它们的老大，一直在追他。

我想要把所有卡巴尔人的尸体埋葬起来。代价有些大，而且没能找到所有人。

我们尽量保持隐蔽，利用走私通道在船内藏些东西。只要你能找到其中一个就够了。

他们追踪我差不多有一个月...三个月了吧。冲击波来得毫无规律，一旦被击中，整个船体就会重组，我就又得重新找路。

吉尔伽美什跟我也越来越疏远了。不怎么说话。有时候一连好几天都在外面游荡。到目前为止，他还总是会回来。

当我死的时候，我总是会梦到一座燃烧的城市。做完这个梦，当我醒来的时候，我都不知道已经过了多久。吉力...也不愿告诉我。

从一开始到最近的一个，大概已经复活了一百多次了吧。

我住在一个烧焦的屋子里。

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

我还活着，一切都跟以前一样。

“起来。”吉力的声音有些微弱。

“为什么？除了饿死，这里什么事干不了。”

“又要放弃了？你是希望我把你丢在这里不管是吧？”

我转过脸望着他：“我不是要放弃，只是...节约自己的光能，直到...有机会逃出去。”

“听着，我曾经以为我们俩齐心协力就能出去。但是现在只不过是困在又一个轮回当中。”

“这里什么吃的都没有，吉尔。你感受不到那种被空虚啃噬的感觉。求你在出去之前，不要再管我了。”

吉尔伽美什望着我久久没有作声。我闭上了双眼。

“如你所愿。”


页边有一行潦草的手书：迷宫般的管道。这里面一定通向某个地方。但是那些该死的菌类挡住了我的路。

entries.name: ENTRY 12 - Debtor's Knife
entries.text:
This page is blighted with mold and the imprint of a memory…

The words seep experience into your open mind…

THROUGH THE EYES OF GILGAMESH…

I linger on the corpse of my once-Guardian. I've hidden his shame for so long. I believed it was my obligation, to be the warmth when his fire died… but now, I see that obligation was a leash to keep me tied to life. It is a cold, coiled, choking reality, and I will hang gasping from it no more.

See the truth, the whispers had offered. I saw it in every moment suffered aboard this vessel. A microcosm of violence extrapolated to the world beyond, with only one escape. Soon Katabasis would know it too.

Scorn onlookers surround us.

I raise Katabasis.

"Gilly…" Katabasis kneels before me, his rifle beside him. "What is this?"

"A way out. I won't carry you anymore."

"You're… abandoning me?" Katabasis looks to the Scorn, his rifle, his Ghost—no. No longer. Not his, not the Traveler's, not anyone's.

"I sacrificed everything to keep you moving forward. Guided you to every power you needed to survive." I share the truth he wants to forget. "And for what? It never ends anything. There's always more."

The Scorn encroach across disjointed walkways. Katabasis sinks. "You said you wouldn't…"

"You, the Traveler. You've kept me trapped in this death knell. Now it's time to set us free."

"What does that mean?" His words like stone weights.

"Sever our Light, or they'll rip you apart for a thousand lives." I gesture to the Scorn.

"You wouldn't."

"Your deaths are heavy, Katabasis, but I'll bring you back as many times as it takes for you to learn." He does not understand. "You think I don't feel pain? You think I don't suffer while you're hiding in your limbo?"

Katabasis lurches forward. "I did everything YOU asked me to."

"YOU LEFT!" I shout. "You left me here. You left me in the City. Made me turn away from the Traveler. We're like the Scorn in those tanks, drowning in panic… confusion… forever. You did that."

"The City was burning, and I wanted to live. Everything was… so we could live."

He still didn't see it. This place is no different than Sol. A barrel of blood. There's no reason to go back. "Now the Light is burning."

"We can survive this." Katabasis holds out his palm for me. "Please?"

"I don't want survival, Katabasis." I drift away from him. "I want salvation."

"…It got to you," Katabasis sobs weakly, his epiphany complete.

"You can end this, for both of us. It's your turn to sacrifice," I offer.

"Everything you say is a lie!" Katabasis grasps for his rifle.

Lever-to-action.

Shot to nothingness.

Ghost to dead memory.


FRENETIC SCRAWL INKED IN THE MARGIN READS: Water under the bridge, flooded with bodies waiting to stand again in the next wave. Be careful.
entries.text_zh:
这页已经被霉菌侵蚀，上面刻着某些记忆的印迹…

文字缓缓将原主人的经验传输给你…

透过吉尔伽美什之眼...

我望着眼前的尸体，他曾经是我的守护着。我帮他隐藏自己的耻辱。我相信这是我的义务，当他的希望之火熄灭时，我有义务成为他的火苗...但现在，我明白了，这种义务是我跟生命的一种纽带。是一个冰冷地束缚，是令人窒息的现实，我不再被它所束缚了。

我看到了真相，耳语者已经告诉了我。我在这艘船上尝到的每一丝痛苦都让我体会到它的正确。这是整个世界暴戾的某种缩影，只有一个方法能够逃出去。很快，冥旅也会知道。

嗤魅围着我们。

我复活了冥旅。

“吉力...”冥旅在我面前单膝跪地，背后背着他的步枪。“这是什么？”

“是一条出路。我不会再背负着你了。”

“你要...抛弃我？”冥旅望着嗤魅，又看了看他的步枪和他的机灵——不，不再是他的机灵了，也不属于旅行者，他只属于自己。

“我牺牲这么多，就是为了你能前行。为你提供所有能够让你活下来的指导。”我提醒他那些不愿想起的真相：“我为了什么？这解决不了任何事情。总有更多的问题出现。”

嗤魅将整个地方围住。冥旅心一沉：“你说过你不会...”

“你，旅行者。是你将我们困在这个无尽的轮回之中。现在该让彼此解脱了。”

“你是什么意思？”他的话十分沉重。

“切断我们之间的光能，否则我就让他们撕碎你千百万次。”我向嗤魅示意了一下。

“你不该这么做。”

“你的死亡对我来说也是负担，冥旅，但是我却一次次将你复活，让你学到经验。”他有些迷惑。“你以为我感觉不到痛苦吗？你以为在你躲藏在地狱夹缝中时，我感受不到难过吗？”

冥旅狠狠地向前探出身体：“你让我做的所有事情，我都做了。”

“你走了！”我大喊道：“你把我一个人丢在这里，把我丢在城里。让我抛下旅行者。我们就像活在那些容器中的嗤魅，沉浸在恐慌、困惑之中，永远也无法翻身。这都是你干的好事。”

“整个城市都在烧，我想要活命。大家都想要活命...所以我们才活了下来。”

他还是不明白。这地方跟太阳系没什么区别。不过是另一个装满鲜血的罐子罢了。回去又有什么意义呢。“现在，光能也燃烧起来了。”

“我们能活下来。”冥旅向往伸出手。“求你？”

“我不想活了，冥旅。”我从他身边飘开：“我想要获得救赎。”

“...你被它们洗脑了，”冥旅轻声抽泣，他突然明白了。

我对他说：“你可以结束这一切，为了我们俩。现在是你做出牺牲的时候了。”

“你所说的一切都是谎言！”冥旅紧紧握住手中的枪。

准备射击。

射向虚无。

这就是机灵关于死亡的记忆。


页边有一行潦草的手书：桥下的水淹没了尸体，再次受到冲击时它们便能复活。小心。

entries.name: Untamed
entries.text:
What have I done?

(NoiseNoiseNoiseNoiseNoiseNoise)

Fear.How.Mothers.Did.Sadness.It.Fathers.Come.Hate.To.Children.This.Sorrow.Forgive.Displeasure.Me.

(Chaos—Lubrae convulses. The sky shatters.)

This was the cost of justice?

(An enclosed cell. Introspection. Subjugation incoming. Life, upended.)

You made me do this. You made me do this. I made me do this. You made me do this.

(Father's face. Mother's face. Empty. Clan, broken. Blood, pouring. Silence, eerie.)

It was them versus us. Then it was us versus them. I ignored who "us" was. I forgot who "them" was.

(Our City. An abyss surrounds. Lubraean-made. Infinite. Or just empty. Divides. Silently conquers.)

Ignorant contentment. Love… I… was… cared for…

(My clan, safety. Dual fire in the sky. Blue light. Salvation. Dark light. Death. Safety, my clan—my family.)

—-And who cares for you now?—-

…There are none left.

—-Do you desire it still?—-

Once. I did once.

—-And you returned it?—-

…

(Our Wildlands. An Abyss separates. Lubraean-made. Infinite. Beautiful.) 

(A father. Him. A son. Me. His arm on my shoulder. Assurances of a collaborative future. A teardown of "us versus them." Love, shown.)

(Guards cross the Abyssal Bridge. Not guards—Stalkers, we call them, salivating after a group of Wanderers, ready to watch them be torn apart.)

(My anger flares. I move to confront the Stalkers. Father's hand holds me back. We lock eyes. His communicate sympathy, pain, regret. He won't let me reach the Wanderers. Their blood spills.) 

(A lesson in inaction. Father wants me to see what he's seen. To feel the powerlessness he's felt. To feel insignificant. To accept the status quo.)

—-You were never capable of returning it.—-

…

(Slaughter. Our eyes meet again. Father's saddened. Apologetic. Afraid. Not of the Stalkers returning across the bridge, but of me. He sees not the same in my eyes. Only confusion. Anger. Anger at everything.)

You have your answer.

—-It's not our answer to have, but yours to embrace.—-

Embrace? Why?

Hello?
entries.text_zh:
我到底做了什么？

（噪声噪声噪声噪声噪声噪声）

害怕。怎样。母亲。做到。悲伤。它。父亲。来。憎恨。孩子。这种。悲伤。原谅。不快。我。

（混沌——鲁布瑞剧烈地震动。天空四分五裂。）

这就是正义的代价？

（封闭的牢房。反省。镇压即将到来。生活，倒置。）

是你逼我这么做的。是你逼我这么做的。是我逼我这么做的。是你逼我这么做的。

（父亲的脸庞。母亲的脸庞。空洞。氏族，破碎不堪。鲜血，倾注而下。沉默，怪异可怕）。

是他们对抗我们。然后是我们对抗他们。我忽略了“我们”是谁。我忘了“他们”是谁。

（我们的圣城。深渊环伺。鲁布瑞人造成的。无尽。或者只是空洞。界限。默默地征服）。

无知的满足感。爱…我…得到了…照顾…

（我的氏族，安全。天空中的双重火焰。蓝光。救赎。暗光。死亡。安全，我的氏族，我的家人。）

—-那现在谁还在乎你？—-

…一个也没有了。

—-你还渴望吗？—-

曾经。我曾经确实渴望。

—-你还了回去？—-

…

（我们的荒原。深渊分隔开来。鲁布瑞人造成的。无尽。美丽。） 

（一个父亲。他。一个儿子。我。他的手臂搭在我的肩膀上。合作未来的保证。“我们对抗他们”的拆解。爱，表露。）

（守卫穿过深渊大桥。不是守卫，是潜行者，我们这么叫他们的，他们跟在一群漫游者后垂涎三尺，准备看着他们被撕成碎片。）

（我怒不可遏。要去和潜行者对质。父亲的手把我拉住了。我们对视着。他的眼神传达了同情、痛苦和遗憾。他不让我接近漫游者。他们的鲜血喷涌而出。） 

（无为的教训。父亲希望我看到他所看到的东西。感受他所感受到的无能为力。感受那种无足轻重。接受现状。）

—-你根本不可能还回去—-

…

（杀戮。我们的目光又相遇了。父亲伤心透了。道歉。害怕。不是对从桥上回来的潜行者，而是对我。他在我眼里看到的是不一样的东西。只有困惑。愤怒。对一切都感到愤怒。）

你有答案了。

—-这不是我们要拥有的答案，而是你要拥抱的答案。—-

拥抱？为什么？

听得到吗？

entries.name: Provoked
entries.text:
—-And what more of this family of yours?—-

They're gone. Dead. All of them. They don't matter anymore.

—-Is that so?—-

What do you even want to know? You want to know more about my father, the Lubraean traitor? Or perhaps my mother, another Lubraean traitor? I should have seen it coming. I could tell you about my clan, and my clan-father and clan-mother. Also Lubraean traitors. They were all City dwellers once, loyalists to The Regime before exiling themselves. Do you see now what I see?

—-We see unfinished business… We see a child seeking validation… We see great loss.—-

(Content. Together. A fire burns bright. Our cavern is alight. We hide within it to keep safe—the hazy sky is outside, and surely there are some without shelter this night. Those who will be torn apart. By the wild. By the Umbral Sun. By those Lubraean guards who call themselves Stalkers, pursuing us on behalf of a brutal regime.) 

(Long ago, there were only Wanderers, surviving a harsh landscape covered with shifting, bloodthirsty flora. Surviving wildlife can flatten themselves until they are practically invisible—perfect at going unnoticed until they've split your skin and organs apart.)

—-And now?—-

(We are divided. Split by a shimmering orb that appeared briefly in our sky, as if having two suns isn't already crowded enough.)

—-What of this shimmering orb?—-

It was before my time. It came. We evolved. It left. Left us with a mess—those who believed in good progress. Those who didn't. 

Those who believed dwelled in the City. Controlled it. Filled it only with the light of the Sapphiric Sun and endless day to keep the horrors of night away, revealing the horrors among us. They pushed progress for the sake of the few while the rest of us took our chances under the alternating suns.

—-And this shimmering orb you now see before you?—-

(There it is. Shining like silver in the sky. Like the stories told.)

Providing hope, then leaving everything to those who desire control but lack commitment and understanding.

—-Look at them now.—-

(Bodies. Limbs. Vaporized remains. A shattered sapphire. Lubrae irreparable. An Umbral sun, still shining darkness.)

…What have I done?

—-What was necessary.—-
entries.text_zh:
—-那你的这个家庭还有什么呢？—-

他们已经走了。死了。所有的人。他们不再重要了。

—-是这样吗？—-

你到底想知道什么？你想知道更多关于我父亲的事吗，那个鲁布瑞叛徒？或者是我的母亲，另一个鲁布瑞叛徒？我早该料到的。我可以给你讲讲我的氏族，我的氏族父母。也是鲁布瑞的叛徒。他们曾经都是圣城居民，在流亡之前都是政权的忠实拥护者。你现在看到我看到的了吗？

—-我们看到未完成的事业…我们看到一个寻求认可的孩子…我们看到巨大的丧失。—-

（心满意足。大家在一起。火烧得很旺。我们的洞穴火光闪亮。我们躲在里面确保安全——外面是朦胧的天空，今晚肯定有一些人无家可归。那些人将被撕成碎片。被野性撕裂。被本影之日撕裂。被那些自称为潜行者，代表残暴政权追捕我们的鲁布瑞守卫撕裂。） 

（很久以前，这里只有漫游者，他们在满是流动的嗜血菌群的恶劣环境中生存了下来。幸存下来的野生动物会压低身体，直到几乎不被看见——在它们把你的皮肤和器官撕裂开来之前，完全不被注意到。）

—-现在呢？—-

（我们四分五裂，被一个在我们的天空中短暂出现的闪光球体分割开来，仿佛拥有两个太阳还不够拥挤。）

—-那这个闪光的球体怎么样？—-

那是在我出生之前的事。它来了。我们进化了。它离开了。给我们留下了一个烂摊子——那些相信进步的人。还有那些不相信的人。 

那些相信的人就居住在圣城里。控制着它。让它充满蓝宝石般的阳光和无尽的白昼来驱走黑夜的恐怖，揭示出我们内心的恐惧。他们为了少数人的利益而推动进步，而我们其余的人则在交替的太阳底下碰运气。

—-那你现在看到的这个闪光球体呢？—-

（就在那里，像银币一样在天空中闪闪发光。就像故事里讲的那样。）

提供希望，然后把一切交给那些渴望控制但缺乏承诺和理解的人。

—-看看他们现在的样子。—-

（身体。四肢。蒸发的遗体。破碎的蓝宝石。鲁布瑞已经无法挽回。本影之日，仍在暗影中闪耀。）

…我做了什么？

—-必要的事。—-

entries.name: Endangered
entries.text:
(We survive. We give back to the land. We help those in need. They come for us anyway.)

(The Regime raids our camp. No logical explanation for those they kill. Clan-mothers. Clan-fathers. Children. They kill us without purpose. A red spattering courtesy of a Stalker spreads across my face. Goodbye, Fhent. Goodbye, clan-uncle.)

(I am covered in red. It's all I see.)

(It spills out of these Stalkers like an endless crimson wave as I face them. Their valuables and instruments become mine. A Glaive of my own. A Sapphiric Converter.) 

(Father is carried off, not killed. Not yet anyway. Not many of us are left. Mother and the others look at me with concern. Not for my injuries, but for those who suffered at my hands.)

—-They disrespected your power.—-

They were weak.

—-And yet you still saved them when you could.—-

(The Stalkers attack us under the Umbral Sun, during a migration. They know how to find us—they know we move at twilight—the space between when the Stalkers hunt and the planet kills.)

(We barely survive. At the safehouse, they dance and sing, not in celebration, but in admiration of their continued existence and in memoriam for those lost. I sit in anger. I hunger for revenge.)

Loss meant little to our kind. It was too rampant.

—-Are you sure it wasn't just you?—-

You know not what you ask.

(I'm a boy. I hold the furry little Yhadt in my hands as it wriggles before pulling it apart. It separates from its skin with ease. What is this worthless, pointless thing?)

Why show me this?

—-This you have already seen… experienced. Surely you can handle it again?—-

(This worthless, pointless thing… it dies so unceremoniously—did it ever matter at all? The children weep for their lost pet, but I feel… powerful. I feel—)

—-You know what you are. You always knew.—-

(Mother and the others look at me with concern. Not for my injuries, but for those who suffered at my hands… and they are right to do so. Tearing their bodies to pieces brought only joy. What… am I?)

I am a monster. I knew it then, I know it now.

—-Not a monster. A savior.—-
entries.text_zh:
（我们存活了下来。我们回馈土地。我们帮助有需要的人。他们还是会来找我们）。

（政权突袭了我们的营地。不分青红皂白地杀人。氏族母亲。氏族父亲。孩子们。他们无缘无故地杀害我们。有个潜行者把鲜红的血渍溅满了我的脸。再见，芬特。再见，氏族叔叔。）

（我浑身沾满鲜血。这就是我看到的一切。）

（当我面对这些潜行者时，它就像无尽的红色波浪一样从他们身上喷涌而出。他们的贵重物品和仪器变成了我的。属于我自己的一把偃月。蓝宝石转换器。） 

（父亲是被带走的，不是被杀害的。至少还没有。剩下的人不多了。母亲和其他人担心地看着我。不是因为我受的伤，而是因为那些在我手下受苦的人。）

—-他们不尊重你的力量。—-

他们很软弱。

—-但你还是尽力救了他们。—-

（在一次迁徙中，潜行者在本影之日下攻击我们。他们知道如何找到我们——他们知道我们会趁暮色——在潜行者狩猎和星球杀戮之间的一段时间里行动。）

（我们勉强活了下来。在安全屋，他们载歌载舞，不是为了庆祝，而是为了赞美他们还能继续活着，纪念那些失去的人。我坐在那里满腔怒火，渴望复仇。）

丧失对我们来说并不算什么。已经司空见惯了。

—-你确定不是你一个人吗？—-

你不知道你在问什么。

（我是个男孩。我把毛茸茸的小伊哈特捧在手里，它蠕动着，然后我把它扯开。它轻易地就与皮肤分离了。这个毫无价值、毫无意义的东西是什么？）

为什么给我看这个？

—-这个你已经见过…体验过了。你肯定能再面对一次？—-

（这个毫无价值、毫无意义的东西…它死得如此随便——这有什么关系吗？孩子们为他们丢失的宠物哭泣，但我感觉自己…很强大。我感觉…）

—-你知道你是什么。你一直都知道。—-

（妈妈和其他人担心地看着我。不是因为我受的伤，而是因为那些在我手下受苦的人…他们这么做是对的。把他们的身体撕成碎片带来的只有快乐。我…是什么？）

我是一只怪物。我当时就知道，现在也知道。

—-不是怪物。是救世主。—-

entries.name: Nepotistic
entries.text:
(Father… it's been a year since you were taken. But we have not been attacked since. I know the Stalkers still watch the clan, but I survive alone these days—ousted for being the only one brave enough to act. A liability, they called me.) 

(We will see what they say when I bring you back. If you still live.)

(Every Umbral Sun, I walk the Abyssal perimeter with the help of the Sapphiric Converter's attunement to our great sun, providing me light in the dark. The Stalkers don't expect me, so they don't see me. And the Glaive, a tool of The Regime, which I have named after you—Rheliksward—makes eviscerating them that much easier.)

(I kill many looking for a sign of you. Wash my hands with their blood in the hopes of your continued existence. I have been lost without your guidance. Unsure of what I am. Who I am. What I am meant to do.)

(And now, as you stand before me draped in the insignias of the very Regime that took you, I am confident that you have no answers.)

(As you call your fellow Stalkers to overwhelm me, to bind me, to carry me into the dense, unending city of Lubrae, I am confident that you are a coward.)

(As you testify at my trial that I should not be put to death for what The Regime claims are immeasurable crimes, but should instead serve alongside the Stalkers—alongside you, killing Wanderers, annihilating clans—I am confident you are an opportunist.)

(What about Mother? Our clan? What about "down with The Regime"? What about biding our time? Or is this another lesson in inaction—in sparing ourselves from the absolute worst so that we can barely live? Barely survive?)

(I am confident, Father—you will die by my hand.)
entries.text_zh:
（父亲…你被带走已经一年了。但从那以后，我们就再没有遭到攻击。我知道潜行者们还在监视氏族，但这些天我都在独自求生：作为唯一一个敢于行动的人而遭到了驱逐。他们说我是个累赘。） 

（等我把你带回来，看看他们会说些什么。如果你还活着的话。）

（我在蓝宝石转换器与我们伟大太阳协同的帮助下，行走在深渊的周界，每一个本影之日都为我在黑暗中提供光明。潜行者没料到我会出现在这，所以他们没看到我。而偃月，政权的一种工具，我用你的名字把它命名为——雷里克斯卫士——让活剥他们变得更加容易。）

（我杀了许多人，只为找到你的踪迹。抱着你还存活的希望，用他们的血清洗我的双手。没有你的指引，我迷失了方向。不确定我是什么。我是谁。我注定要做的事。）

（现在，当你站在我面前，身上挂着带走你的那个政权的徽章时，我确信你也没有答案。）

（当你召唤你的潜行者同伴来制服我，捆绑我，把我带进稠密无边的鲁布瑞圣城时，我确信你是个懦夫。）

（当你在我的审判中作证说我不应该因为政权声称的“不可估量的罪行”被处死，而是应该和潜行者一起并肩作战——与你一起携手杀死漫游者，消灭氏族时——我确信你是个机会主义者。）

（那母亲呢？我们的氏族呢？“打倒政权”呢？韬光养晦呢？还是说这又是一个无为的教训——让我们免于遭受最糟糕的后果，这样我们才能勉强活着？勉强生存？）

（我确信，父亲——你会死在我手里。）

entries.name: Defiant
entries.text:
—-The Regime took all that mattered to you… and yet, you blamed your father?—-

The Regime never lied about who they were. They were brutal, yes. But honest.

—-Honesty meant something to you?—-

It meant everything.

—-Interesting. And so, in the face of your father, the hypocrite, you leaned on The Regime that enslaved you both instead. That killed so many of your kind.—-

The Regime did not enslave me. It freed me.

(The Regime puts the Glaive back in my hand, the one I named in honor of you. I have renamed it—Rheliksbane—and no matter how you try to hide it, this scares you. Just as I knew it would.)

(I'd be lying if I said I didn't take pleasure in this. But I do. Just as I take pleasure in the constant Sapphiric light. And the roof over my head. The consistency in regular meals. The Regime lives well, comfortable.) 

(The city may be overcrowded. The laws may be strict. The few may have all of the power. But at least we're not out there trying fruitlessly to survive. At least we're not out there scared, cold and alone, wondering if we'll live to see the next rise of either sun.)

(But most importantly, Father—nobody denies me my thirst. My lust for blood. They encourage it. Feed it. And they have begun to show me truths. About the Wanderers. About what the glimmering orb encouraged.)

(You always claimed the hands of The Regime were stained red, but you never showed me yours—until now.)

(How dare you stand before me now and confess your disloyalty to The Regime. How dare you lie to me again.)

(You may have overwhelmed me this time. Escaped my grasp. But I am coming for you. I will end this.)
entries.text_zh:
—-政权夺走了你所在乎的一切…而你却责怪你的父亲？—-

政权从来没有隐瞒过他们的身份。是的，他们很残忍。但却是诚实的。

—-诚实对你有意义吗？—-

它意味着一切。

—-真有趣。所以，面对你父亲这个伪君子，你反而倚靠了奴役你们、杀死了那么多你的同胞的政权。—-

政权没有奴役我。它解救了我。

（政权把偃月放回我手中，就是我以你的名字命名的那把。我把它重新取名为——雷里克斯祸害——不管你再怎么掩饰，这都让你害怕。正如我所料想的那样。）

（如果我说我不喜欢这样，那一定是在撒谎。但我确实很享受。就像我享受那永恒的蓝宝石般的光芒。还有我的栖身之处。规律饮食的一致性。政权的生活很好，很舒适。） 

（圣城也许太过于拥挤。法律也许很严格。少数人也许拥有了全部权力。但至少我们不是在徒劳地求生。至少我们不再害怕，不再寒冷，不再孤单，不再担心自己能否活着看到下一轮太阳的升起。）

（但最重要的是，父亲——没人能否认我的渴望。我对鲜血的欲望。他们鼓动它。喂养它。他们已经开始向我展示真相。有关漫游者的真相。有关那闪闪发光的圆球鼓动了什么的真相。）

（你总是说政权的双手沾满了鲜血，但你直到现在——才让我看到你的双手。）

（你现在怎么敢站在我面前承认你对政权的不忠。你怎么敢再对我撒谎。）

（这次你也许制服了我。逃出了我的手掌心。但我会去找你的。我会结束这一切。）

entries.name: Isolated
entries.text:
Stop.

—-Why?—-

I don't want to do this. I don't want to relive this.

—-Most would die for the opportunity to retread their greatest moments.—-

…Great moments end in triumph, not mass extinction. In the end, what mattered?

—-The end? No, no. We are so very far from the end. You are not yet ready to taste true glory. You may not yet be familiar with the concept of metamorphosis , but we assure you, you are experiencing it right now. You were once free to roam your little box but lacked wings to fly out of it. And so you grew them —the little larva that you were—wrapped in a cocoon. Now, you need only cut yourself from it. But to do so, you must leave behind that which made you weak, retaining only that which makes you strong.—-

But my world…

(Shattered.)

—-Recreated here, for you.—-

(Reformed. All around me.)

—-Every painstaking detail.—-

(The suns. The Abyss. The Regime. Lubrae.)

—-Every painful memory.—-

(My clan. My family. Khloa, clan-father. Kheesa, clan-mother. Kheeta, sister. Vrhuna, mother. Rhelik, father. Their heads in my hands.)

—-Love for them made you weak. Power over them made you strong. Upon reflection, you are filled with regret. Believing yourself to be under the spell of the Regime. Believing your actions in their tenure to be wrong. But morality, oh dear Rhulk, is subjective. And now that you are all that remains of Lubrae, isn't it time you made the rules? Isn't it time you looked back upon your life with pride? After all, your actions brought you to us. And only we can help you emerge from your cocoon.—-

We…? What even are you?

—-We are your salvation. We are your judgment. And soon we will be… your Witness.—-
entries.text_zh:
停下来。

—-为什么？—-

我不想这么做。我不想再体验一遍。

—-大多数人愿意为重现他们最伟大的时刻而死。—-

…伟大的时刻应以胜利而告终，而不是大灭绝。到了最后，那有什么意义？

—-最后？不，不。我们离最后还很远。你还没准备好品味真正的荣耀。你可能还不熟悉蜕变的概念，但我们向你保证，你现在就在经历它。你曾经自由地在你的小盒子里漫游，但却缺少飞出盒子的翅膀。于是你长出了翅膀——那个曾是你的小幼虫——被包裹在一个蚕茧里。现在，你只需要让自己从里面挣脱出来。但要做到这一点，你必须抛下那些让你软弱的东西，只保留使你强大的东西。—-

但我的世界…

（支离破碎了。）

—-在这里重筑了，专门献给你。—-

（完全改造了。就在我的周围。）

—-每一个精心设计的细节。—-

（太阳。深渊。政权。鲁布瑞。）

—-每一段痛苦的记忆。—-

（我的氏族。我的家人。克洛，氏族父亲。克伊萨，氏族母亲。克伊塔，妹妹。弗鲁纳，母亲。莱里克，父亲。他们的头颅在我手里。）

—-对他们的爱让你变得软弱。对他们的控制让你变得强大。回想起来，你内心充满了悔恨。相信自己受到了政权的蛊惑。相信你在他们任期内的行为是错误的。但是道德是主观的，哦，亲爱的胡克。现在你已经是鲁布瑞星残留下来的全部了，是不是该你制定规则了？难道你现在不应该骄傲地回顾你的一生吗？毕竟，你的行为把你带到了我们这里。而只有我们能帮助你破茧而出。—-

我们…？你到底是什么？

—-我们是你的救赎。我们是你的审判。很快我们就会成为…你的见证者。—-

entries.name: Tainted
entries.text:
—-Your father, he feared your anger. Feared you.—-

Because he knew what I could become. He knew what burdens flowed through my veins. He too felt them, lived them.

(I am a boy. My father skewers three Stalkers in front of me. His eyes are crimson, his sharpened teeth bared as he moves to bite their heads off.)

For a time, my father embodied what I felt inside. I looked up to him, believed I could confide in him. He felt a bloodlust and he despised The Regime. But as they did with me, the others began to see him as a liability. So he softened and softened until, in my opinion, he degraded to the Lubraean equivalent of fetid rot.

—-And so you treated him as such.—-

(I stare into the face of my father, his severed, shattered head held in my hand, dripping with what once stayed within.)
A consequence of weakness. His own.

(In search of my father, I reach the final hiding place of my clan. Devoid of active life, as were the rest. But filled with tokens, trinkets, heirlooms. They left in a hurry, all who remained. And I know where desperation takes them.)

The same place it took me.

The Abyss.
entries.text_zh:
—-你的父亲，他惧怕你的怒火。惧怕你。—-

因为他知道我会成为什么样的人。他知道我的血管里流淌着什么样的重担。他也感受过它们，体验过它们。

（我是个男孩。我父亲当着我的面杀了三个潜行者。他的眼睛通红，呲着锋利的牙齿，准备咬掉他们的头颅。）

有一段时间，我的父亲体现了我的内心感受。我仰视他，相信我可以向他倾诉。他有一种杀戮的欲望，他鄙视政权。但正如它们对我所做的那样，其他人开始将他视为一种负担。所以他变得越来越软弱，直到在我看来，他堕落成了和恶臭的腐根没什么两样的鲁布瑞人。

—-所以你把他当成腐根对待。—-

（我凝视着父亲的脸，他那被砍断的破碎头颅握在我的手中，滴着曾经留在里面的东西。）
软弱无能的后果。他咎由自取。

（为了寻找我的父亲，我到达了我氏族最后的藏身之处。那里了无生机，就像其他的藏身处一样。但里面装满了代币，小饰品，传家宝。剩下的人都匆忙地走了。而我知道绝望会把他们带到何处。）

和它带我去的地方一样。

深渊。

entries.name: Assaulted
entries.text:
(The Abyss. The artificial crack in Lubrae, separating the desired from the undesired. A crevice devoid of all but a strand of concrete to connect the halves.) 

(There, amongst the brush that conceals those approaching, I find them. Trembling, unsure of what would come next regardless of encouragement from Father. He seeks to ferry them into the city of Lubrae unnoticed, through the tunnels below. How he plans this, I do not know. But I do not intend to find out.)

(My emergence from the deep forest was not unexpected, or so my father claims. Mother is here. Clan-mother is too. I do not see many other familiar faces. They have been worn down. Beaten. Broken. In search of a forever home. I must give it to them. I must… )

(But they plead. They reminisce. They appeal. They claim to love. To care. Mother brushes my arm, touch designed to evoke my inner goodness, one I am supposed to have forgotten. She apologizes for my exile.)

(Then Father apologizes—for everything. For the furious example he set. For earlier inaction. He wants to do right. He wants our clan to live a comfortable life. I see sadness. I see truth. I see regret. Perhaps this is the way. Perhaps my time with The Regime has clouded my judgment.)

(And perhaps my tumble into this Abyssal chasm is the result of my own overwhelming catharsis.)

(Or perhaps it is the cost of naivete.) 

(Their faces grow smaller as I plunge deeper, but I can still make out their expressions. No longer do any of them—the adults, the children—no longer do they show regret or pain or sorrow—)

(Their faces show relief.)
entries.text_zh:
（深渊。鲁布瑞的人工裂缝，将有欲之人和无欲之人分隔两端。一条除了连接两半的一股混凝土外，没有其他任何东西的裂缝。） 

（在那里，在隐藏着接近者的灌木丛中，我发现了他们。他们颤抖着，不知道接下来会发生什么，不顾父亲的鼓动。他试图通过下面的隧道，在不被注意的情况下将他们渡进鲁布瑞圣城。我不知道他是如何计划的。但我不也想知道。）

（我从森林深处出来并没有让他们意外，至少我父亲是这么说的。母亲就在这里。氏族母亲也是。我没有看到其他熟悉的面孔。他们已经疲惫不堪。筋疲力竭。颓丧不堪。他们在找寻一个永远的家园。我必须给他们这个家。我必须…）

（但是他们苦苦哀求。他们追忆往事。他们诉情劝说。他们声称要爱我。要关心我。母亲抚摸我的手臂，想要唤起我内心的善良，那种我应该已经忘却了的品质。她为我的流放道歉。）

（然后父亲道歉了——为所有这一切道歉，为他所树立的愤怒榜样道歉。为之前的无为道歉。他想做正确的事。他想让我们的族人过上舒适的生活。我看到了悲伤。我看到了真相。我看到了悔恨。也许就是这样。我与政权相处的时间已经蒙蔽了我的判断。）

（也许我跌入这个深渊裂口是我自己彻底宣泄的结果。）

（又或许这是天真的代价。） 

（我越往深处跳，他们的脸就变得越小，但我仍然能分辨出他们的表情。他们任何人——无论大人小孩——都不再表现出悔恨，痛苦或悲伤——）

（他们的脸上露出轻松的表情。）

entries.name: Lamented
entries.text:
I should have died.

—-And yet, it was there in the darkness of the Abyss that you became truly alive.—-

(I lie amongst swamp and rock and ruin. The Abyss is not unending after all. The wrathful sounds of unchecked nature draw close. Down here, it is dark. And in the dark, they thrive. I am… broken.)

(—-And now, you are unbroken.—-)

(I am… unbroken. I see your Luster. Disarming the beasts who dared to approach, their flesh melting in your presence.)

(—-And we see yours.—-)

(I rise. Broken and then unbroken. What is this thing that grants life?)

(—-We are opportunity.—-)

(And I am?)

(—-Ruin.—-)

(And what am I meant to do?)

(—-Ruin.—-)

(Your voice subsides, but your Luster remains—it is a familiar one. Like that of our Umbral Sun.)

(Rheliksbane lies nearby, broken in two. You mend it with your Luster. It is whole, again. But even more so than before, as if imbued with the wrath of vengeful gods.)

(Miles above, I see the axis that sits between our bright city of Lubrae and our shadowed Wildlands. By now, my clan must be inside the city.)

(I pocket your Luster before I thrust my Glaive into the sheer wall that separates me from my vengeance. I lift myself with one hand gripping the slate. Then another thrust of the Glaive, raising me ever closer towards my goal.)

(No more chances. No more wavering. No more weakness.)
entries.text_zh:
我早该死了。

—-然而，正是在深渊的暗影中，你才真正活了过来。—-

（我躺在沼泽、岩石和废墟之中。毕竟，深渊不是没有尽头的。不受控制的大自然愤怒之声越来越近了。这里很暗。而在黑暗中，他们繁荣兴盛。我…破败不堪。）

（—-而现在，你完好无损。—-）

（我…完好无损。我看到了你的光泽。卸下那些胆敢靠近的野兽的武装，他们的血肉在你面前融化。）

（—-而我们看到了你的光泽。—-）

（我站了起来。先是破败不堪，然后完好无损。赋予生命的这东西是什么？）

（—-我们是机遇。—-）

（那我是？）

（—-毁灭。—-）

（我该怎么做？）

（—-毁灭。—-）

（你的声音减弱了，但你的光泽依旧，那是令人熟悉的光辉。就像我们的本影之日。）

（雷里克斯祸害就在附近，断成了两半。你用你的光泽修补它。它又完整了。但比以前更甚，仿佛被注入了复仇之神的怒火。）

（在几英里的上空，我看到了位于我们明亮的鲁布瑞圣城和我们阴影笼罩下荒野之间的轴线。现在，我的族人一定已经进城了。）

（我把你的光泽装进口袋，然后把我的偃月刺入将我和复仇分隔开来的高墙。我单手抓住石板，把自己拉起来。接着，又刺了一刀偃月，让我离目标越来越近了。）

（不再给机会。不再动摇，不再软弱。）

entries.name: Liberated
entries.text:
I know what happened next. I do not need to see it again.

(I rend Mother's flesh.)

Do you not hear me?!

(I remove Father's head from his neck.)

This is madness!

(None escape my wrath. Not even the little ones. Not even civilians. The city watches in horror. They know what I am.)
This must stop!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

Stop!!!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

I COMMAND YOU!!!

(Their faces inform only of relief.)

AHHHHH!

(The Sapphiric Sun implodes.)

PLEASE!

(Lubrae is cracking. Lubrae is shattering. Lubrae is upending. What have I done?)

I CAN'T—

(Your Luster. My Glaive.)

—-Relive it.—-

NOOOOO—

(They've turned against me—my Regime. They've perished by my hand—my clan. They call me a monster. They put me in a cage. They seek my execution. But your Luster—I see it, even though they took you from me.)

(You guide my hand. You free me of these chains. You find me again. You return to me my Glaive—no longer Rheliksbane. Serving only one final purpose: Lubrae's Ruin.)

(A shattered sky. A planet convulsing. Our existence, upended.)

(Their folly was their intended salvation. Siphoning light from the Sapphiric Sun itself. I use your Luster. Turn their technology against them, like a backfired pistol.)

(After serving them. Protecting them. Fighting for them. Suffering for them.)

(A shattered sky. A planet convulsing. Tearing apart.)

(One Lubraean remains—me. But not for long. What have I done? I stare into the Abyss. It has opened—truly opened this time—to show me what lies beneath: death. I drop your Luster. I drop Lubrae's Ruin. I let myself fall in. And then I… I… and then I am… )

—————————————————————————————————————————————-

Here. With you. My… Witness.

—-And what do you feel now? Devoid of family. Devoid of The Regime. Devoid of Lubrae. What do you feel here, in our embrace, now that they are gone and you are left?—-

Rhulk opens his eyes. Crawls forth through the blackened solution that engulfed him all this time. Emerges from the wall of obsidian-like miasma to find his Luster. To find Lubrae's Ruin. Taking them, he rises to his feet.

—-What do you feel, my child?—-

"Relief."
entries.text_zh:
我知道接下来发生了什么。我不需要再看一次。

（我撕碎了母亲的肉体。）

你没听见我说的吗？！

（我从父亲的脖子上取下他的头颅。）

真是疯了！

（没有人能逃脱我的愤怒。即使是小孩子。即使是平民。整个圣城都在惊恐地看着。他们知道我是什么。）
停下来！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

别说了！！！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

我命令你！！！

（他们的脸上只露出轻松的表情。）

啊啊啊啊！

（蓝宝石般的太阳内爆了。）

拜托了！

（鲁布瑞开裂了。鲁布瑞破碎了。鲁布瑞颠覆了。我干了什么？）

我没法——

（你的光泽。我的偃月。）

—-再体验一遍。—-

不不不——

（他们背叛了我——我的政权。他们死在了我手上——我的氏族。他们叫我怪物。他们把我关进笼子里。他们想要处决我。但你的光泽——我看到了，即使他们把你从我身边带走。）

（你指引着我的手。你帮我解开镣铐。你再次找到我。你还给了我的偃月——它不再是雷里克斯祸害，而只服务于最终的目标：鲁布瑞之厄。）

（碎裂的天空。行星剧烈地震动。我们的存在，颠覆了。）

（他们的愚蠢曾是他们想要的救赎。从蓝宝石太阳身上抽走光。我利用了你的光泽。用他们的技术转而对付他们，就像逆火手枪一样。）

（就在效忠他们。保护他们。为他们战斗。为他们受苦之后。）

（碎裂的天空。行星剧烈地震动。分崩离析。）

（剩下一个鲁布瑞人，就是我。但这不会持续太久。我做了什么？我凝视着深渊。它打开了——这一次它真的打开了——让我看到了隐藏在下面的东西：死亡。我扔下了你的光泽。我扔下了鲁布瑞之厄。我让自己掉了进去。然后我…我…然后我就…）

—————————————————————————————————————————————-

来到了这儿。和你一起。我的…见证者。

—-你现在的感觉是什么？没有了家人。没有了政权。没有了鲁布瑞。在这里，在我们的怀抱中，你有什么感觉，现在他们都没了，只剩下了你？—-

胡克睁开眼睛。从一直吞没着他的焦糊溶液中爬了出来。从黑曜石般的瘴气之墙中露了出来，以找到他的光泽，找到鲁布瑞之厄。拿着它们，他站了起来。

—-你有什么感觉，我的孩子？—-

“轻松。”

entries.name: The Habitable World
entries.text:
A dream of worlds in unity, millennia gone by, alien and familiar all at once. It leaves behind a data fragment to mark its passing.

[RECORD: GRIEF EFFUSION]

After the informant had come, bringing reports of the end of the Ammonite by the sword of the festering Hive, we did not yet know disaster. Unusual signals at the edges of our Habitable World suddenly had meaning, the intelligence thrice-over credible enough to mobilize. And yet: those at the core of our united Ecumene did not know the scent of fear.

After all, it was to be understood that they would fall. The Ammonite were only one, not a unity. Divided. Meanwhile our Habitable World always grew. We offered the Fathomless Deep to any who wished to learn of our synergy, and it glossed the way to become more than we were.

The day the war began, I was far from disaster. There was celebration. A new client-species drank of the Deep and understood the World as we tasted it. The joy marked the air, and all of us shared it, for all were now Ecumene: welcome, welcome. What could bitter such a thing?

Sunrise-scents were long fading when I read the first report of strife, though delight lingered sweet on my breath. Buoys offline. Sentinels unresponsive. A first strike. A lingering scent we could not understand, though the Deep indicated familiarity. From the beacons: Aiat. Aiat.

I set this day in memory above all others.

[ENACT: REMEMBER]

It has been long and long since the war began. The Habitable World shrinks by the moment. We know not what the future holds but crisis and fear.

I set this day in memory so that we will know, when the lessons are taught in some warless future, unbreathed but true in the fragile hope all of us shelter. Fear did not come suddenly. The first harbingers of violence arrived on the same winds as joy. That of value must be cherished, for it may already be too late.

In the Deep may we be kept.
entries.text_zh:
一段关于统一世界的幻梦，千年过后，既陌生又熟悉。它留下了一块数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

[记录：悲伤倾泻]

线人抵达后，带来了阿莫耐特在溃烂邪魔族的刀剑下灭亡的消息，我们对灾难还一无所知。在我们宜居世界边缘的异常信号突然间有了意义，情报的可信度提高了三倍，足以发起动员。然而：那些处于我们统一家园核心的人还未嗅到恐惧的味道。

毕竟，他们会倒下并不难理解。阿莫耐特只是个独立个体，不是统一整体。四分五裂。与此同时，我们的宜居世界一直在发展壮大。我们向任何想要了解我们协同能力的人提供了无底深渊，它为我们指明了超越自我的道路。

战争开始的那天，我离灾难十分遥远。当时有一场庆祝活动。一种新的平民物种啜饮了深渊并理解了世界，我们一同品尝。空气中弥漫着我们共同分享的喜悦，因为一切全都成了家园：欢迎，欢迎。有什么能让这样的事变得痛苦呢？

当我看到第一份纷争报告时，日出的气味早已消散，尽管我呼吸中仍然萦绕着喜悦的香甜。浮标离线。哨兵们毫无响应。首次打击。一种我们无法理解，挥之不去的气味，但深渊表明了熟悉感。从信标处传来：阿特。阿特。

我将这一天牢记于心，高于其他所有一切。

[启动：铭记]

战争开始后已经过了很长时间。宜居世界正在萎缩。除了危机和恐惧，我们不知道未来会发生什么。

我将这一天牢记于心，这样我们才能知道，在某个没有战争的未来，当人们吸取教训时，在我们所有人躲避的脆弱希望中，未经泄露却无比真实的信息。恐惧并非突如其来。暴力的先兆和喜悦一样乘风而至。宝贵的东西必须受到珍视，因为也许已经为时已晚。

愿我们被深渊所收留。

entries.name: A Sword, an Edge
entries.text:
A phantasm of the Hive, forbidden and sacred, trespassing into hidden and unwelcoming places. It leaves behind a calcified fragment to mark its passing.

Here is what is taught to the Hive, from the basest of Thralls newly made: that what can be destroyed, must be destroyed. What cannot be destroyed will surpass infinity. Therefore, is it not best to destroy? Only by testing can the truth be found. Only in destruction can the invincible surpass the mortal. Commit the violence, and know you are part of that greatest ambition, to create some ultimacy, which perfects the universe. That which is built on your sacrifice, with your bones as the foundation and your blood as the mortar, is yet part of you. In this way is transcendence achieved.

Every belief creates a heresy.

I tell you this in a duelist's regard: I made that heresy. Is it not just? It was my hand that fashioned the Hive from the marrow of their predecessors, and it was my voice that whispered this in time. That as much as the Hive were uplifted by the worms, so too were those worms uplifted by the Hive.
 
If they were so weak they needed us to live, this ancient logic of the infinitely sharpened edge should have left them behind long ago.

Do you think I did not see this? My father's worm did not tell me only of swords. It had vast things to say, painted the cosmos in shine and gore, truth and fiction. I looked forward with three clear eyes and chose the path of the sword to cut open our future. To reach the stars, first one must crawl out of the ocean. It is a question of priorities.

This is not regret, this story I tell. It is but a ripple.

That whisper of ideas beyond swords is here to stay: I have ensured this. Even among us, such things die by slow inches, excruciating and unquiet. Possibility remains, a secret woven into the blank spaces of dogma. That what was defeated may rise again; that the shape of all shapes is not yet settled.

That the worms need the Hive more than is reciprocal.

Even between the lines of the Books of Sorrow themselves is this written.
entries.text_zh:
一个邪魔族的幻象，禁忌而神圣，闯入了不甚友好的隐蔽之地。它留下了一块钙化的碎片来标记它的逝去。

这是新造出来最卑劣的怨魂教会邪魔族的道理：能被摧毁的，必须被摧毁。无法摧毁的将超越无限。因此，摧毁不是最好的吗？只有通过考验才能发现真相。只有在毁灭之中，无敌者才能超越凡人之躯。使用暴力，知道你是最庞大野心的其中一环，去创造某种终局，从而完善宇宙。建立在你的牺牲之上、以你的骨骼为根基、以你的鲜血为砂浆的东西，却也是你的一部分。这样才能实现超然。

每一种信仰都会滋生异端。

我站在一名决斗者的角度告诉你：我创造了那个异端。这不公平吗？是我的手，用其前辈的骨髓塑造了邪魔族，是我的声音，及时低声说出了这句话。蠕虫鼓舞了邪魔族多少，邪魔族也就鼓舞了那些蠕虫多少。
 
要是其如此虚弱，以至于需要我们才能生存，优胜劣汰这一古老的逻辑早就该将其遗弃了。

你以为我没看到吗？我父亲的蠕虫告诉我的不仅仅是刀剑。它有许多话要说，把宇宙描绘成光辉与血腥，真实与虚构。我用三双清澈的眼睛向前看，选择了刀剑之路，切开了我们的未来。要触及群星，首先必须爬出海洋。这是一个优先次序的问题。

这不是悔恨，我讲的这个故事。它只是一道涟漪。

刀剑之外思想的低语将继续存在于此：我已确保了这一点。即使在我们中间，这种事情也在缓慢地、痛苦地、不平静地消逝。可能性依然存在，这是个编织在教条空白处的秘密。被击败的还可能重新崛起；所有形状之形态尚未稳定。

蠕虫对邪魔族的需求不仅仅是对等的。

甚至在忧愁之书本身的字里行间也写着这样的话。

entries.name: The Art of Symbiosis
entries.text:
A trance-imagining of Darkness sweet like honey, a life refracted through another's eyes like splintered light. It leaves behind an imperfectly translated data fragment to mark its passing.

…Anyway, beloved sibling, if you want to catch me while I'm still wearing this (form/body?), you'll need to come home in the next couple of cycles. I don't mind if you'd prefer to wait until I'm down by the [untranslatable] among our ancestors, but you might get a different sort of chat!

I'm excited about it, genuinely. I still hear from our parents, from our great-parents, distantly in my night-trances. And there are those nectar-made moments—you know the ones, when you turn your thoughts to the Darkness and just listen, and the long sum of Qugu history graven there reflects dark-comforting advice.

I have lived out my life with the tenebrous warmth of our ancestors over me like a (cloak/atmosphere?) between us and nothingness. It's different—it's distant. I've drunk of the nectar a few times in the last cycles, and I touch briefly that concurrence of us all, and more and more, I think it is time to be part of it. I want to know the truths our ancestors keep close, and it is my turn to guide the future's children.

I know we argued the last time we spoke about it. You thought I was moving too fast toward aging-metamorphosis, but really I just think you've been away from home too long. Don't take it as my urging to get on with the next stage of your life, just take it as…

I miss you.

Funny, isn't it? How can you miss someone when you know they're always in the Dark? I close my eyes, and in the warm nest-hide of sleep, I know you are real and happy and out there on some other part of the world, far from the river, far from the [untranslatable] where our ancestors (dream/exist) together. But it isn't the same as having you near, knowing your truth is under the same stars. Being able to simply turn my (head/face/bloom?) and ask for your opinion.

Dear sibling, come home. Live in my house, and let me (dream/exist) close to you again, whether in this shape or the new one I will take on. I will not be the same, but which of us ever is? You are not the same as you were as a child, either.

No matter the form of the existence, I will love you.
entries.text_zh:
一个如蜂蜜般香甜的暗影幻象，通过他人眼睛折射出的像碎裂之光的活物。它留下了一块未完全翻译的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

…不管怎样，亲爱的同胞，如果你想趁我还在这个（形体/身体？）中的时候见到我，就得在接下来的几个周期里回家。如果你愿意等到我倒在我们祖先中的[无法翻译]旁，我也不介意，但你得到的聊天方式可能会大为不同！

我为此感到兴奋，真的。在我的睡梦恍惚中，我还能隐约听到我们的父母，我们的曾祖父母的消息。还有那些甘露造就的时刻——你知道的，当你把你的思想转向暗影，就这么倾听的时候，镌刻在那里的曲谷历史的悠长总和表达了黑暗安慰的忠告。

我一生都生活在祖先给我的阴暗温暖之中，就像在我们和虚无之间的某种（披风/大气层？）。这不一样——这是遥远的。在过去的几个周期里，我喝过几次甘露，我短暂地触到了我们所有人的共识，而且我越来越认为，是时候参与其中了。我想知道我们的祖先所一直遵循的真理，现在轮到我来指引未来的孩子们了。

我知道上一次我们谈论这件事时我们争论过。你认为我老化变质得太快了，但其实我只是觉得你离家太久了。别把这话当成我催促你继续下一阶段的生活，就把它理解成…

我想你了。

真有意思，不是吗？当你知道他们总是深处黑暗中时，你怎么能想念他们呢？我闭上眼睛，在温暖的睡眠巢穴中，我知道你是真实的，快乐的，在世界的某个地方，远离河流，远离我们的祖先一起（梦想/存在）的[无法翻译]的地方。但这和有你在身边，知道你的真相共处在同一片星空下还是不一样的。能够只要转动我的（头/脸/花朵？），就能征求你的意见。

亲爱的同胞，回家吧。住在我的房子里，让我（梦想/存在）再次靠近你吧，无论是以这一形态还是我将会呈现的新形态？你也和小时候不一样了。

无论以何种形式存在，我都会爱你。

entries.name: The Dark Below
entries.text:
A nightmare of Luna, of that which waits below, of disaster and wreckage and inexplicable warm camaraderie tangled together. It leaves behind a journal page with familiar handwriting to mark its passage.

Six of us went down into the Pit, and only one crawled out. That is how it was, and that is how it is.

I have not wanted to look back at that time, but lately it has become prudent to examine what is and is not known of the Darkness. 
I know Darkness. I have been trying to distinguish the Darkness from the framework the Hive use to shape it for long and long, but they are deeply intertwined. The Voice in the Darkness answers some things, but not all.

I think: The Great Disaster. What did we know? Was there anything besides terror and the swords of the Hive?

I think: What was in the Pit?
 
The Lunar Pyramid was here all along, as we now know. Since the Collapse, its Darkness has seeped into Luna, into all that surround it. Could one write a treatise on the subspecies of Hive, on the differences written in the various plates of chitin? Have the Hive been here long enough, overrunning our Luna, that a recognizable change in them has evolved?

…I digress. There were times, deep in that dark pit, when I thought: Ah, Sai means to break left. And then she would, knives like lightning, as true as if she herself had told me she would. Or: Ah, there is Omar, beside me, and though he was not, his presence rang comforting in my ears like struck metal.

Synergy, I thought. The closeness that combat creates. We were pinned together in the dark, and so we learned to read each other perfectly, for to do otherwise would have been to die.

To die sooner.

Anecdata? Perhaps. Always the quiet voice that says to temper my expectations, that it is wishful thinking to imagine that they lie beside my heart, instead of Nightmares floating in my wake. But in all this time, all of this lingering, I am surer of what I felt then. Not only necessity; not only the edge of the blade.

I know more of Darkness now. It is not violence. It is something more: something that hums and flows and resonates, knife or song by equal measure.

I have not been able to bear the sound of silence since that time. Too long among the screaming Hive, I thought once. Now…

Cacophony is almost a comfort.
entries.text_zh:
一个月球的梦魇，一个等待在深渊之下的梦魇，灾难和残骸以及莫名温暖的情谊纠缠在一起的梦魇。它留下了一张字迹熟悉的日记页来标记它的逝去。

我们六个人进入竞技场…只有一个人活着出来。过去是这样，现在也是这样。

我不想回顾那段时光，但最近，审视暗影中什么是已知的，什么是未知的，已是一种明智的选择。 
我了解暗影。我一直试图将暗影与邪魔族用来塑造它的框架区分开，但它们深深地交织在一起。暗影之声回答了一些问题，但并非所有。

我在想：大灾难。我们知道些什么？除了恐怖和邪魔族的刀剑，还有什么吗？

我在想：巨坑里曾有什么？
 
我们现在知道，月球金字塔一直都在这里。自从大崩溃以来，它的暗影渗透进了月球，渗透进了它周围的一切。有人能写篇关于邪魔族亚种的论文，来探究不同甲壳质板的差异吗？邪魔族在这里的时间是否足够长，超越了我们月球的负荷，以至于他们中已经发生了明显的变化？

…我跑题了。有时，在那个黑暗深坑里，我会想：啊，赛打算向左突破。然后她就会那样做，刀剑如同闪电，像她自己告诉了我她会那样做般真实。或者：啊，奥马尔就在我身边，虽然他之前不在，但他的存在就像敲击过的金属一样宽慰着我的耳朵。

我想这就是协同吧。战斗创造出的亲密感。我们被困在黑暗中，所以我们学会了完美地感知对方，因为不这样做就会死去。

更早地死去。

只是臆测？也许吧。总是有个平静的声音说要放平期望，想象他们在我的心里，而不是在我身后漂浮的梦魇，却发现这只是我的一厢情愿。但是在这段时间里，那挥之不去的种种，让我更加确信我当时的感受。不仅是出于必要；不仅是刀剑利刃。

我现在更了解暗影了。它不是暴力。它不止于此：它是某种嗡嗡作响、涓涓流动并产生共鸣的东西，可以是刀剑，也可以是颂歌。

从那以后，我再也无法忍受寂静之声。在尖叫的邪魔族中呆得太久了，我曾这样想。现在…

嘈杂声几乎成了一种慰藉。

entries.name: Brass Gardeners
entries.text:
A specter of the Black Garden, rich with the sweetness of flowers and the stink of radiolaria. It leaves behind a delicate data-lattice to mark its passing.

Garden state: neutral

garden&&gardeners==root&&branch==leaf&&flower

//intrinsic, inextricable, inescapable

anomaly ++

anomaly One = leaf|invasive;

Garden state: active (gardeners attend)

case Irrecoverable:

if (irretrievable injury (garden&&gardeners)) && (threat persistence) then (escalation. escalation.)

anomaly status: present, tracked, new. No archive referent. simulation: failed.

Damage: 0.3332%. Recoverable. Danger: Recovery projection irresolvable. Repeat. Repeat. Set: irresolvable == irrecoverable == irretrievable

anomaly ++

anomaly Zero = infinite|witness;

archive data retrieved. Zero = infinite|witness == (a seed was planted here.) Recorded referent: "Black|Heart"

Zero : seed :: One : DANGER

[SIMULATION BREAKING. VISIBILITY NARROW. FRACTALS DISINTEGRATING.]

anomaly Zero, absent. anomaly One, DANGER remaining.

Garden state: acting (gardeners in unison)

extirpate (anomaly One)

//There is a majestic thorn. The anomaly is gone. The garden is peaceful.

//It is known|seen|predicted that a primary function of irresolvable|irrecoverable presences is to trample.

Flowers growing / damage repairing / threat unresolved

Function called: escalation. Iteration.

Function: winnow. Function: simplify. Function: flatten.

//The first defense is offense.
entries.text_zh:
一个充满了花朵芳香与放射虫恶臭的黑暗花园的幽灵。它留下了一块精密的数据晶格来标记它的逝去。

entries.name: Dark Glass
entries.text:
A reverie of a loyal Ghost, changed and quiet but always steadfast. It leaves behind a gently glowing data fragment to mark its passing.

We were in the Garden, and I was going to die, and then I didn't. I watched my Guardian speak to himself, and not himself: a being that wore his shape, spoke with his voice, and offered him salvation. Salvation in the form of forgetting. I didn't know Darkness could do that. I don't think any of us really understood it.

And where did that leave me?

A loose end, that's what. Any reasoning being would have spotted that; taking someone's memory does no good at all if they have someone right there to tell them all about it. I don't know if my Guardian thought about that. The mirror of him definitely did.
 
I tried to run.

A grasp from out of the Darkness caught me.

I lost something there, like I was taken apart and put back together with a part missing. Like I was really nothing more than a machine, like the Traveler's blessing and my own bright heart meant nothing at all more than copper and glass. And when I thought about anything again, anything that wasn't an infinite abyss with no stars, my Guardian and I were outside the Black Garden. He had lost them, and I couldn't tell him, and nothing was the same.

I don't speak any more, and he doesn't know why. I cannot even speak to explain—I don't know where my voice is, or even if I want to speak at all. Maybe it took that, the memory of my voice.

I still remember what happened. I wonder why that thing that pretended to be my Guardian didn't just kill me or change me further—make of me something broken and unknowing. I don't know if it understood that I love my Guardian, despite everything. Maybe it counted on that, that I would always bring him back even if I had nothing else in me but that.

I think the voice, that wrong presence in the Darkness, thought that forgetting his team would make him malleable, but it's the other way around, really. Without them, my Guardian is impossible to shift aside. Even for me.

And that power in the Garden, the one that turned them all on each other… I have my suspicions. I'm an honest Ghost, but.

I've known a lot of con artists.

The power and the offer, the curse and the salvation. Were they all the same in the end? The same thing, the same Voice in the Darkness?

If nothing else, I know at least that thing, that grasp which caught me, isn't the same as the Darkness itself. Otherwise, I'd never be able to bear my Guardian's touch. But: I can settle in his hand and, sometimes… sometimes we still understand each other, like meaning moves from me to him without the need for words at all.

We're different. But we're alive.

It's enough.
entries.text_zh:
一个曾发生过改变、沉默寡言，但始终坚定不移的忠诚机灵的遐想。它留下了一块微微发光的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

我们当时在花园里，我快要死了，但我还没死。我看着我的守护者对自己说着话，却并非自言自语：一个以其之形现身，以其之音发声，并向他提出救赎的存在。以遗忘为形式的救赎。我不知道暗影还能这么做。我想我们都没有真正理解它。

那么我呢？

一个潜在的麻烦。任何逻辑思考的生物都会发现这一点；如果有人能告诉他们一切，拿走记忆就没有丝毫意义。我不知道我的守护者是否想过这一点。他的镜像考虑到了。
 
我试图逃跑。

暗影中伸出的一只手抓住了我。

我在那里失去了一些东西，就像是我被拆分开，然后又被装回去，只是少了某个部件。就像我真的只不过是一台机器，就像旅行者的祝福和我自己明亮的心只不过是铜和玻璃罢了。而当我再次想到任何事情，任何不是没有星星的无限深渊的事情时，我的守护者和我已在黑暗花园外面。他失去了记忆，我无法告诉他，一切都变了。

我沉默不语，而他不明所以。我甚至无法说话解释——我不知道我的声音在哪里，也不知我还是否想要说话。也许它带走了我对声音的记忆。

我仍然记得发生了什么。我想知道为什么那个假装是我守护者的东西没有杀了我或者进一步改变我——让我变得支离破碎，一无所知。我不知道它是否明白我爱我的守护者，无论发生什么。也许它指望着这一点，指望着我会一直让他复活，即使我除此之外一无所有。

我认为那个声音，那个暗影中败坏的存在，以为忘记他的团队会让他变得易受操纵，但事实恰恰相反。真的。没有他们，我的守护者就不可能转换阵营。即使是为了我。

而花园里那股让他们互相背叛的力量的身份…我有自己的猜测。我是个诚实的机灵，但是。

我认识许多骗子。

力量和提议，诅咒和救赎。它们最终都是一样的吗？同一个东西，同一个暗影之声？

至少，我知道那个东西，那只抓住我的手，并不是暗影本身。否则，我将永远无法承受我守护者的触摸。但是：我可以在他的手里停下来，而有时…有时我们仍然能理解对方，就像意义从我身上转移到他身上，根本无需言语。

我们改变了。但我们还活着。

这就够了。

entries.name: Irae
entries.text:
A waking dream that appears by night, singing slyly like starlight. It leaves behind a crystallized data fragment to mark its passing.

I am diminished. I know this. It behooves a Queen to be honest with herself, even if such truths are hidden from advisors and subjects. Leaving the Distributary was not a mistake—and, in fact, it was the only possibility, for the expanding wake of the Collapse must someday find that safe haven too—but there are days I regret it.
 
Celestial bodies still spin. Most of them.

I touched the mind—the being—of that terrible distant force but once, and that was more than sufficient. Even I, Awoken and Queen, strength of my people, felt inextricably mortal in that moment.

I have stared into hard vacuum with nothing but my will to keep the breath in my lungs, and never feared a moment. This?

It disquiets me. I should not be afraid. I must not embrace fear. So I turn it over, again and again, picking through the pieces of that one fragmented impression for something more. To look at my own weakness, time after time. To understand something is to drain the killing fear out of it. That which is known can be disassembled.

(There was a version of me that was grateful… no.)

Yet the more I analyze, the more I ponder, the less I understand. A cacophony, an overwhelming weight of presence and thought and intent. A person, but not a person. More than that. Imagine if that first place where we the Awoken came to be had been nothing but screaming chaos.

In the noise, in the oppressive weight, I learn pieces as delicate as spiderwebs, as scattered as stars. I lay them out along each other in my thoughts. Here is purpose—not a singular thesis, but the idea of purpose, vicious and brilliant and driven as I ever was. Here is a shape—I see it as a sharpness, like a starless cutout against a distant galaxy, made clear in the negative space. The thoughts of the Hive, I might guess, but it is not quite the same. Purpose and sharpness are discrete from each other here. Darkness, and the sword—no, Darkness BUT the sword.

Here is a stillness—I breathe, and it shatters, but the idea of that perfect quiet ending remains, lingers into dreams. I think sometimes if I dream long enough, I will understand this Witness better, the Voice not of the Darkness, yet in it. But I do not have the time to spend in dreaming.

To understand this listless scavenger that claws through our world and cherishes the destruction it leaves as transcendent…

Risky, as all valuable things are.

I know one other thing from the Witness, garnered in those bare moments I touched it. Not a why or a how, no home or treasures to point at weakness. Only this:

Beneath all else, that being cradles rage enough to burn the stars themselves to cinders.
entries.text_zh:
一个在夜里出现，像星光一样狡黠歌唱的清明梦。它留下了一块结晶的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

我被削弱了。我深知这一点。女王理应对自己诚实，即使这样的真相需瞒着顾问和臣民。离开两仪界并非是个错误，事实上，它是唯一的选择，因为大崩溃后不断扩大的余波总有一天也会找到避风港——但有的时候我也会后悔。
 
天体仍然在旋转。大多如此。

那可怕的遥远力量，我只触碰过一次它的思维——它的存在，而那已绰绰有余。即使是我，觉醒者和女王，支撑我的人民的力量，在那一刻都感到了无法逃脱的死亡。

我曾凝视着坚硬的真空，仅凭意志维持肺中的呼吸，未曾有一瞬间感到害怕。而这个？

这让我感到不安。我不应该害怕。我不能拥抱恐惧。所以我反复地翻看，从那个支离破碎印象的碎片中寻找更多的东西。一次又一次地审视自己的弱点。理解某物就是要从中滤干杀戮的恐惧。已知之物皆可被拆解。

（我曾一度心存感激…不。）

然而，我分析得越多，思考得越多，我理解的就越少。一种刺耳的声音，一种势不可挡的存在、思想和意图。是一个人，却又不是一个人。不止如此。想象一下，要是我们觉醒者形成的第一个地方，除了尖叫的混乱外别无他物。

在喧嚣中，在重压中，我了解到了像蛛网一样纤细，像星星一样散落的碎片。我把它们一一列在我的思想里。这就是使命——不是单一的论点，而是使命的概念，像曾经的我一样残暴、聪颖、有干劲。这是个形状——我把它看作是个锐利的轮廓，就像遥远的星系里一处没有星星的切口，在负空间中清晰可见。是邪魔族的想法，要我猜的话，但又不完全一样。使命和锐利在这里是彼此分开的。暗影，和刀剑——不，暗影而非刀剑。

这里是一片寂静——我呼吸着，它破碎了，但那种完美的平静结局的想法依然存在，萦绕在梦中。有时我想，如果梦的时间足够长的话，我就能更好地理解这个见证者，并非暗影之声，而是处在其中的声音。但是我没有时间去做梦。

去理解这个在我们的世界中爬行的倦怠拾荒者，珍惜它留下的破坏，视之为超然…

太冒险了，就像所有宝贵的事物一样。

在我接触它的那些仅有的瞬间，我从见证者那里了解到了另一件事。没有原因或方式，没有家园或宝藏来指向弱点。只有这个：

在这一切之下，那存在孕育着足以把群星烧成灰烬的怒火。

entries.name: The Cave
entries.text:
A delusion of a being long dead, an idea of living only to serve, only for one purpose. It leaves behind a sharp-edged data fragment to mark its passing.

There is a conflict in me, O Witness, that unsettles your weapon, my self. Why is it that you allow flawed understandings of your great work to persist in all those who serve you, even in your Disciples? Every one of us seems to have some different conception of your Final Shape.

I do not need reassurance in my own comprehension. Only to understand what purpose it serves that you have chosen such disparate servants to carry out your will.

Is it a simple answer? Perhaps none who serve you have the capacity to grasp your vision. And so, rather than waste more of your time and attention on explaining something they will never hold, it is enough that they act as you will. The Witch and her Hive carving single-mindedness out of the cloth of the universe, that whispering Nightmare seeking the fullest gamut of existence, the Upender destroying all differentiation. Shadows on the wall.

In this case, it would be hubris to think I have understood your work, that I alone among your Disciples have grasped what purpose it is we serve. All of us must see darkly reflected.

But there is relief in simplification. There is kindness in winnowing. So then, why is this proliferation permitted?

The shadows, showing the truth by their casting.

Perhaps it is enough to simply trust that we are weapons in your hand, O Witness—even if we cannot see the perfect shape of your plan, we serve it by your wielding of us. Each Disciple has come to be only by your will, and so that incomprehension is also in your making. You ask for trust, and obedience, and promise that whatever you do, whatever finality you achieve, will suit each of your followers perfectly.

Your Final Shape will be a hundred promises kept. I have seen the reflections of it through all of we Disciples, through the tracks you leave in the universe, a truth understood through the shadows it casts.

There: I have resolved the conflict within my thoughts, and I am at peace again. Once more, I am only your violence and nothing more.

The Final Shape will realize us as we strive.
entries.text_zh:
一个早已死去之人的错觉，一种活着只是为了效力、只有一个使命的想法。它留下了一块锐利的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

见证者啊，我内心有一种冲突，它让您的武器，也就是我自己心神不宁。为什么您允许所有效忠于您的人，甚至是您的门徒，对您伟大的工作存在错误的理解？我们每个人似乎对您的终焉之形都有着不同的概念。

我自己的理解无需消除疑虑。我只想知道您选择如此差异化的仆从来执行您的意志是为了什么。

答案很简单吗？也许没有一个效忠您的人有能力领会您的远见。因此，与其浪费您更多的时间和注意力去解释一些他们永远不会理解的东西，让他们按照您的意志行动就足够了。女巫和她的邪魔族在宇宙的布料上雕刻出从一而终的忠贞，那个低语的梦魇则在寻求存在的最大界域，翻料机摧毁着所有的差异。墙上的阴影。

如果是这样，认为我理解您的工作，认为我是您的门徒中唯一一个明白我们效忠使命的人，就太狂妄了。我们所有人看到的都必是黑暗的倒影。

但简化也算让人宽慰。扬场也算一种仁慈。那么，为什么要允许这种增殖呢？

那些阴影，通过它们的投射展现真相。

见证者啊，也许只要相信我们是您手中的武器就足够了——即使我们看不到您计划的完美形态，我们也会通过您对我们的操控而效力于此。每一个门徒都出于您的意志而存在，所以这种不理解也是出自您手。您要求信任和服从，还有承诺，无论您做什么，无论您达成什么样的终局，都将完美满足您每一位追随者的需要。

您的终焉之形将是百个承诺的兑现。通过我们所有的门徒，通过您在宇宙中留下的足迹，通过它投下的阴影来理解的真理，我看到了它的倒影。

好了：我已解决我思想中的冲突，我再次获得了平静。又一次，我只不过是您使用暴力的手段，仅此而已。

我们努力实现终焉之形，它也终会实现我们。

entries.name: Meaning
entries.text:
A dream of a metaphor made starkly, an allegory discussed in study of ontology, in Darkness not unkind. It leaves behind a warped, barely-real data fragment to mark its passing.

There is a voice that echoes across the Darkness, and it asks this question: what is the purpose of it all?

And there is another voice that calls back and says: listen, I will tell you a purpose. I will tell you of a Final Shape.

Look: there are a hundred gildings for this story. It comes down to one key matter. Beings in suffering crave purpose to carry them through. The tyrant consumed by ennui or the disenfranchised struggling simply to survive—it is the state of mind, the pain which cries out: give me a reason I should suffer so!

Let us speak of power and choices.

A man comes to a crossroads and asks of the sky, "Which road shall I take?" There is no answer from the sky, nor the wind, nor the earth beneath his feet. But another wanderer on the road, coming from behind and hearing the question, says, "I know the way. You should take the dexter road."

If the man agrees, he puts himself in the wanderer's power, ceding his own choices for the implicit promise that this is the correct road, the safe road. And if he disagrees?

Let us say that the wanderer draws a knife.

The man may therefore be made to take the dexter road. But now if the knife goes away, the man will certainly flee. And perhaps even if the knife remains, the man may tire of being threatened and decide the risk is worth fleeing. In this way, the wanderer erodes their own power.

If the wanderer says, "The wind has said that you should take the road of my choosing," will the man accept the choice made for him?

And if the wanderer says, "Behold, I have seen that the meaning of suffering lies along the dexter road," will the man give away his own power for longer?

Is it not easier to accept the guidance of a stranger when the path ahead is unknown?
entries.text_zh:
一段在不失友善的暗影之中，赤裸裸的隐喻之梦，一则本体论研究中的寓言。它留下了一块扭曲、几乎不真实的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

有一个声音在暗影中回荡，它问了这个问题：这一切的使命何在？

而另一个声音则回应说道：听着，我会告诉你一个使命。我会告诉你一个终焉之形。

看，这个故事有一百种虚饰的讲法。归结为一个关键问题。处于苦难中的人们渴望能有使命来帮助他们度过难关。被倦怠所吞噬的暴君或是被剥夺了权利的人，仅仅为了生存而挣扎——这是一种心灵状态，是在呼喊的痛苦：给我承受如此折磨的理由！

我们来谈谈力量和选择吧。

有个人来到十字路口，向天空问道：“我应该走哪条路？”天空没有给出回应、风和他脚下的大地也默不作声。但路上的另一个流浪者，从后面走来，听到这个问题，说道，“我知道怎么走。你该走右边这条路。”

要是这个人同意了，他就会把自己置于流浪者的力量之中，放弃自己的选择换取一个隐含的承诺：这是正确的路，安全的道路。但如果他不同意呢？

让我们假设羁客拔出了一把刀。

这个人因此有可能会被迫走上右边的道路。但现在如果刀没了，这个人一定会逃跑。也许即使那把刀还在，他也可能厌倦了被威胁，决定冒险逃跑。这样，羁客就削弱了自己的力量。

如果羁客说，“风说你应该走我选择的路”，这个人会接受为他做出的选择吗？

而如果羁客说，“瞧，我已经看到苦难的意义就在右边的道路之中”，这个人会继续放弃自己的力量吗？

前途未卜之时，接受一个陌生人的指引不是更容易吗？

entries.name: Winnowing
entries.text:
A dream of a friendly conversation with someone impossible to see, cloaked in shadows. It leaves behind an impossible data fragment to mark its passing.

Here is what a flower knows.

(The fact that a flower may know anything is a conceit that will have to be accepted as metaphor, but to constantly qualify into perfect precision wears thin, does it not? So, here is what a collection of chloroplasts and pigment can know.)

The direction of the sun.

The presence of the rain.

The tangle of the roots.

The distress of another plant.

The hands of the gardener, whether they prune or transplant or crush.

A flower cannot know much else. But the reality of the garden is vast and wild. A flower knows not the fence; a flower knows not the footpath. And yet there is an infinite cosmic garden, which is not any less real simply because the flower cannot possibly comprehend it…

Let us try this again. Stop me if you've heard this one: A gardener and a winnower sit down to play a game outside of time and creation. Yes?

Yes. Then we're agreed. The metaphor stands. Let us iterate.

A gardener and a winnower set out their chairs and play a game of flowers. The flowers know only that they grow or wither, struggle or flourish. Sometimes, they are touched by one hand or the other, and that influence is the closest they will know of the divine.

A flower and a flower spread their leaves to the sun above. (Remember that the sun is also a metaphor: a thing said beautifully, winnowed down to poetry, when the truth is too vast to put in words at all.) They jostle for space, each competing to be the pinnacle of their shape. One flourishes. One withers. Is it the fault of the flower or the fault of its position?

A gardener and a winnower sit down to play a game called Possibility. This is a game about a garden, which is to say that it is also a game about flowers, just as a game about a living being must also be a game about organs and bacteria.

A gardener and a winnower collaborate to create a protein. Whose hand is it in the design, that shortens one life to extend the rest?

It is the winnower that discovers the first knife, but it is not done without the gardener. This, too, is a tradition: a knife does not come to exist without something that must be cut. A woody stem, a colored petal, a vital vessel. The first victims of the blade.

All of these are true.

All of these are false, for metaphor simplifies as the knife does. It pares incalculable concepts into shapes your wrinkly little brains can comprehend. The weight of billions and the simple curve of a planet give you pause, and how then are you to be expected to grasp the forces that created your nth-removed creator?

So the stories woven with utmost delicacy in and around the falsehoods are, after it all, true. There was never any option for the knife to not exist in the garden: it was only ever a matter of time and opportunity.

And as for the shape of the knife itself—

No. That is enough.

I will tell you of gardens.

They are domesticated things, made in a form. As soon as something is called a garden, it is shaped. The plants require the hand of a gardener, for they have become weak and dependent on tender care. They require the hand of a winnower, to cut away the dross, for they are too incapable to do it themselves. In absence of a hand, either the flowers themselves must rise up to wield the knife, or the garden will resolve to meaningless wilderness.

You will say, "But there are plants that can walk! There are seeds that must be scorched by fire to know growth! Existence is more complex than a simple dichotomy between growth and withering, and there is more in heaven and on earth than is dreamt of in this philosophy!"

And I will tell you, clearly:

There can be no gardens without knives.
entries.text_zh:
一段与隐匿在阴影之中，看不清的人友好交谈的幻梦。它留下了一块匪夷所思的数据碎片来标记它的逝去。

以下是一朵花所知道的事情。

（一朵花可以知道任何事情，这是一种只能接受为隐喻的措辞，但不断达到完美的精度是很难的，不是吗？那么就改成，以下是叶绿体和色素的集合所能知道的事情。）

太阳的方向。

雨水的存在。

根茎的缠结。

另一株植物的忧虑。

园丁的双手，无论它们是在修剪、移植还是捣碎。

一朵花没法知道更多事情了。但花园的现实是广阔而荒凉的。花不可知篱笆；花不可知小径。然而，有一个无限的宇宙花园，花朵虽然无法理解，但它依然真实地存在…

让我们再试一次。如果你听过，就叫我停下：一个园丁和一个扬场工坐下来玩了一个超脱于时间和造物之外的游戏。听过吗？

好。那我们就达成一致了。这个比喻站得住脚。我们来复述一下。

一个园丁和一个扬场工把他们的椅子摆好，玩起了花朵游戏。花朵只知道自己在生长或枯萎，挣扎或繁盛。有时，它们会被一两手触碰，这种影响是它们所知的最接近神性的感受。

一朵花和另一朵花向头顶的太阳舒展自己的叶子。（要记住，太阳也是一种隐喻：当真理博大到无法用语言表达时，就可以用优美的言辞，提炼成诗歌。）它们互相争抢着生存空间，都想成为自己形态的巅峰。一朵繁盛了。一朵枯萎了。这是花的错还是其位置的错？

一个园丁和一个扬场工坐下来玩一个叫做“可能性”的游戏。这是一个关于花园的游戏，也是关于花朵的游戏；正如一个关于生物的游戏必定与器官和细菌游戏有关一样。

一个园丁和一个扬场工合作创造了一种蛋白质。这设计是出自谁手，能缩短某个生命来延长其余的生命？

是扬场工发现了第一把刀，但没有园丁是做不到的。这，也是一个传统：没有必须切割的东西，刀就不会存在。木质的根茎，彩色的花瓣，重要的导管。刀锋的第一批受害者。

所有这些都是真的。

所有这些都是假的，因为隐喻就像刀一样被简化了。它把无法计算的概念简化成你那满是皱纹的小脑袋所能理解的形态。数十亿的重量和行星的简单曲线已让你无法理解，你怎么可能掌握创造你的第n个已故造物主的力量呢？

因此，在谎言之中或其周围精心编织的故事，终究，是真实的。刀根本不可能不存在于花园里：这只是时间和机会的问题。

而至于刀本身的形态——

不。这就足够了。

我会告诉你关于花园的事。

它们是被驯化的东西，被塑造成某种形式。某件事物一旦被称为花园，它就塑形了。植物需要园丁的手，因为它们已经变得虚弱，需要悉心照料。它们需要扬场工的手来把糟粕丢弃，因为它们自己太无能而没法亲自动手。要是没有一只手，要么花朵必须自己奋起来挥舞刀子，要么花园就会变成毫无意义的荒野。

你会说，“但是有植物会走路！有种子必须经火烧焦才知道生长！存在比生长和枯萎之间的简单二分法更为复杂，天地间有很多东西是这种哲学想象不到的！”

而我会明确告诉你：

没有刀就没有花园。

entries.name: Strand Log I
entries.text:
…but there is no point in lingering on my restriction from front-line efforts. Rather, I am dedicating my efforts to the understanding of this peculiar force the Guardian has stumbled into.

It is unknown to our local hosts, so they have been of limited help. Green energy returns few helpful results in accessible Vanguard databases—there are some limited notes on Weapons of Sorrow, of course, and Hive magics have a distinctive yellowish-green hue, but the quality of the visible effect is different. As is, naturally, the effect.

But, all the same, it is not a power of the Light. Their Ghost was certain about that. 

To sum up what is known:

• This power manifests with a specific symbol-set: green, thread or strings, knots. It is worth noting that there never seems to be a single thread, but rather a collection of them, whether in parallel or in tangle.

• This power carries an impressive capacity for destruction, but causes a sort of rebound or exhaustion, the nature of which is not fully clear. It has not yet appeared lethal to the self, but it is being wielded by a Guardian fully empowered. Lethality means little in that context if it does not strike the Ghost as well, which this does not.

• The Guardian is the only one who has wielded this power to date. One sample is insufficient to draw full conclusions about the capacity required in a wielder. We certainly know by now that no existing power of Light is required to use a power of Darkness, only willingness to participate in the required rituals…

• The Guardian reported a sense of connection, a perception of the greater whole. I include this as relevant, more than likely related to the concept of multiple strings.

• We do not yet know enough.

The enemies here on Neptune have put significant effort into inhibiting known paracausal powers. This new one may be precisely what is needed to gain an upper hand and keep it. But something uncontrolled and unknown, the nature of which is not yet fully understood, is unwise to wield indiscriminately.

I could return to someplace the source of this energy has been reported and seek to touch it myself, but… I hesitate. I do not know why.
 
Practical study via the Guardian first. Ontological and paracausal study once the current trouble has been dealt with.
entries.text_zh:
…可是纠结于限制我进行一线工作是没有意义的。我宁可致力于理解守护者无意中发现的这种特殊力量。

我们的本地主人对此一无所知，所以他们能提供的帮助有限。绿色能源在可访问的先锋数据库中也没返回多少有用的结果——当然，在忧愁武器上有一些有限的注释，邪魔族魔法有着独特的黄绿色调，但视觉效果的质量不一样。很自然，效果也是不一样。

但无论如何，它都不是一种光能之力。其机灵对此深信不疑。 

总结下已知的情况：

• 这种力量以特定的符号集展现：绿色、丝线或绳线、缠结。值得注意的是，似乎从来没有出现过单根丝线，而总是它们的集合，无论是并行还是纠缠在一起。

• 这种力量具有十分惊人的破坏能力，但会引起某种反弹或衰竭，其性质尚不完全清楚。它还未显示出对使用者的致命性，但它正受到一位完全赋能的守护者操控。在这种情况下，杀伤力没什么意义，除非它能同时打击机灵，而它确实做不到。

• 守护者是迄今为止唯一操控过这种力量的人。一个样本不足以得出关于操控者所需能力的完整结论。我们现在无疑清楚，使用暗影力量并不需要现有的光能力量，只需要愿意参加必要的仪式…

• 守护者上报了一种联系的感觉，一种对更大整体的感知。我将其纳为相关项，很有可能与多条绳线的概念相关。

• 我们的了解还不够深。

海王星上的敌人付出了巨大的努力抑制已知的超因果力量。这种新的力量可能正是占据并保持优势所需要的。但是，在尚未完全了解其性质的情况下，任意地操控不受控制且未知的东西，并不是明智之举。

我可以回到这个上报过的能量源头所在地，尝试亲自去触摸它，但…我犹豫了。我不知道为什么。
 
先通过守护者进行实践研究吧。等目前的问题得到解决后，再进行本体论和超因果研究。

entries.name: Carding
entries.text:
Shadow Legion moving through the streets. Boxy formation, a few scouts ahead. Two heavy hitters—Colossi. Even in silhouette against Neomuna's bright lights, the shapes of their cannons are distinctive, weighing down their steps and progress.

The Titan steps out to block their way. There is a power here—a place where something new and vibrant runs close to the skin of the world, so close she could just reach out and touch it.

So she does.

The brilliant city wakes up. Potential and connection string a network of understanding along the streets, and she understands everything. Understands how the scouts will come out of the next intersection down to try to flank her, understands the movement of the Shadow Legion's formation, how one soldier and the next are all connected. A beautiful dance of the inextricably linked.

She wraps those links around her fists and charges into the fray. They scatter like pins, like mice with the cat among them. It's perfect. She tears through Legionary after Legionary, catches a hum along the threads that tells her to move—spins a full hundred-eighty degrees and arches back, swipes out, balletic and instinctive. A Colossus falls.

And then she thinks: How did she know to do that?

Now, she is trying too hard to anticipate, feels warning and motion coming from all sides and reacts—but consciously, in the realm where she has to think too hard about every move she makes, puts her half a second behind. Step here and punch there, and the threads are humming, harmony becoming warning becoming discord as the Titan realizes she doesn't know which way to leap.

Fire snakes toward her, and a heavy shield comes around, and all the threads slip away.

She misses a few moments in oblivion. The next thing she knows, her Ghost is hunkered close, a vibrant touch of Light pulling her up to a whole body, a hale mind. The sense of potential still thrums there, a heartbeat under the surface, a promise in the net of battle.

Desperately, the Titan scrabbles for it again, but strands break in her grasp—the Legion is too close, and she wants too much, too fast. It's going to take too long to breathe and find again that perfect harmony she had. To say nothing of reaching for the Light—her nerves are rattled, her mind blank.

The Colossus remaining charges up his cannon. Her Ghost bumps against her helm, and she takes the only action she can think of: she flees, Ghost cupped in her hand and her favorite sword melted useless on the city street behind them.
entries.text_zh:
暗影军团穿过街道。四四方方的队形，前面有几个侦察兵。两个重击手装甲兵。即使是在内欧姆那明亮灯光的映衬下，他们大炮的形状依然别具特色，重压着他们的脚步和进程。

泰坦走出来挡住了他们的去路。这里有一种力量——全新的、充满活力的东西与世界的肌肤紧密相连，近得她伸手就能触及。

她确实这么做了。

明亮的城市苏醒了。潜能和联系沿着街道串起了一张理解的网络，她理解了一切。理解了侦察兵如何从下一个十字路口出来试图包抄她，理解了暗影军团的队形移动，一个士兵和下一个士兵是如何联系在一起的。一段万千链环的美妙舞蹈。

她把那些链环缠绕在她的拳头上，冲进了战斗。他们像大头针一样散开，好似一群被猫冲散的老鼠。完美。她撕裂了一个又一个的军团士兵，听到丝线上传来的嗡嗡声，告诉她该移动了——旋转一百八十度，向后拱身，滑动扫击，芭蕾舞般唯美而又出乎本能。一个装甲兵倒下了。

随后她心想：她是怎么知道该这么做的？

现在，她开始过于努力地去预测，有意地感知来自四面八方的警告和移动并做出反应。必须对自己每一步行动都仔细思考，让她慢了半秒钟。踏足这里，击打那里，丝线嗡嗡作响，和谐声变成警告，化作不协和音，泰坦意识到她不知道该往哪边跳了。

火焰蜿蜒着向她逼近，厚重的护盾包围了她，所有的丝线都溜走了。

她失去了随后一些时间的记忆。反应过来时，她的机灵正降到附近，一股充满活力的光能之触将她拉进一具完整的身体，一个健全的思维里。潜能的感觉仍在那里回响，表面之下的心跳，战网之中的预示。

绝望之中，泰坦再次摸索着寻找，但她手中的丝线断了——军团士兵离她太近，而她想要的太多，太快。她需要很长时间才能呼吸并再次找到她曾有过的那种完美和谐。更不用说伸手去够光能了——她神经紧张，头脑一片空白。

剩下的装甲兵在为他的大炮充能。她的机灵碰撞着她的头盔，她采取了她唯一能想到的行动：她逃了，机灵托在她的手里，她最喜欢的刀剑融化在了他们身后的城市街道上。

entries.name: Strand Log II
entries.text:
We are calling this power "Strand." The threads of the world as it is woven, if the conscious universe could be considered to be a tapestry. Further analysis and data have suggested that the wielder of Strand begins to see, simply put, connections. Between allies, between enemies. It is a force that is always present, but wells to the surface more strongly in certain locations. Perhaps places many people think about, or where many beings have passed by. (Note: Analyze these "sources" in concert with the Cloud Strider. They may be able to provide more locational context.)

The true power of Strand lies not in the fact of the connection alone, but in the way such a power allows the manipulation of those connections. To make them something physical and then pull on it, or break it, or tie it into a knot. Or to unravel it entirely.

Strand is not without danger, although that should not be unusual to Guardians. Those who take up the banner of Stormcaller, for instance, have their own storied contention with the storm, and the Void was unilaterally regarded as dangerous by the Vanguard for many years. Strand's danger comes from the very act of taking hold of those threads—like many powers, the closer one comes to the source, the more likely the source may act on the wielder.

This danger is no product of Darkness. Or rather, only insomuch as wildfires are a product of Light: a natural consequence.
