That aspect of Darkness which revels in destruction, which encourages the easy entropy for the pursuit of power—it is nowhere to be found here. It may not even be truly part of Darkness…

I have touched Strand myself now. Carefully—I am too aware of mortality, but I must understand the power further if I am to hope to instruct the Guardian in turn. They acted as lightning rod while I experimented, and the backlash clung to them instead.

What a strange feeling, to be so aware of one's size in the spectrum of existence! It is the natural instinct to try to steer that, to take any control at all, no matter how much. Whatever can be done to feel as though you are not wholly adrift, lost in something huge and all-encompassing.

But precisely at the moment one tries to grasp for control, the weave becomes a devouring snarl.
entries.text_zh:
我们称这种力量为“缚丝”。如果意识宇宙可以被认为是一幅织锦的话，这就是编织世界的丝线。进一步的分析和数据表明，缚丝操控者开始看到了，简而言之，那些联系。在盟友之间，在敌人之间。这是种始终存在的力量，但在某些位置会更强烈地涌现出来。也许是许多人想念的地方，或是许多人经过的地方。（注：与云端行者协同分析这些“来源”。他们也许能够提供更多的位置信息。）

缚丝的真正力量并不在于联系本身，而在于这种力量允许操纵这些联系的方式。把它们变成有形的东西，然后拉扯它，或是扯断它，或是把它打个结。或是完全瓦解它。

缚丝并非没有危险，尽管这对守护者来说算不上什么稀罕事。举个例子，那些肩扛唤雷旗帜的人，对风暴有着众所周知的专属论调，多年来，先锋单方面认为虚空是危险的。缚丝的危险之处在于抓住这些丝线的行为——就像许多力量一样，越接近源头，源头就越有可能作用于操控者。

这种危险不是暗影的产物。或者更确切地说，正如野火不是光能的产物：它也同样只是自然的结果。暗影以毁灭为乐，鼓励追求力量的轻易熵变的那一面——在这里找不到。它甚至可能并不是暗影的一部分…

我现在已经亲身触碰过缚丝了。我太了解死亡，所以行事谨慎，但如果我想反过来指导守护者，就必须进一步了解这种力量。我进行实验时，他们充当了避雷针，结果是他们受到了反冲。

对自己在存在光谱中的大小有如此清楚的认知，真是种奇怪的感觉！自然的本能促使你试图去引导，去掌控一切，不管能掌控多少。你会做任何事，只要能让你感觉到，自己并没有完全迷失在某个硕大无比、包罗万象的事物中。

但恰恰在你想要抓住进行掌控的时候，编织就化作了毁灭缠结。

entries.name: Roving
entries.text:
Neomuna is a wonderful place for a Hunter to run. This Hunter, specifically.

Here the activity of life runs close to the surface—like an invisible river, like a migration of birds, like the moment of breathless motion just before the lightning strikes. Here Strand twines through his fingers, strong as a rope and just as flexible, and all he has to do is keep running. And why would he ever want to stop?

The pounding of feet. The exhilaration of free-fall. The snap as he catches hold of the weave of existence itself and swings up again with all the momentum of his dive. In motion, as he turns, he catches brass and gold reflecting vibrant city lights, realizes there are Vex in the streets—

Are they, too, part of the same flow? They echo in the weave nevertheless, like flowers on the surface of the rushing river. The Hunter bounds from one building to the next, never stopping, and finds effortlessly the place where all those Vex will converge, drops a roiling knot into the midst and sails on by.

How wonderful, simply to move, and never stop.

And then, later: when the exhilaration has run its course and he's agreed to do some little work in the service of science, he perches at the top of Artifact's Edge, that towering drop-off on Nessus. There's a safe lift down, but no Hunter he knows has ever bothered to take it, rather bounding along in their free-fall, daredevil way.

On Neptune, in Neomuna where that artifact of Darkness shores up the existence of the city itself, finding the weave was easy. Here…

Here on Nessus, it's perhaps not as close to the surface, but now he knows what he reaches for and, by the Darkness, it knows him as well. The Hunter wraps his hands in the beautiful ropes of the world's loom and vaults into emptiness. Laughter and Strand buoy him up at once, delight and freedom and a wonder at the vastness of existence.

Easier to learn the trick of it, where the Veil is close and enveloping. But of course Strand is everywhere. How could it not be?
entries.text_zh:
内欧姆那是猎人奔跑的好去处。尤其是，这位猎人。

在这里，生命的活动贴近表面——就像一条看不见的河流，就像鸟儿的迁徙，就像闪电来临前让人喘不过气来的那一刻。在这里，缚丝缠绕在他的手指上，像绳子一样结实，也一样灵活，他所要做的就是继续奔跑。他又为什么会想停下来呢？

脚步的重击声。自由落体的兴奋感。他抓住存在本身的编织用俯冲的全部动力再次摆动起来时的迅捷。在移动过程中，他转过身，看到青铜和黄金反射着充满活力的城市灯光，意识到街头有Vex出没——

它们也是同一水流的一部分吗？然而，它们在编织中回响，就像奔流河面上的花朵。猎人从一个建筑跳到另一个建筑，没有停息，毫不费力地找到了所有那些Vex将会聚集的地方，在中间放下一个翻滚的绳结，继续前行。

多好啊，只需移动，永不停息。

而在那之后：当兴奋感殆尽，他同意为科学出一些力时，他息停在神器止境的顶端，涅索斯上那高耸的陡坡。那里有条安全的下降通道，但他认识的猎人中没有一个人愿意尝试，而都是以自由落体的冒险方式一路跃进。

在海王星上，在暗影神器支撑着城市本身存在的内欧姆那，要找到编织是很容易的。在这里…

在这涅索斯，它也许没有那么靠近表面，但现在他知道他的手在伸向什么，而且，暗影在上，它也知道了他。猎人将双手包裹在世界纺织机上美丽的绳索中，跃入了虚空。笑声和缚丝立刻让他振作，他感到喜悦和自由，对宇宙浩瀚惊叹不已。

在面纱近在四周之处，更容易学会缚丝技巧。不过它当然是无处不在的。难道不是吗？

entries.name: Strand Log III
entries.text:
I have been conducting research among the local population, specifically regarding the "children's story" Nimbus told us, regarding the river of souls. I had a suspicion that there might have been other versions, or versions with better recorded provenance.

Willingness to participate in this research has been mixed, as have the results. It seems to be an endemic concept rather than a religious belief, and no one has been able to say where it comes from, save that a parent or teacher told it to them at some point. Some respondents have mentioned a river of stars—perhaps the Milky Way galaxy—and some have cited windstreams and weather formations, but the majority of respondents adhere to the "river of souls" construct. 

All things come from the river, and all return to it. The river may split and meet again. Other things may fall into it and change its course, but nevertheless it continues. In time, even mountains are worn down before it. 

Naturally, it is easiest to view this as an allegory for control of life. In the end, rivers are impossible to control. A person may swim or boat, but never take hold of the river to steer the course of the water itself. And it is impossible not to see the relationship to Strand, which slips away the moment a person tries to grasp too tightly.

I wonder about Strand. About its appearance. We can see the origins of the Stasis power on Europa, and the concept of a cosmic ice to oppose stellar fire fits very neatly in a certain sort of paradigm. Even that idea of stillness and control suits freezing, a slowness of atoms whether or not it is in truth a power of "ice." There is a certain weight to the perception of an "element."

If Strand had been shaped through the lens of Neomuna, surely it should have been some cosmic water instead, something that flows and gives way only to rise again. There are certainly combat styles to support this in old records.

But this power that has never before been used in this way came to one Guardian first, and I conjecture that they may have unconsciously given it form. I wish I had seen it! What would "connection" have appeared as? Now, of course, we know the shape of this power: it is green, it weaves itself in strings. As other Guardians begin to learn it, they too slot it into these positions in their minds. Whatever advances they come to are already framed verdant and tangling.

All the same, I cannot help but wonder about the nascent, formless thing it was before we reached out to it, and it reached back.
entries.text_zh:
我一直在当地居民中进行研究，特别是有关宁博思告诉我们的“儿童故事”，有关灵魂之河的信息。我怀疑可能有其他版本，或者出处记录得更好。

参与这项研究的意愿不一，研究结果也是如此。这似乎是一个风土概念，而非一种宗教信仰，除了父母或老师在某个时候告诉他们之外，没有人能够说出它来自哪里。一些受访者提到了一条群星之河——也许是银河系——其他人则提到了气流和天气形成，但大多数受访者坚持“灵魂之河”的说法。 

万物来自河流，又都归于河流。河流也许会分叉，然后再度汇合。其他事物也许会落入其中并改变它的河道，但无论如何它继续流淌着。假以时日，即使高山也会在它面前被冲平。 

自然，这很容易被看作是一则掌控生命的寓言。到头来，河流是无法被掌控的。一个人也许能游泳或划船，但永远别想抓住河水来控制水流。这与缚丝的关联也显而易见，抓得太紧，就会溜走。

我很好奇缚丝。好奇它的外观。我们可以看到木卫二上冰影的起源，宇宙之冰对抗恒星之火的概念非常符合某种范式。就连静止和控制的想法也与冷冻，这种原子的缓慢很相符，不管它是否真的是“冰”的力量。对某种“元素”的感知是有一定的权重。

如果缚丝是通过内欧姆那的视角塑造的，那么它肯定本应是某种宇宙之水，某种流动、消失后只为再次涨高的东西。在旧记录中肯定有战斗风格来印证这一点。

但是从未以这种方式使用过的这种力量首先出现在了一个守护者身上，我猜想他们可能是无意识地赋予了它形式。真希望我有见到那一幕！“联系”会是什么样子？现在，我们当然知道了这种力量的形状：它是绿色的，它把自己编织成绳状。随着其他守护者开始学习它，他们也把它插放入他们思维中的这些位置。不管他们进展到什么程度，都已经搭建起了翠绿缠结的框架。

尽管如此，我还是禁不住想知道我们触及它之前，那个原本新生而无形的东西的样子。

entries.name: Spinning
entries.text:
The Warlock sits with hands in the water and hums to themself. Several of the local feral pouka come and go as time passes, bumping up against fingers or vaulting out of the water to become airborne and curious, spattering drops everywhere. The Warlock doesn't mind, really. It's impossible to feel alone when dozens of creatures are hanging on their every move.

Perhaps meditation is meant to be solitary, but this is comforting.

A year ago, they were running with a fireteam, a tight-knit group of six that had each other's backs. Till the stars died, the lot of them had thought. It would always be like this.

Now there is one Warlock sitting in a flock of pouka, in an impossible settlement on a miraculous planet. And they miss that sense of companionship desperately—

There's something besides water in their hands. Cautiously, wonderingly, they lift their hands out of the pool and find green. The same verdancy as Strand, the same parallel strings and helical shifts. Only this also seems to be something living? 

It skitters over their hand, up their arm to their shoulder, leaving the sense of warmth in its wake. The Warlock stays very still as the little Strand-creature brushes against their cheek and then simply vanishes, a lingering hint of green and a sense of company the only concept that it was there in the first place.

The pouka congregate around shortly after, all chirps and flaps, and the Warlock can't help but laugh, even as they shoo some of the creatures away. They're supposed to be meditating.

But they didn't really come here to be alone. And it was foolish to think that they ever could be, when connected to the web that living creatures spin between them all. The Warlock breathes deep and dips their hands into the water again, and the pouka and the little green moments of connection swarm about them.

All might not be well, but it is better, like this. Not alone. Never truly alone, in this wide world where everything is bound together.
entries.text_zh:
术士坐在那里，双手浸在水中，对着自己哼唱。时间流逝，几只当地的野生普卡来了又去，碰撞着手指或是跃出水面，在空中好奇飞舞，把水滴溅得到处都是。那名术士毫不在意，真的。当几十只生物都在关注其一举一动时，你不可能感到孤独。

也许冥想本该是孤独的，但这却十分让人宽慰。

一年前，这名术士曾属于一支火力战队，那是一个由六人组成的紧密团体，彼此互相扶持。他们中的许多人都曾以为可以永远这样下去，直至群星陨灭。

现在，这名术士坐在一群普卡之中，在一颗神奇星球上的一个不可思议的定居点里。而术士极度怀念那种同伴的感觉——

术士的手里除了水还有其他东西。术士小心翼翼地、惊奇地从水池中抬起手，发现了一团绿色。和缚丝一样的翠绿，一样的平行绳线和螺旋游移。只是这似乎也是有生命的东西？ 

它越过术士的手，爬上其手臂，再到肩膀，留下一种暖意。术士一动不动，这个小缚丝般的生物擦过术士的脸颊，然后消失了，留下一种淡绿色和陪伴感，而这正是它最初存在的唯一概念。

很快，普卡聚集在周围，发出各种鸣叫和拍翅声，术士在驱赶它们时禁不住笑了。这本该是一次冥想。

但术士来这里并不是为了独处。与这些生物在它们之间纺织的网络相连时，认为自己还能独处的想法是愚蠢的。术士深吸一口气，再次将手浸入水中，普卡和小小的绿色联系瞬间蜂拥而至。

一切并非尽如人意，但像这样更好。不孤独。从未真正的孤独，在这一切都紧密联系在一起的大千世界里。

entries.name: Strand Log IV
entries.text:
Despite being aware by now of the correct manner to practice Strand—a loose hand, a letting-go of the concept that it can be controlled—some things still elude me. The will to let go at all, for instance.

It is pure foolishness, of course, to think that letting go of the need to control this one thing will extend to all areas of my life. A ceding of control in a game of chess does not translate to the same in philosophy. And yet it is true that people are not discrete, disconnected systems; they are many interlinked systems. One facet adjoins the next. 

I think of spinning. It has been a long, long time since any raw fiber passed my hands, but there were times in the Dark Age when if anyone wanted cloth, it must be made from scratch. Fleece is shorn, then carded out to remove the imperfections and align the fibers. And when you have them, what then? A single fiber is short and fragile. It breaks if you tug even lightly. It is useless.

But twist many of those short fibers together, and they become useful. Weavable, or knittable, or what-have-you. Thus, is strong cloth made: from the most delicate of things.

I think of spinning, and I remember the way unspun fiber passes through the fingers to the spindle. One pinches, but not too hard, just enough to direct and narrow. Too much and the fiber does not pass, the spinning does not take.

The metaphor is transparent. Obviously, this is about Strand. Just as it is about a craft I used to know, long ago. Beginner's errors can only be solved by learning the shape of failure, but most yarns will not unravel the spinner if some mistake is made.

And I am afraid. Not only of death, of wasting that final sacrifice Sagira made to preserve my life. But that if I open my hand, I will find it no longer hurts, that the thorn I have imagined there for so long is already gone.

It is all the same thing, in the end. I think I must be willing to let go, to let that which is truly temporary sink beneath the water, in order to achieve any significant capacity with Strand. Even pain may be guarded jealously, as though it is a treasure, but it need not be.

How fascinating what the lens of Strand shows us about Darkness.
entries.text_zh:
尽管现在我已经意识到了练习缚丝的正确方式——手放松，放下掌控它的想法——但有些东西我还是不具备。比如说，放手的意志。

当然，如果认为我生活的各面都需要放弃掌控，这就实在太愚蠢了。象棋比赛中控制权的割让在哲学上并不等同。然而，人们确实不是离散、互不相连的系统；他们是许多相互关联的系统。环环相扣。 

我想到了纺纱。我已经很久很久没有接触过纤维原料了，但在黑暗纪元有段时期，如果有人想要布料，就必须从头开始制作。剪短羊毛，然后梳理去除瑕疵，定向纤维。等你有了这些材料，然后呢？单根纤维又短又脆。只要你轻轻一拉，它就会断裂。根本没用。

但是把许多短纤维捻在一起，它们就变得有用了。可以编织，能够编制，或诸如此类的词。结实的布料就是如此：用最纤弱的东西制成。

我想到了纺纱，我还记得没纺的纤维经过手指到达纺锤的方式。一小撮，但不用太硬，刚刚够引导和缩小就行。太多的话，纤维就无法通过，纺纱就没法进行。

隐喻显而易见。这明显和缚丝有关。就像我很久以前知道的一门手艺一样。初学者的错误只能通过学习失败的形式来解决，但大多数丝线都不会因为出现了一些错误而弄坏纺纱机。

我很害怕。不仅仅是害怕死亡，害怕浪费了萨吉拉为保护我的生命而做出的最后牺牲。而是如果我张开手，我会发现它不再疼了，我想象了很久的那根刺已经消失不见了。

到最后，这都是一回事。我想我必须愿意放手，让那些真正短暂的东西沉入水底，才能使用缚丝获得重要的能力。就连痛苦也可能被小心翼翼地守护着，仿佛它是一件珍宝，但其实不必如此。

我们透过缚丝看到的暗影是多么的迷人啊。

entries.name: Weaving
entries.text:
Osiris contemplates the universe.

Strand curls between his fingers, a gentle presence, shape shifting but not changing. A helix—a careful knot, like those that used to be artwork—a braid. Always strands, always a structure that creates strength from fragility. 

He is so aware of the beat of his heart, in ways he never used to be. It shudders in his chest, aching but resolute.

He knows where the closest people are—the Guardian, obvious, within eyesight and hovering fretfully just in case Osiris slips. Nimbus, further away but tangible, probably surveying the city outside. And there's a pouka he can't quite see somewhere behind him, making eddies in the flow of the Strand as if it can dive into and out of that just as well as water or air.

It would be so easy to close his hand, to take hold of that which he touches. He does not. He thinks about it—lets his fingers curl softly—holds there as the humming cords of the world's loom shiver around him.

Existence flows. It is not a stagnant thing, one snapshot in time. In these connections, there is always motion, and all things are swept away in time, good and bad. No wonder Strand unravels, when it is given half a chance to do so; as far as it is concerned—if it has any sentience at all—everything is simply part of the river, a momentary curve or splash.

Osiris has known the vastness of the Infinite Forest and the great span of their solar system, and it is only here, with a tiny nascent spiral of the cosmic weft in his hand, that he feels small.

And yet: he knows also that he is not alone. A hundred hundred steady threads weave together, pulling this way and that, flowing and twisting and always part of the greater whole.

He should be taking notes. Expanding the Vanguard's understanding of Darkness, simplifying the steps of learning Strand for Guardians new to paracausality.

But for a moment, Osiris is at peace.
entries.text_zh:
奥斯里斯凝视着宇宙。

他手指间的缚丝，温柔的存在，形态游移着却并未发生改变。一个螺旋——一个周密的绳结，就像那些曾是艺术品的东西——一条穗带。总是成股成股的，总是从脆弱中创造力量的结构。 

他非常清晰地感知到自己的心跳，这是他以前从未有过的感受。它在他的胸口颤抖，疼痛却坚定。

他知道最接近的人在哪儿——守护者，显而易见，在他的视线范围内，焦躁不安地盘旋着，以防奥斯里斯失手。宁博思，离得更远但依然看得见，大概是在观察着外面的城市。在他身后的某个地方有只他看不太清的普卡，在缚丝的水流中制造着漩涡，仿佛它可以像水或空气一样潜入或跳出。

合上他的手，抓住他触及的东西是如此地容易。但他没有这么做。他思考着这个问题——让他的手指轻轻地弯曲——世界纺织机嗡嗡作响的绳索在他的周围颤抖，就这么握着。

存在流动着。它不是个停滞不前的事物，而是时间长河中的快照。在这些联系中，运动始终不变，所有的事物都在时间长河中被一扫而尽，无论好坏。难怪只要给它一点点机会，缚丝就会解绕；就它而言——如果它有任何感知的话——一切都只是河流的一部分，一个瞬时的曲线或水花。

奥斯里斯早就见过无尽森林的浩瀚和他们太阳系的巨大跨度，可只有在这里，手里拿着一根小小的新生螺旋宇宙纬线时，他才感觉到了渺小。

然而：他同样知道他并不孤单。无数条稳定的丝线交织在一起，四处拉扯，流动缠绕，永远是更大整体的一部分。

他应该记下来。拓宽先锋对暗影的理解，为不熟悉超因果关系的守护者简化缚丝学习步骤。

但在这一刻，奥斯里斯感到了平静。

entries.name: I — Eris Morn — Prolegomenon
entries.name_zh: I —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 序言
entries.text:
Verse 8:1 — The Sisters

Thoughts calcify into action, and actions calcify into being. Such is the ontology of Hive magic. Such is the Deck of Whispers that has unfolded beneath my hands.

These cards are curious objects—esoterica manifested by my power and the Guardians' tithes. They have taken on our forms: myself, Savathûn, and Xivu Arath. Our loves and fears, our memories, our desires.

Contemplate me. Contemplate the Hive.

These cards unsettle me. I did not wish to be unveiled so. But perhaps that is the consequence of my transformation: I am seen as I am, beneath my bandage. Beneath my skin.

So, too, are Xivu Arath and Savathûn unveiled. Through these cards, we have found ourselves connected. Dear devoted sisters, and I, inchoate but for the eyes I have stolen.

I have deciphered the meanings of the cards, drawn from them the shapes of their referents. The whispers ask for reflection and meditation, speaking of the paths we have taken and who we have come to be. And so my utterings, alongside those of the two surviving sisters, have taken the form of a new Book of Sorrow: a bound collection of verses sung by their gods and delivered to their brood as scripture.

Now I deliver it to my brood. Now I number among their gods. Aiat.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:1 - 姐妹

思想会转化为行动，而行动则会转化为存在。这就是邪魔族魔法的存在论。我的双手之下铺开的低语卡组也是如此。

这些卡牌是由我的力量以及守护者的贡品所生成的奇异物品。它们有着我们的形态：我自己、萨瓦图恩和希乌阿拉斯。我们的挚爱和恐惧、记忆和欲望。

凝思着我。凝思着邪魔族。

这些卡牌让我感到不安。我并不希望如此暴露自己。但也许这就是我转化的后果吧：在我的绷带之下，在我的皮肤之下。我的本体被一览无遗。

希乌阿拉斯与萨瓦图恩的本体也以这种方式被揭露了。通过这些卡牌，我们发现我和我那些亲爱的姐妹们是有关联的。而我，除了我偷窃的眼睛之外，还远远没有成熟。

我从卡牌之所指的形状中破译了其含义。这些低语可引起反思与冥想，讲述我们选择的道路以及我们所成为的自己。于是我与其他两名幸存姐妹的话语，成为了新的《忧愁之书》：一本将作为虫群经文的神吟诗书。

现在我将它交给我的虫群。现在我成为其众神中的一员。阿特。

entries.name: II — Savathûn — Imago Unfurl
entries.name_zh: II —— 萨瓦图恩 —— 心象
entries.text:
Verse 8:2 — The Witch 

We were the last surviving siblings. That's what this has always been about for Xivu Arath. She wanted us all to survive. She would throw everything she could at us, so we could learn to survive.

Didn't quite work, did it?

My brother's greatest acts of navigation were his metamorphoses. That was his tactic: he would change everything about himself so that he could survive this universe. Meanwhile, my sister cuts the universe apart—makes it as sharp as she—until all that's left is her and her love.

I'm a little bit of both. No need to choose. I don't have my brother's fear or my sister's vanity.

Even in his infinite adaptability, Oryx could not withstand the Guardians. So Xivu Arath wants to prove she can by being as rigid and unyielding as she always has been—no need to fix what isn't broken. Overwhelming force, tactics, and intimidation.

We are who we are, and we chose our morphs carefully. I wanted life. Xivu wanted vengeance and dominion. Oryx wanted to venture out, deep in thought, and feed on the delicacies of truth.

Well, he got what he wanted. Now Oryx knows death more intimately than any of us. No bringing him back.

Poor Xivu's distraught. With all that war and ruin to hide behind, she thinks she doesn't show it. Deep down she believes Oryx must have survived through their logic. She believes he'll be conjured back just like he conjured us.

That was a long time ago. We've moved past that. Despite everything to come, I will live on. With and without them.

Should I say that I miss my siblings? That I miss the times when the threats of death and short lifespan were still with us, when we piloted our needle, when we dove and became what we became?

No. Xivu is the sentimental one. We are not who we were. Who we were no longer exists.

I sound like my brother.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:2 - 女巫 

我们是最后幸存下来的同胞。希乌阿拉斯只考虑着这一点。她想让我们都生存下去。她会迫使我们经历一切困难，好让我们学会生存之道。

好像没有奏效，不是吗？

哥哥最厉害的导航之道是他的蜕变能力。那是他的战术：为了能够在这个宇宙中生存，他会改变自己的一切。同时，妹妹在不断切削着宇宙，使其变得像她一样锋利，直到剩下的只有她和她的挚爱。

我从两边都学了点。没必要选择。我没有哥哥的恐惧，也没有妹妹的虚荣。

欧里克斯虽然有无限的适应力，但他依然招架不住守护者的猛攻。所以希乌阿拉斯想一如既往地通过坚毅和不屈来证明她能挡住守护者…没必要去改变至今没出过问题的办法。毁天灭地的力量、战术和恐吓。

我们就是我们自己，而我们谨慎地选择了蜕变的形态。我想要生命。希乌想要复仇和统治。欧里克斯想要冒险，沉思，并以真理的美味为食。

他如愿以偿了。现在欧里克斯比我们任何人都更清楚死亡的滋味。他再也回不来了。

可怜的希乌悲痛欲绝。她躲在战争和废墟的后面，以为能掩藏自己的情绪。在内心深处，她坚信欧里克斯定是通过他们的守则生存了下来。她坚信他能被召唤回来，就像他召唤我们一样。

那是很久以前的事了。我们已经过了这道坎。不管将来会发生什么，我都会继续活下去。不管有没有他们。

我该说我怀念我的兄弟姐妹吗？我怀念死亡和短暂生命的威胁依然如影随形的时候，怀念我们驾驶织针飞下深渊，成为现在的样子的时候？

不。希乌才是多愁善感的那一个。我们已经不是以前的我们。以前的我们已不复存在。

我这话很像我哥哥的语气。

entries.name: III — Xivu Arath — Battlesong
entries.name_zh: III —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 战歌
entries.text:
Verse 8:3 — The Adherent 

What I Am —
Uttered by Xivu Arath —
God of Many Shapes — 

I AM THE GOD OF SILENCE. I slit a hundred million wailing throats. I watch as their blood scatters like precious stones. Their screams turn to sighs; their sighs turn to silence. I stand among the dead and listen to the absence of sound.

I AM THE GOD OF LOGIC. I shiver in delight to speak the truth because speaking truth is good. I speak my brother's words, the words he cut from the worm god Akka's throat.

I AM THE GOD OF LIFE. I pare dead things from truth, and in this, I find life that cannot be extinguished. I hold that life, nurture it by testing it against myself, by removing the weaknesses that bring death. In this, I embrace life and all its strength.

I AM THE GOD OF LOVE. Any life that can withstand me will be with me at the final shape. There, we will stand together. That life will know me, and I will know it: pared to our true shapes, seeing each other for what we are.

I AM THE GOD OF ALL THAT EXISTS. I have endured while others have not. I am the last surviving sibling. I will stand at the final shape and be the end. I will maintain my existence when nothing else has. I will stand alone.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:3 - 拥护者 

我为何物——
出自希乌阿拉斯——
万变之神—— 

吾乃沉默之神。我已经割开了亿万哀号者的喉咙。我看着他们的血像宝石般散落一地。他们的尖叫声变成了叹息；他们的叹息变成了沉默。我站在死者中间，听着那片寂静。

吾乃守则之神。我为诉说真话而高兴得发抖，因为诉说真话是好事。我说出哥哥的话语，那是他从虫神阿卡的喉咙里割下来的。

吾乃生命之神。我从真理中剥离死物，也在其中找到了无法熄灭的生命。我握着那生命，通过亲自测试它的力量，剔除可能招致死亡的弱点来培育它。在其中，我拥抱生命及其全部力量。

吾乃爱之神。任何能够承受我的生命将以终焉之形与我同在。那时我们将携手与共。它了解我，我了解它：还原成我们真实的样子，看到彼此的本质。

吾乃万物之神。我已经存活到了今日，而其他人却没有。我是兄弟姐妹中最后的幸存者。我将化为终焉之形，成为一切的终点。我将在虚无中永远独存。

entries.name: IV — Eris Morn — Evocate Desire
entries.name_zh: IV —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 唤起欲望
entries.text:
Verse 8:4 — The Harbinger 

My vile transformation is complete. What was foretold, what was feared, is now true: Eris Morn has given in to the Hive's endless hunger. She has taken up the mantle of a Hive queen and leads vast armies of acolytes into war.

Inevitable. Inimitable. Who else but her? What else but this?

(Ikora believes my transformation was not necessary. It was.)

I hear whispers, but when do I not? They have been with me since the Hellmouth. This is what I am. It cannot be refuted or denied. This is the shape I have chosen for myself: my morph, the Harbinger.

(Ikora believes I will martyr myself. But what martyr walked towards oblivion with a knife in hand? I will not go so serenely.)

In my morph, I am unafraid. In my morph, I wield fear, that earliest of fears: fear of devourment. Since we ourselves were prey, we have felt terror at the gaping maw, at the hunger gazing at us with delight.

I have stared that hunger in the face. I have endured it for too long. Now, I will be the predator. I will devour. I will instill that first fear.

I hunger, but that hunger has always strained against the limitations of my Lightless body. But here, in the Witch Queen's endless hypogeum, that hunger has bloomed. This part of me has erupted from my body as from the earth, like one of those obscene, carnivorous corpse flowers—dark cores swallowing sunlight, plush petals open to death.

Ridiculous. Who would compare hunger to a flower? I do not wait passively for my prey. No—no—it is a worm. A worm I have a desperate urge to feed.

It can be nothing else.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:4 - 先知 

我的邪恶转化完成了。所预言的，所担心的，现在都已成真。埃里斯·摩恩屈服于邪魔族的无尽饥渴。她披上了邪魔族女王的衣钵，带领着仆从大军投入了战争。

不可避免。命中注定。除了她，还能是谁？除了战争，还有什么？

（艾可拉觉得我没必要转化。但它是必要的。）

我听到了低语，但我何曾听不到呢？它们自从地狱深渊起就伴我身边。这就是我。无法反驳，也无可否认。这就是我为自己选择的形态：我的蜕变，先知。

（艾可拉以为我会殉道。但哪个殉道者会手握刀子走向覆灭？我不会平静地死去。）

蜕变后，我无所惧怕。蜕变后，我挥舞恐惧，那是最原始的、对吞噬的恐惧。自从我们成为猎物以来，我们对那疯狂注视我们的饥饿大嘴感到恐惧。

我直面着这样的饥饿。我已经忍受它太久了。现在，我会成为捕食者。我将要去吞噬，去散播那种最初的恐惧。

我以前很饥饿，但那种饥饿感总是与我无光之体的局限性相抵触。但在这里，在巫妖女王的无尽次元空间里，这种饥饿感被释放了出来。这种欲望从我的身体里爆发了出来，就像从地球上爆发出来的欲望一样，就像那些淫秽的、食肉的尸花…黑暗的核心不断吞噬阳光，让毛绒绒的花瓣向着死亡绽放。

荒谬。谁会把饥饿感比作花朵？我不会静候我的猎物。不——不——我说的是一只蠕虫。一只我急切地想去喂养的蠕虫。

绝非他物。

entries.name: V — Eris Morn — Mimesis
entries.name_zh: V —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 摹仿
entries.text:
Verse 8:5 — Blades 

What is the nature of war? Ritual.
What is the nature of ritual? Fascination.

Imitation shapes desire, and Xivu Arath has become its great mediator. She compels those she wars against to war against her, and the object over which they war is existence itself. She takes up her blade, and we take up ours. Xivu Arath cuts at us, and so do we cut at her. We bleed together, mirrored in our pain and violence.

Savathûn looked at us through a veil so that we would not see her. Xivu Arath looks at us through a dark mirror, and she only sees herself.

This is her design, her ultimate mechanism of desire: she would make us into her image. She would cut the entire universe into her image so that she is the only thing left at the end of all things.

Vain and lonely. That is Xivu Arath, bereft of her siblings.

The sword logic is predicated on such imitation. To return Xivu Arath's violence is to embrace it and its beautiful thesis. We are forced to react, again and again, as she makes her advance. We are forced to desire existence at any cost, just as she does.

Fated? Inevitable? No. An ontological trap.

The Warmind knew this, as he could know her the most intimately out of all of us. His escalation did nothing but mirror her endlessly. His self-sacrifice put an end to that font of violence. It was a frustration in her logic that he did so, as Xivu Arath recognizes no sacrifice that does not end in a scream.

But self-sacrifice could not put an end to her war march. Only doubt can do so. And in Xivu Arath's mournful solipsism, she will be left with nothing but that.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:5 - 利刃 

战争的本质是什么？仪式。
仪式的本质是什么？痴迷。

模仿塑造欲望，而希乌阿拉斯已成为了它的头号中间人。她迫使那些被她宣战的人向她宣战，为了存在本身而战。她拿起她的利刃，我们拿起我们的利刃。希乌阿拉斯砍向我们，而我们也砍向她。我们一起流血，承受相同的痛苦和暴力。

萨瓦图恩透过一层面纱看我们，让我们无法看见她。希乌阿拉斯透过一面黑镜看我们，她只能看到自己。

这是她的诡计，她最终的欲望机制：她会把我们变成她的样子。她要把宇宙变成她的样子，让自己成为万物尽头所剩下的唯一东西。

虚荣和孤独。那就是失去兄弟姐妹后的希乌阿拉斯。

邪剑守则是以这种模仿为前提的。回击希乌阿拉斯的暴力就是在拥抱这种暴力，以及它美丽的论调。我们被迫做出反应，一次又一次，跟着她的脚步起舞。我们被迫不惜一切代价渴望存续，就像她那样。

命中注定？不可避免？不，这是一个存在论的陷阱。

战争思维知道这一点，因为他在我们之中最了解她。他的升级不过是在不断反照她而已，而他的自我牺牲终止了那个暴力的源头。在希乌阿拉斯的守则中，这是一种挫折，因为不在尖叫中归于沉寂的死亡不算献祭。

但自我牺牲无法阻止她前进的脚步。只有怀疑能阻止她。在希乌阿拉斯悲哀的唯我论中，这是她仅有的东西。

entries.name: VI — Xivu Arath — κατολοφύρομαι
entries.name_zh: VI —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 哭泣之歌
entries.text:
Verse 8:6 — Lacuna 

My Navigation — 
Sung by Xivu Arath —
Faithful Sister to Oryx —

THE SKY GAVE OUR SISTER STRENGTH FROM FALSE SHAPES.

SHE FELL TO WHAT FELLED YOU, LONELY NAVIGATOR.

THIS IS THEIR LIE: THEIR COMPANIONSHIP IS STRENGTH.

THIS IS OUR TRUTH: THEIR COMPLACENCY DECAYS EXISTENCE.

THEIR DEAD RISE WHEN THEY DESERVE TO DIE!

THEY WILL NOT MEET OUR TRUTH WITH TRUTH!

THUS, THEY DO NOT DESERVE IT.

THEY ARE NOT REAL.

YOU WERE REAL.

YOU WERE TO LAST FOREVER,

OUR UNDYING CREATION.

I WOULD DIE AGAIN TO GIVE YOU STRENGTH.

I WOULD CUT MY WOUND SO THAT YOU MAY STEP THROUGH.

YOU WILL NOT RISE BY FALSE SHAPES,

BUT WITH OUR UNCONDITIONAL VICTORY:

SHE WHO HAS BEEN SCOURED OF THE SKY NOW BRINGS FORTH HER BROOD.

THEY HAVE TAKEN UP YOUR WEAPON, WHICH IS ALL THAT YOU ARE,

AND SHE WILL CONJURE YOU BACK WITH HER UNDERSTANDING.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:6 - 缺漏 

我的航行—— 
由希乌阿拉斯吟唱——
欧里克斯忠诚的妹妹——

苍穹给了姐妹力量，让她摆脱了虚伪的形态。

她被你的夙敌击倒，孤独的领航员。

这就是他们的谎言：他们的同伴就是力量源泉。

这就是我们的真相：他们的自满会使自身衰退。

他们应死的亡者涅槃重生！

他们无法用真相面对我们的真相！

故而，他们不配得到它。

他们不是真实的。

你是真实的。

你本该永远存续，

我们不朽的创作。

我愿再次死去以给你力量。

我会切开伤口来让你踏过。

你不会以虚假的形态涅槃重生，

而是带着我们无条件的胜利：

被夺取苍穹的她如今统领虫群。

他们已经拿起了你的武器，这就是你的全部，

而她会以其理解将你带回这里。

entries.name: VII — Xivu Arath — Deathless
entries.name_zh: VII —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 不死之身
entries.text:
Verse 8:7 — Liminal

My Throne —
Carved to endure by Xivu Arath —
God of Love —

MY COURT IS WAR, AND YOU WILL FIND ME THERE.

I am war, and my throne is deathless.

Come. Cut the outer curtain of my fortress, and it will open its new eye in a bloodless laceration. Cut further to see inside its walls: the yellow fat, the purple viscera, the teeming rust-cut capillaries.

These are the colors of war. THESE ARE THE COLORS OF MY COURT.

My gates open to the most life. The swollen fountains run with blood and burst with arterial spray. The paths are paved with small white teeth. They gnash beneath each footfall, their roots raw and alive.

Look! I have raised cathedrals made of flesh. When a breeze caresses them, they blush and contract, fine hairs sensing the change.

They are worshipped with bare touch. MY THRONE SHUDDERS WITH JOY.

The halls of my palace are echoing throats, slick and filled with breath. Its windows are glazed with skin, opalescent and alive, latticed with blue-black veins.

The seats of my throne are fashioned with living bones. Break them, and you will see their raw, red marrow. Break them, and the wet pith will writhe. Two are knotted with scars: broken and reformed, broken and reformed.

Look out from the terrace and see the worlds we will devour to sustain us. It is a mouth, yawning black and wide and hungering. It is open in screams of base need.

MY COURT IS LOVE, AND YOU WILL MEET ME THERE.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:7 - 阈限

我的王座——
由希乌阿拉斯雕刻以存续——
爱之神——

我的宫廷即是战争，你会在那里找到我。

我即是战争，而我的王座是永存的。

来吧。割开我堡垒的外帘，它将在一个不会流血的裂口中睁开一只新的眼睛。再往深处切一刀，就能看到它墙内的景象：黄色的脂肪，紫色的内脏，锈蚀铁器割伤的充血毛细血管。

这是战争的颜色。这是我的宫廷的颜色。

我的大门向大多生命敞开。鲜血在膨胀的喷泉中流淌着，在一旁的动脉中迸发着。路上铺满了小小的白牙。它们在每一个脚印下咬牙切齿，根部生机勃勃。

看！我用血肉搭起的教堂。当微风抚过它们时，它们会脸红、收缩，上面的细毛感觉到变化。

它们在触碰之中被敬拜。我的王座因喜悦而颤抖。

我的宫廷大厅是一个回响的喉腔，光滑而充满气息。它的窗户覆盖着一层布满蓝黑色血管晶格的乳白皮肤。

我王座的座位是用鲜活的骨头做成的。打断它们，你就会看到生鲜的红色骨髓。打断它们，里面湿润的骨髓会随之蠕动。有两根骨头结着疤痕：这是因为它们断了又愈合，愈合了又断。

从阳台向外看，看那些为了我们的延续而即将被吞噬的世界。它是一张黑色的大嘴，在饥饿的驱使下，伴着欲望的尖叫而张开血盆大口。

我的宫廷即是爱，你会在那里见到我。

entries.name: VIII — Savathûn — Swords and Lanterns
entries.name_zh: VIII —— 萨瓦图恩 —— 刀剑与灯笼
entries.text:
Verse 8:8 — Ascension 

My sorry, sad, inculcated sister. She thinks she's as honest as a knife's edge just because she never speaks a lie aloud. But she's prone to contradiction, at least since our beloved brother fell.

She could never quite understand it—someone as mighty as Oryx brought down by liars, his bloodline destroyed, his corpse left to desiccate in Saturn's orbit. Xivu Arath actually believed that Dreadnought of his was unassailable, but Oryx knew that he had limits: more than once, he took the power of our deaths to defeat something stronger than himself.

She's just bitter she wasn't there to die for him again.

She says she's the god of death, but I've seen her throne. It's a mausoleum for life with all the close, cloying comfort of a birthing room, wet and raw and filled with disgusting effluvia. I imagine it reminds her of our gardens so long ago, and all the things that grew there.

She really shouldn't be so nostalgic.

There was a game we played when we were young: Swords and Lanterns. Sathona held the lantern, while Xi Ro held the sword. Sathona would search for her hidden sister, and Xi Ro would avoid the lantern's light. If Xi Ro touched Sathona with her sword, she would win. If Sathona found Xi Ro with her lantern, she would win.

Sathona devised the rules, but Xi Ro would let her sister find her.

I still give her presents, too, of course. I gave her Torobatl! My gift to my last surviving sibling. She gobbled it up so greedily, she didn't even consider how it proved her precious logic false.

What kind of thing is a gift? The Deep doesn't like gifts. Neither does the logic. But we're sisters: I thought I'd be nice, and share.

Xivu was too busy to notice that little contradiction. She never even thanked me.

What did she say, as soon as she set foot on Torobatl? "FOR AS LONG AS YOU HAVE WORSHIPPED WAR, YOU HAVE WORSHIPPED ME." Aiat, aiat. That was Torobatl. I know a joke in a dead language: aiēbat.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:8 - 飞升 

我那可怜而可悲的妹妹太过固执。她以为自己像刀锋一样诚实，只因为她从不将谎言说出来。但她经常自相矛盾，至少从我们心爱的哥哥倒下之后就是如此。

她永远无法完全理解…强大如欧里克斯竟会被说谎者打倒，血统被毁，尸体被留在土星的轨道上干枯殆尽。希乌阿拉斯真的相信他的无畏战舰是无可匹敌的，但欧里克斯知道自己有极限：不止一次，他利用我们死亡的力量来击败比他更强大的东西。

她只是因为没能在那里再度为他赴死而愤懑。

她说她是死亡之神，但我见过她的王座。那是一座生命的陵墓：拥有产房里封闭而发腻的舒适感，潮湿而原始，到处是令人作呕的液体。我想这让她想起了很久之前我们的花园，以及所有生长在那里的一切。

她真不该如此怀旧。

我们儿时曾玩过一个游戏：刀剑和灯笼。萨托娜拿着灯笼，希罗拿着剑。萨托娜会寻找躲起来的妹妹，而希罗会避开灯笼的光。如果希罗用剑碰触到萨托娜，她就赢了。如果萨托娜用灯笼找到希罗，她就赢了。

萨托娜设计了规则，但希罗会故意让她姐姐找到她。

当然，我还是会给她礼物。我给了她图罗巴特尔！那是给我最后一位活着的姐妹的礼物。她贪婪地吞下它，甚至都没想过，这证明了她宝贵的守则是错的。

礼物算什么东西？深渊不喜欢礼物。守则也是如此。但我们是姐妹：我想我会友善点，分享些东西。

希乌忙得没能注意到这个小小的矛盾。她甚至都没谢过我。

踏上图罗巴特尔后，她是怎么说的？“只要你崇拜战争，你就崇拜着我。”阿特，阿特。那就是图罗巴特尔。我知道一个已死语言中的笑话：艾埃巴特。

entries.name: IX — Xivu Arath — Antigone Drowns
entries.name_zh: IX —— 希乌阿拉斯 —— 安提戈涅的溺亡
entries.text:
Verse 8:9 — Lament 

On Xivu's Mourning —
Sung by Xivu Arath —
Sister to a dead king —

GRIEF. There is no grief. I will not grieve.

FEAR. There is no fear. We do not fear.

PITY. There is no pity. There is nothing to pity.

GRAVE. He will have no grave. We do not dig graves.

ROT. He rots beneath the waves.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:9 - 挽歌 

希乌的悲叹——
由希乌阿拉斯吟唱——
已死之王的妹妹——

悲痛。没有悲痛。我不会悲痛。

恐惧。没有恐惧。我们不恐惧。

怜悯。没有怜悯。不值得怜悯。

坟墓。他没坟墓。我们从不掘墓。

腐烂。他在腐烂。沉没于海底。

entries.name: X — Eris Morn — The Augur Casts Her Bones
entries.name_zh: X —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 用她的骨头占卜
entries.text:
Verse 8:10 — The Lie 

It is a dire error to see Savathûn's predictions as truths divined from some inner foresight. She did not prophesize. What we are attempting here was just one possibility in an infinite collection of possibilities, and a choice we made in an infinite collection of choices. She could not have anticipated them all. She could only cast her bones in the space between certainty and augury, and watch them fall.

(It is odd to speak of her in the past tense. Even in death, she is here with us, pulling at our strings, howling with laughter at our failings as she did years ago. But now our failings will be her sister's triumph, and Savathûn's lasting death.)

No, the Witch Queen never dealt in fate. In this, we share her understanding of the universe: every movement is a result of a meticulous application of desire. This path was carefully constructed, and we were predictable enough to place our footsteps into the imprints she made for us.

It is a truth dressed as a lie, so that we may overlook it.

But that is not fate. Fate is the purview of Xivu Arath's childish logic; the dead were destined for death, and the fall of her sword is inevitable.

We are not as easily fooled as she. That logic is a lie dressed as a truth, so that we may waste our time with it.

No. I am not here because of fate. I am here because of will and machination.

But if neither are my own, is that any more desirable?

No matter. I will take control. I possess that power.

I will cast my bones, as the Witch Queen did, between certainty and augury. I will see Xivu Arath's worm devour her. She will be struck down by her own bargain and fall like lightning. I will see Savathûn undone by my own trickery. She will behold me as I am and know that I am her ruin.

This is the path I lay for them, and they will follow it. 

Aiat.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:10 - 谎言 

把萨瓦图恩的预测看成是以某种内在的预知能力而占卜出来的真相是一个可怕的错误。她没有作出预言。我们在此所尝试的只是无限的可能性集合中的一种可能性，以及我们在无数选择中做出的一个选择。她只能把她的骨头抛进确信与预言之间的空间里，看着它们倒下。

（用提及死人的口吻谈论她感觉很怪。就算死了，她也仍然在这里，和我们在一起，像几年前一样，在背后操纵我们，对着我们的失败嚎叫大笑。但现在我们的失败将会是她妹妹的胜利，以及萨瓦图恩的永久死亡。）

不，巫妖女王不会干涉命运。在这点上，她对宇宙的理解与我们相同：每个举动都是对欲望一丝不苟运用的结果。这条道路是被精心构建的，而我们太容易被猜透，以至于会把脚步放在她为我们留下的脚印中。

这是个装扮成谎言的真相，这样我们才会对其视而不见。

但那不是命运。命运在希乌阿拉斯幼稚守则的范畴之内；亡者注定要死去，她刀剑的落下无可避免。

我们不像她那样会被轻易愚弄。那守则是个装扮成真相的谎言，这样我们才会在其身上浪费时间。

不。我在这里不是因为命运。我在这里是因为意志，也是因为阴谋。

但如果两者都不是我的，那难道会更可取吗？

不重要。我会控制局面。我拥有那力量。

我会像巫妖女王所做的那样，把我的骨头抛进确信与预言之间。我会看到希乌阿拉斯的蠕虫将她吞噬。她会被自己的交易击倒，像闪电般从天上堕下。我会看到萨瓦图恩被自己的诡计毁掉。她会看到我现在的样子，知道我将毁灭她。

这是我为她们铺设的道路，而她们会沿着它走下去。 

阿特。

entries.name: XI — Eris Morn — They Drink Strong Poison
entries.name_zh: XI —— 埃里斯·摩恩 —— 他们喝下了剧毒
entries.text:
Verse 8:11 — The Truth 

The Hive are not a monolith. They have internal contradictions, strife, tensions. These threaten to engulf them. There is a fissure forming that I alone behold with open eyes. It will one day yawn and gape, and something will crawl from it that will shake the Hive's foundations.

Perhaps that thing is me.

They sense this possibility and cling to their imperative truth out of fear. To this end, Xivu Arath lies to herself continuously. With each deception she immures herself in a great fiction she must restore with each forming crack.

This is why they fear and revere their own logic. The first doubt, the oldest doubt, the entaoxuanna. It would destroy them.

To this end, Oryx's grand philosophy encompasses everything it touches. Every paradox, every conflict. Love is death, war is love, and what is at peace is sick. Even his defeat was a movement towards the final shape, as he knew that his killer would become him. In his logic, that is all his killer could become. It makes failures into proofs, so that their logic may weather them.

It will all collapse one day. I will make sure of it. I will break their truth by my becoming.

I have stolen much from the Hive. I took their eyes, their fetid magic, and now I have taken from them again. Each time I descend into the Deep, I take what I need, and take what I am owed. Just as the Taken King slew Akka to satiate his worm.

I see now. With all my years of study and strife, all my years of venturing into the dark so that I may put my eyes to good use, I have conjured him.

This is what Xivu Arath sees when she beholds my morph. Her brother, triumphant. Reborn.

In this way, I am truly loved.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:11 - 真相 

邪魔族不是铁板一块。他们有内部矛盾、纷争、冲突。这些东西有可能会反噬他们。有裂缝在形成，只有我才能睁眼看清它。有一天它将张开大嘴，而里面爬出的东西会动摇邪魔族的根基。

也许那东西正是我。

他们感觉到了这一可能性，因恐惧而坚持自己重要的真相。为了这个目的，希乌阿拉斯不断地对自己撒谎。每一次欺骗，她都使自己被困在巨大的虚构之中，被迫修补上面出现的每道裂缝。

这就是为什么他们既恐惧又敬畏他们自己的守则。最初的怀疑，最古老的怀疑，超越死亡的恐惧。它会摧毁他们。

为了这个目的，欧里克斯的宏大哲学包含了它所接触的一切。每个悖论，每个冲突。爱即是死，战争即是爱，和平即是病。甚至他的失败也是走向终焉之形的步骤，因为他知道他的杀手会变成他本身。在他的守则中，他的杀手只能变成那样。它把失败变成证据，这样它们的守则就能经受得住失败。

它总有一天会彻底崩溃，我会确保这一点。我会通过我的降临击碎其真相。

我从邪魔族那里窃取了许多。我拿走了他们的眼睛，他们恶臭的魔法，而现在我又从他们那里夺取了。每一次我潜入深渊，我就夺取我需要的东西，拿走我被亏欠之物。正如邪神为满足蠕虫而斩杀了阿卡。

我现在明白了。通过多年来的学习和斗争，多年来为了用好我的眼睛而涉险踏入黑暗的举动，我召唤出了他。

当希乌阿拉斯看见我的蜕变时，这就是她所见的东西。她的兄弟，凯旋。重生。

我以这种方式被真正地爱着。

entries.name: XII — Savathûn — Love
entries.text:
Verse 8:12 — The Wish

Eris will comport herself beautifully.

I wish I could behold her morph. I can see it in my mind's eye. Her chitin will engulf her; her eyes will be uncovered. She will laugh! And what a delightful sound that will be, after everything! Genuine, full of my guile and my sister's zest for life.

I may still see her morph. There's still time. I'll be so proud of her.

It will seem like fate, something that couldn't have happened any other way. But Eris is smart enough to recognize my touch. She will realize it was me, and understand that this was what I made her for. She'll see all the intricacies of the path I have laid before her from the moment my nephew raised his sword.

Not too long ago, that understanding would have starved me. Now it's just icing on the cake.

I hope she's not too upset. Ah well. I'm sure she'll get over it.

There were contingencies, of course. It's foolish to put all your eggs in one basket. One must lay snares and set events in motion that may never quite snap into place.

But this? This was easy. Perfectly aligned.

Xivu Arath will make it clear why it had to be this way. She will do exactly what I know she will do because that is all she is ever able to do. Anything else would kill her.

Because in the end, my sister just wants someone to love, fully and completely. And she's given up on me.

So I will give her Eris Morn.
entries.text_zh:
诗节8:12 - 心愿

埃里斯会表现得很出色。

我希望我能观看她的蜕变。我可以在我脑海中看到那一幕。她的甲壳会裹住她；她的眼睛会露出来。她会笑！经历过那一切之后，那将是多么令人愉快的声音啊！发自内心而充满了我的狡诈与妹妹对生命的热情。

我也许还能看见她的蜕变。还有时间。我会为她自豪。

像是宿命一样，无法以另一种方式发生。但埃里斯足够聪明，能够辨认我的触摸。她会意识到那是我，理解这就是我创造她的目的。她会看到，从我侄子举起剑的那一刻起，我在她面前铺设的道路，以及其中所有错综复杂之处。

不久之前，那份理解会让我饿死。现在，它只是锦上添花。

希望她不是很沮丧。也罢。我确信她能走过那个坎。

应急方案自然是有。把赌注都押在一个地方太愚蠢。我们必须设下陷阱，触发那些可能永远不会恰当发生的事件。

但这个？这很简单。与计划一致。

希乌阿拉斯会表明为何非这样不可。她会做我预料中的事，因她只能那样做。其他做法会让她丧命。

因为归根结底，我的妹妹只是想去完全而彻底地爱某个人。而她已经放弃我了。

所以，我将把埃里斯·摩恩送给她。

entries.name: Chapter 1 – A Step Leads. A Step Follows.
entries.name_zh: 第1章 领导者与追随者
entries.text:
The name Te'Qal fades from focus. Red anticipation runs into dripping memory as the unknown sprawl of the future stands endless and dark. 

Moments before jaws close, reality confronts the mind. Reason pleads with the body. 

Every nerve screaming too late to retreat from viral attraction. 

Deterministic instinct forces Qugu to jaw-beast. Severed. Paid. Reformed in the belly of sacrifice, repaid. 

Drink deep the nectar, and recite… 

all change is pain… 

… 

…Gloom shades a great Mountain. 

Rigid. 

Cut against the sky. 

Floodplains engulf the Mountain's shadow to every horizon. Coral forests dotted by mossy patches root into red sands and maize-streaked stone. Geothermic silt-rich shallows steep aromatic lichen, and flow through subterranean channels that erode foundations until the surface above falls into slithering grooves across the planet Seht. 

Within a sunken valley at the Mountain's base, a Qugu slumps, dying. Cephalopod frame atop bi-pedal, inverted legs, cloaked in a flowing mane of tendril-like tentacles, with a single forelimb reaching from their chest… the deep black eyes infer connection—but primal, lost and alone. 

:Te'Juna:cries out alone:extinguishment:the old fear:shared burden: 

Their legs have no strength left, but something in the blood compels them forward into the maw of an enormous mollusk beast. The great jaws snap shut. A mane of tentacles limply grope, and then lay still. Remains into the shallows. Life leaves the flesh and gathers again. It splinters and fractures, then melds, entwines. Decomposes, and gestates. A death-grove awakening. Time passes. Te'Juna's rot seeds the grove that drinks from the dark pools beneath the Mountain. 

Five rise from the silt and shallow. Their existence burns bright for a time, then dims. Five return in frailty to the death-grove, to the mollusk beast, compelled into its jaws. Their flesh churns to nectar. They seed the grove anew. 

A dozen worlds persistently circle a blazing white star. Qugu herds stride the open floodplain, feed-basking the starlight of Se'Tar. Their migrations find the coral edge that falls into the sea. Direction is sought; mane-limbs are offered in ritual symbiosis to the great mollusk of the Mountain—a deified jaw-beast. Vision-bringing nectar is collected, fermented, and imbibed. Seeded death-groves saturate with it. The line of the Qugu people carves valleys deep into Seht. Their existence resonates across time, through consciousness, in voice and actioned flesh. 

The children of their children would return to the coral edge, to swim in the depths and pry submerged jaw-beasts to surface. These holy beasts are given new roosts beneath the Mountain. Many cycles pass. A village of salt-stone, lichen and coral shelters the herd. In time, many dot the shallows around the Mountain.  

The death-grove churns generations in the silt, and new groves take shape, filling the shallows for miles. Groves anchor villages. Villages spiral into cities that join the Mountain to the sea and reach high to seed bodies in the sky. Qugu voices echo in unity across a shared dream of existence. A haven from fear and loneliness. A horizon of communal ambition. 

Memories and concepts—as distant reference—as echoed warning—as guiding hand. Ever sharpening the whole. Living, active reincarnation. 

And now, Te'Qal. This expression of the cycle. One of three. One who has seen the skies colored by four stars, the insight of nectar many times, and the perils of 70 years. One who now sees the line of their descendancy, back to its inception; the lives of Te'Qali ancestors entwined and present before them. Above, the stars are absent, a hollow sky. 

Te'Qal concentrates on the breadth of the Qugu line—listens to their voices, seeks guidance. In their deepest dreaming moments, Te'Qal would experience their knowledge, feel their gentle pull or push. As if all action had been building to and from their decisions. The herd surrounds them. They stride across the floodplain, together. They wriggle through sea-rock coves and run the paths of their evolution together.  

The herd halts under a starless sky. Te'Qal stops but a few paces out of step—so sudden is the loss of momentum—and looks back, draws faces known to them forward, listens. 

The herd screams in silence. Their mouths agape in that old extinguishing fear. Te'Qal turns from the line of their ancestors and looks to the starless sky. The floodplains fall away into cliff and void, the starless nothing dripping down to overtake the horizon. And there, at the pointed tip of the Qugu line, Te'Qal sees an end, a precipice of silence, a great yawning tear in the sky of nothing, looming over the Mountain.  

An Omen. 

Split. To swallow them all. 

A vision of purpose. 

The culmination of many cycles. 

A pivotal step… 

… 

…Te'Qal sinks to the floor before stretching mane-tendrils stabilize them. A steady line of blood flows from one freshly nubbed tendril; one of 15 missing from Te'Qal's mane. The bloodied nub spasms with pain. Musical percussion vibrates through their limbs and plants them back in the present, in time to hear a voice address them. 

"Awaken, Warden Te'Qal. With the knowledge our forebearers entrust to you, the Seht Armada's Command is now held to the Te line." 

Three Qugu elders wrapped in pearlescent second-skin sleeves stand before Te'Qal. A golden-crowned sleeve is suspended above them. The golden mantle, a Will-weaver, to meld disparate intentions into unity. 

"Rise and accept this burden of service." 

A massive jaw-beast bubbles with nectar, the taste of it still fresh, its shell bloodied. Providence fills Te'Qal's heart. The hum of spaceflight vibrates in rhythm with the pulse of pain in their mane. This ship, their command. To stand against what is coming. 

"The line of Te accepts." Te'Qal stands, raising their mane-tendrils as the golden-crowned sleeve lowers over them and enwraps their form. Data and feeling pour into perception, into control. Te'Qal feels dozens of ships taut at their command, like bladed waves cresting in the wind of Te'Qal's voice. 

"In service. For Seht." 

***** 

Te'Qal hangs suspended in their command sleeve aboard their flagship, two years wiser, having learned to guide the fleet's movements like amorphous ripples across magnetic fields. Now Te'Qal and their Captains react as one. Tendrils twist within sleeve and draw the fleet together. Fifty-three of the armada's finest far-reaching War-pearls drift into formation, their sleek horizontal teardrop shapes rendering them nearly invisible against surrounding space. 

Progress? The request awaits an answer. 

"The Se'Un Gate is ready to send the fleet, Warden." The voice resonates in Te'Qal's mind from the right flank of their fleet. Captain Je'Gana.  "There is no response from Se'Un Receiving." 

The Qugu system of Se'Un had fallen silent. There was fear. 

Te'Qal speaks to the fleet. "We do not jump in blindness. Our ancestors guide this fleet. We will see what has caused silence in the system of Se'Un and return them into concert with the Qugu. Forward." 

The fleet slips from Te'Qal's awareness ship by ship, into the folded space between points and out again, until finally the flagship follows them through to a far-off star. 

And there, upon the exodus, the fleet is met with a great yawning tear of nothing. It spans ten times the width of their numbers. Te'Qal's eyes catch something within the void. A gulf that in its deepest reaches burns with jade flame. 

:an Omen: 

:to swallow them all: 

Te'Qal tenses, and the fleet, feeling their apprehension, halts. Te'Qal listens, and the fleet boosts sensors, sending scans deep into the black. Those that probe the tear return no information. The gate behind them cools. 

"Je'Gana. Pel'Uma." Te'Qal draws the captains into shared concert. 

"It is empty," Je'Gana states flatly. "What is it? A gate?" 

"I cannot locate any planetary signal, nor ark-ship, nor groves," Pel'Uma's concern strains the connection. 

"I have seen. This is a doom we must avert." Te'Qal is firm, grounding the connection. "Pel'Uma, go to Sehta'Un. The elder of their grove will—" 

The tear shudders, sending a shockwave through the fleet. Hundreds of small objects surge forth from the tear, like sparks spitting from sharpened steel. Their trajectories appear random and inelegant until a massive vessel—a graven spinal corridor of obsidian and jade flame—breaches the tear. As it crashes into open space before Te'Qal, the sparks react and scream forward toward the Qugu ships. 

Te'Qal scatters the private concert and relays alerts to the fleet. 

Battle stations. 

The sleek hull plates of the Qugu War-pearls part to release dozens of drones: weapons, shielding, utility, they flock around each ship and form into tight-knit squadrons.  

Qugu fusion batteries charge and rip into the incoming swarm, disintegrating swaths of chitinous ships before the attackers close in. Te'Qal contorts sleeved tendrils and directs the fleet into a cloud formation—each captain's sub-command and drones a murmuration within the greater armada—united in fluid motion. They draw the tiny, bladed ships into crossfires and reduce them to ashes. 

Te'Qal turns the fleet's attention to the tear and the ship in front of it. 

Suddenly, dozens of obsidian vessels burst forth from the tear. Sheets of tiny Rippers dislodge from the larger vessels and cut across space toward the Qugu fleet, supported by salvos of axion volleys. 

Qugu fusion fusillades cull hundreds of tiny blades from the surge of approaching ships, but it is not enough to punch clear holes and target their supporting artillery. Te'Qal tries to guide the fleet through an upward arc over the incoming swarm, dodging heavy ordnance and tiny chitinous blades that peck at their flanks through torrents of retaliating fusion energy. 

:terror:pain:silence: 

One of the fleet is snuffed out. Te'Qal tightens their ranks against the bladed swarm and attempts to redirect fire to the larger ships, but their numbers are quickly beginning to pale to those of the invaders. They watch doom pour from the omen. Another wave of ripping blades blitz through the tear. The invasive surge overwhelms their armaments. 

Te'Qal detaches Pel'Uma to spool the gate home, then adjusts tactics. They draw drones in close to chain power between ships. They inhale, and fusion energy flows through the fleet into one unified beam that scatters the swarm of blades and splits two obsidian ships. Then another, and another… Shields fail across the fleet. 

:hope:hopelessness:extinguishment: 

Te'Qal feels Pel'Uma slip away as their ship is overtaken by a thousand blades, but the gate is ready. 

They would need the full might of the Qugu to stand against this horror.  

Retreat sounds across the fleet. Se'Un has fallen. 

They flee through the swarm, leaving wreckage and fire.
entries.text_zh:
特卡尔这个名字逐渐消失。未知的无尽未来矗立于黑暗中，红色的期待变成了滴落的记忆。 

在双颚合上的前一刻，现实直面心灵。理智恳求身体。 

每一根神经都在尖叫，却来不及从病毒般的吸引力中退却。 

命定的本能迫使着曲古靠近颚兽。割裂。偿还。在献祭之腹中改造，再度偿还。 

深饮甘露，吟诵… 

一切改变都是痛苦… 

… 

…阴霾笼罩着一座巨大的山。 

坚硬无比。 

它切开了天空。 

洪泛平原吞噬大山的影子，直达每一处地平线。点缀着苔藓的珊瑚林扎根于红沙和玉米条纹的石头中。富含地热淤泥的浅滩浸泡着芳香的地衣，流经侵蚀地基的地下水道，直到上方的地表下陷成遍布塞特星的沟槽。 

在山脚下的一个凹陷的山谷里，一个曲古奄奄一息。头足类动物的骨架下方是倒转的双足，被卷须状触手的流畅鬃毛包裹，胸前伸出一条单前肢…深黑色的眼睛暗示着联结——但原始、迷失而孤独。 

:特约那:独自呐喊:熄灭:古老的恐惧:共同的负担: 

这生物的双腿已经没有力气了，但血液中的某种力量驱使其向前进入一只巨大软体动物的口中。巨颚倏地闭合。鬃毛般的触手无力地摸索着，然后不再动弹。残骸漂上浅滩。生命离开肉体，重新聚集。它分裂、断裂，接着融合、缠绕。分解、孕育。死亡的树林苏醒了。时光流逝。特约那的腐化为这片小树林播下了种子。它汲取着山下这片幽暗水潭的养分。 

五个曲古从淤泥和暗影中升起。它们的存在一度灼灼生辉，后来黯淡无光。五个曲古虚弱地回到死亡之林，回到软体兽身边，受迫进入它的口中。它们的血肉化作花蜜。它们为这片树林重新播种。 

十几个星球环绕着一颗炽热的白色恒星旋转。曲古群漫步在开阔的洪泛平原上，沐浴着塞塔的星光觅食。它们通过迁徙找到了坠入大海的珊瑚边缘。它们寻找着方向；以仪式共生的方式将布满鬃毛的肢体献给山中的大软体动物——某种被神化的颚兽；带来幻象的甘露被采集、发酵和吸收。播下种子的死亡之树饱含花蜜。曲古的血脉在塞特的山谷深处刻下了深深的烙印。它们的存在穿越时空，通过意识、声音和行动的肉体不断回响。 

它们的子孙会回到珊瑚边缘，在深海中遨游，呼唤水下的颚兽浮出水面。这些神圣的野兽在山下获得了新的栖息地。许多循环过去了。一个由盐石、地衣和珊瑚构建的村落庇护着这群动物。随着时间的推移，许多这样的村庄出现在了山周围的浅滩上。  

死亡之林在淤泥中世代繁衍，新的树林逐渐成形，填满了方圆数英里的浅滩。树林锚定了村庄。村落发展成城市，与山相连，与海相接，高耸入云，在天空中播种。曲古的声音在共同的生存梦想中回响。远离恐惧和孤独的天堂。共同抱负的地平线。 

记忆和概念——是遥远的参照，是回响的警告，是指引的手。不断磨砺整体。活生生的轮回。 

现在，轮到了特卡尔。循环的表现。三个中的一个。它见过被四星点缀的天空，洞察甘露无数，经历了70年的危险。现在，它看到了其血脉，追溯至其起源；看到了特卡尔祖先的生命在面前交织和呈现。头顶上，星光黯淡，天空无垠。 

特卡尔专注于广阔的曲古血脉——倾听它们的声音，寻求指引。在最深的梦境中，特卡尔会体验它们的见闻，感受到它们温柔的牵引或推动。仿佛所有的行动都是根据它们的决定来进行的。曲古群包围着特卡尔。它们一起跨过洪泛平原。它们扭动着穿过海岩洞窟，一起奔跑在进化的道路上。  

曲古群停在了无星的天空下。特卡尔不禁多迈了几步——失去动力的感觉太突然了——它回头望去，把熟悉的面孔引向前方。侧耳倾听。 

曲古群在沉默中尖叫。它们的嘴巴大张，充满了濒临灭绝的恐惧。特卡尔从祖先血脉中转过身来，望向无星的天空。洪泛平原消失在悬崖和虚空中，无星的虚无滴落下来，覆盖了地平线。而在那里，在曲古血脉的尖端，特卡尔看到了一个尽头，一个寂静的悬崖，一个在虚无的天空中打着哈欠的巨大裂口，在山的上空若隐若现。  

一个预兆。 

裂痕。会将它们全部吞噬。 

一个使命的愿景。 

无数循环的顶点。 

关键的一步… 

… 

…特卡尔下沉到底部，然后伸展鬃毛卷须稳住自己。一条鲜红的血线从一处新断裂的卷须穴中流出；特卡尔失去的卷须多达15根。血淋淋的残根因疼痛而抽搐起来。音乐般的节拍震颤着其四肢，让特卡尔及时回到当前，听到了一个声音在叫它。 

“醒来吧，总长特卡尔。我们的祖先将知识托付给了你，塞特舰队的指挥权现在交给了特的血脉。” 

三位裹着贴身珠光华服的曲古长老站在特卡尔面前。它们的头上悬着一个印着金冠的指挥舱。这身金钵是意志的编织者，能将不同的意图融为一体。 

“起来接受这项重任。” 

一只巨大的颚兽冒着甘露的气泡，甘露的味道依然新鲜，它的外壳鲜血淋漓。上天的旨意充满了特卡尔的心。太空航行的嗡嗡声与它鬃毛上的阵阵疼痛有着相同的节奏。这艘飞船，由它掌控。以抵抗即将到来的一切。 

“特的血脉接受。”特卡尔站了起来，抬起鬃毛卷须，金色的指挥舱垂下，包裹住它的形态。数据和感觉涌入感知，融入控制。特卡尔能感受到麾下的数十艘战舰，在它的命令下，像利刃一般划过强风。 

“愿为塞特效劳。” 

***** 

特卡尔悬停在旗舰的指挥舱里，历经两年的智慧积累，学会了指挥舰队的行动，就像在磁场中的无定形波动一样。现在，特卡尔和它的船长们反应如一。卷须在指挥舱里缠绕，将舰队牵引到一起。舰队中五十三艘最精锐的远洋战舰进入了编队，光滑扁平的水滴造型使它们几乎无法被看见。 

有进展吗？请求正等待答复。 

“塞恩之门已经准备好派出舰队了，总长。”这个声音从舰队右翼的杰加纳船长那里传来，在特卡尔的脑海中回荡。“塞恩那边没有回答。” 

曲古疆域中的塞恩星系没有回应。恐惧在蔓延。 

特卡尔向舰队喊话。“我们不会盲目跳跃。我们的祖先指引着这支舰队。我们要看看是什么让塞恩星系陷入沉寂，并让它回到曲古的控制下。前进。” 

战舰一艘接一艘地离开特卡尔的意识，进入点与点之间的折叠空间随后再出来，直到旗舰最终跟着它们穿过，来到一颗遥远的恒星。 

抵达后，舰队的前方空无一物。这片虚无比它们要巨大得多。特卡尔在虚空中注意到了什么。那是一道深不见底的鸿沟，其中冒着翠绿的火焰。 

:一个预兆: 

:会将它们全部吞噬: 

特卡尔绷紧了神经，舰队感受到它的不安，停了下来。特卡尔倾听着，舰队的传感器也随之增强，对黑暗深处进行扫描。探测鸿沟的信号没有返回任何信息。它们身后的星门冷却了下来。 

“杰加纳，佩乌玛。”特卡尔把船长们叫进了思维共享。 

“这里是空的，”杰加纳平淡地陈述道。“这是什么？一道星门吗？” 

“我找不到任何行星信号，也没有移民船和树林，”佩乌玛的担忧，使联结变得有些紧绷。 

“我见过这景象。我们必须避免这样的毁灭。”特卡尔坚毅地说道，联结安抚了下来。“佩乌玛，去塞塔恩。它们的树林长老会——” 

裂痕忽然一闪，舰队被一道冲击波击中。数以百计的小物体从裂痕中喷涌而出，就像锋利的刀刃迸出火花一般。它们的轨迹随意而粗暴，直到一艘巨大的飞船——由黑曜石和绿色火焰构筑出的细长走廊——冲破裂痕。就在它闯进特卡尔面前的开阔太空之际，那些火花也作出反应，尖叫着冲向曲古飞船。 

特卡尔中断了思维共享，向舰队发出了警戒命令。 

全员进入战斗位置。 

曲古战舰光滑的甲板开启，释放出数十架无人机：武器型、护盾型、功能型，它们围绕着每艘飞船，组成了紧密的队形。  

曲古的聚变炮台充能并撕裂了来袭的敌群，在攻击者靠近之前瓦解了大批的甲壳飞船。特卡尔将卷须缠绕一处，指挥舰队形成云状阵型——每个船长的分指挥舱和无人机都是这个大舰队的组成部分——以流畅的轨迹联结起来。它们将带刃的小船卷入交叉火力中，把它们化为灰烬。 

特卡尔将舰队的注意力转移到了裂痕和它前方的舰船。 

突然，数十艘黑曜石般的战舰从裂痕中冲出。成片的撕裂者从大飞船上脱落，在一连串轴离子炮弹的支援下穿过太空，冲向曲古舰队。 

曲古的聚变弹幕击落了成群飞船中的数百架撕裂者，但这还不足以打出缺口，瞄准它们的支援火炮。特卡尔试图引导舰队向上飞越汹涌而来的机群，躲避重型炮弹，并通过聚变能量洪流消灭其侧翼的壳质撕裂者。 

:恐惧:痛苦:静默: 

舰队中有一艘舰船被歼灭了。特卡尔以密集阵型抵御着刀片般的机群，并试图将火力转向较大的飞船，但舰队很快就寡不敌众。它眼睁睁地看着厄运从预兆中降临。又一波撕裂者从裂痕里冲出。入侵的巨浪淹没了它的武器。 

特卡尔让佩乌玛离开阵型，准备开启星门，然后调整了战术。它将无人机布置在舰船中间，以链接其能量。它一呼吸，聚变能量便穿过舰队，汇聚成一道光束，打散了撕裂者群，切开了两艘黑曜石舰船。一道，接着一道…舰队的护盾纷纷失能。 

:希望:绝望:熄灭: 

特卡尔感到了佩乌玛在近千撕裂者的围攻下消逝，但星门已经准备就绪。 

它们需要曲古的全部力量来抵挡这些可怕的敌人。  

舰队开始撤退。塞恩已经陷落。 

它们穿过成群的撕裂者逃亡，身后尽是残骸和火焰。

entries.name: Chapter 2 – To Split the Sky
entries.text:
Hive horrors desolate every world in the Se'Tar system before they come for Seht, home world of the Qugu. They split the sky above the great Mountain. Tomb Ships and Rippers spill from the tear. Endless, their assaults erode the diminishing might of the united Qugu armada. 

Te'Qal commands all remaining Qugu fighters in one massive fleet. Thousands of war craft concentrated above Seht's planetary defense installations to secure their sacred Mountain groves. It was enough to deter a frontal assault, enough to protect the final stages of Seht's evacuation. 

Hive and Qugu battlegroups skirmish just outside Seht's Karman line, just outside the range of hundreds of ground-based rail cannons. Te'Qal maneuvers the Qugu fleet to prod at Hive flanks without advancing on them. They must be cautious not to overcommit and be enveloped by the throng of Hive ships emerging from the tear. They want to draw the Hive outward from the planet to deter, to scatter, before folding back to the safety of their own defensive installations; larger destroyers exchange heavy fire with Tomb Ships, swarms of Hive Rippers chase dancing Qugu murmurations that beam searing fusion energy in twisting displays. 

It is a distracting spectacle that will not last. 

Below the blockade of war vessels, Qugu ark-ships gouge acres of grove land from the surface of Seht, lifting their sacred soil and ferrying it to the other side of the planet to await escort from danger. They prepare to journey to the last remaining gate, one that will take the Qugu to a new star. 

Te'Qal manipulates tendrils within their command sleeve and watches large craft and individual combat-sleeve pilots fly in tandem; Te'Qal lives their experiences from the frenzy of battle to the deadened hopelessness of silence. They feel a warship buckling under axion bombardments, and focus their intent upon its battlegroup, weaving combat-sleeve fighters and shield drones between the warship and several aggressing Tomb Ships. Te'Qal projects their presence through the combat sleeve of a dead captain and leads a squadron on a counter run against incoming Hive Rippers. They assess the balance as the warship shifts deeper into the safety of their murmuration, to be replaced by fresher guns from the interior fleet. 

"Why do they not commit their entire force?" Je'Gana asks impatiently, in concert with Te'Qal. Their ship poised near the center of the command fleet. "They must know by now their numbers can overwhelm our installations." 

"They do not attack because they do not have to. They lay wait-traps to bleed us. Are you so eager?" Te'Qal feels Je'Gana's thirst for vengeance. "We defend the groves." 

"And sacrifice Seht." Je'Gana's bitterness furrows Te'Qal's beak. "I feel them dying too." 

Te'Qal lets the battle fade from their eyes and looks to the distant ark-ships collecting groves on Seht. "I once thought I was destined to avert this doom. But I mistook that guidance. I was only meant to prepare us for it." Te'Qal impresses this perspective onto Je'Gana through the Will-weaver. "Victory is never of singular meaning. Seht will burn. The Qugu may continue, together." 

"If we press now…" Je'Gana pushes back, eyeing the growing reserve of Hive ships slipping through the tear. "Implode the Omen as we did above—" 

A Hive flagship breaches the tear. A circlet of bleached white bone, shaped by death and cunning. 

The strange ship moves to settle high above the Mountain of Seht, Tomb Ships change course to buffer its advance into the atmosphere as runes of jade flame burst around them, dissolving into obfuscating smoke. 

Qugu planetary rail cannons open fire, shredding any Tomb Ships bold enough to skirt the atmosphere and position themselves between their flagship and Seht. Amidst the destruction, the Hive flagship begins amassing a singularity of soulfire at its hollow center. 

In the chaos between rail-cannon volleys, Te'Qal sees a break in the Tomb Ship lines and directs hundreds of combat sleeves through the opening like a fusion spear. The ring ship releases legions of Rippers and their forces become entangled in battle, but enough of an opening is held to maneuver the armada's right flank into the gap like a fulcrum. Te'Qal applies pressure; hails of fusion beam energy trade blows with a storm of axion projectiles raining from the enemy ships. When evenly matched in numbers, Te'Qal's superior tactics pick the Hive forces apart. Their efforts pry the defensive Hive line open wide enough for the Qugu rail cannons to thread shots at the circlet-shaped flagship. 

Te'Qal directs a command group to plunge below the Hive ships, pivot, and surge upward through their center to sever them from reinforcements. If they can isolate the flagship, hold it within range of their rail cannons for only a few minutes, it could be enough to bring it down and halt the assault. 

For a moment, this idea holds true. The Hive forces are bisected. Their reinforcements rout and scatter as Tomb Ships fall to Seht's vengeful rail-cannon fire. Te'Qal is careful to keep their most distant ships close enough to recall to the main fleet should the Hive turn and counter. 

The Hive flagship detonates its collected soulfire without warning, sending a shockwave through its own ships, the Qugu fleet, and the planet Seht. Hundreds of ships are lost in the wave, Hive and Qugu alike, while those that remain intact struggle to repower their systems. 

On the surface of Seht, the Mountain quakes. Great slabs of encrusted stone slough from its sides and crash into the sacred death-groves below, burying the defensive installations and last few ark-ships still diligently working to save their ancestral grounds. 

As dust settles, the Mountain shows a new face of deep black skin with carved trenches of resonating energy. A pulse blasts from the Mountain's base, razing the surrounding landscape and decimating the heart of Qugu civilization. The thing the Hive had torn from the Mountain groans as it slowly lifts into the sky, rising to meet the Hive flagship. 

Te'Qal wrestles order back to the fleet and reconsolidates their forces, assuming direct control of entire battlegroups where necessary. The sight of Seht's upended crust burns into Te'Qal's memory. Gaps in the fleet meet Te'Qal with their absence. The silence from the surface washes over them. Te'Qal realizes they no longer feel Je'Gana.  The old, lonely, fear trickles between beats of silence. 

The invasion advances toward the rising, dark, pyramid that was once the Mountain. They blare roaring jubilation from their ships, howling at the desecration of the Qugu Mountain. As the Hive descend upon Seht, Te'Qal orders a retreat. 

Frozen in extinguishing fear, in the silent scream of sacrilegious abandonment, in the paralytic end, the Qugu leave what remains of Seht to the Hive.
entries.text_zh:
在攻打曲古的母星塞特之前，邪魔族已经毁灭了塞塔星系内的每一个世界。他们劈开大山上方的天空。棺舰和撕裂者从裂痕溢出。无穷无尽的攻击消耗着曲古联合舰队不断衰弱的力量。 

特卡尔将所有剩余的曲古战机组成了一支庞大的舰队。数以千计的战机集中在塞特行星防御设施的上方，以保护它们神圣的树林。这支舰队足以阻挡正面攻击，足以保护撤离塞特的最后阶段。 

邪魔族和曲古战斗群在塞特的卡曼防线外短兵相接，正好处于数百门地面天选轨道炮的射程之外。特卡尔指挥曲古舰队向邪魔族侧翼突袭，但不向前推进。它必须小心谨慎，以免投入过多兵力后被从裂痕涌出的邪魔族战舰包围。它要把邪魔族从星球上引开，以起到威慑和驱散作用，然后再折回到自己安全的防御设施中；大型驱逐舰与棺舰激烈交火，邪魔族撕裂者机群追逐着舞动的曲古舰阵，后者在扭曲的幻象中不断发射着灼热的聚变能量。 

这个引开敌人注意的方法长久不了。 

在战舰的封锁之下，为了逃离危险，曲古移民船从塞特星的表面挖出成亩小树林，以将它们的圣土搬走，运送到星球的另一边。它们准备依靠最后一道传送门，前往一颗新的恒星。 

特卡尔在指挥舱内操纵卷须，看着大型飞船和战机的飞行员协同飞行；特卡尔体验着其经历，从战斗的狂热到绝望的死寂。它感觉到一艘战舰在轴离子轰击下摇摇欲坠，于是将注意力集中到战舰的战斗群上。在战舰和几艘咄咄逼人的棺舰之间，穿梭着战机和护盾无人机。特卡尔通过一位阵亡船长的战舰投射出自己，带领一个中队反击袭来的邪魔族撕裂者。当战舰回到己方阵中的安全地带，被内部舰队修整完毕的战舰接替时，它对敌我实力进行了评估。 

“它们为何不投入全部兵力？”杰加纳在特卡尔的思维共享中焦急地问道。它的飞船泊停到了指挥舰队的中心附近。“它们肯定知道，它们现在能靠数量冲垮我们的防御。” 

“它们不进攻是因为没有那个必要。它们设下陷阱，打算慢慢放光我们的血。你等不及了吗？”特卡尔感到了杰加纳的复仇之火。“我们要守住树林。” 

“然后牺牲塞特。”杰加纳的不甘让特卡尔抿起了嘴。“我也能感到它们的逝去。” 

特卡尔让战斗从眼前消退，遥望着在塞特星上采集树林的移民船。“我曾以为我注定会阻止这场厄运到来。但我误解了这一指引。我的存在只是为了让我们做好准备。”特卡尔通过意志编织者将这一观点灌输给了杰加纳。“并非只有击败敌人才是胜利。塞特将被焚毁，但曲古还可以生存下去。” 

“如果我们现在施加压力…”杰加纳看着不断穿过裂痕、数量逐渐增加的邪魔族舰船，反对道。“就像我们过去那样引爆预兆——” 

一艘邪魔族旗舰穿过了裂痕。一圈漂白的白骨，由死亡和狡诈塑造而成。 

这艘奇特的飞船停到塞特圣山的上空，棺舰们改变了航向以缓冲其进入大气层的速度，绿色的火焰符文在它们周围迸发化作障眼的烟雾。 

曲古星的轨道炮开火将那些胆敢绕过大气层、飞到其旗舰和塞特之间的棺舰炸得粉碎。在一片毁灭中，邪魔族旗舰开始在舰体中空的奇点积聚灵魂之火。 

在轨道炮轰击造成的混乱中，特卡尔发现了棺舰中的突破口，并指挥数百只战机像融合长矛一般穿过了这个缺口。环形飞船释放出的撕裂者机群和邪魔族部队混在一起，但仍有足够的空隙让舰队的右翼像箭头一样插入缺口。特卡尔开始施压；聚变光束能量与敌方飞船倾泻而下的轴离子火力交织在一起。在数量相当的情况下，特卡尔的高超战术将邪魔族部队打得四分五裂。它在邪魔族的防线上撬开了一道缺口，使曲古的轨道炮能够对环形的旗舰进行射击。 

特卡尔派出一个指挥小组从邪魔族飞船的下方突入，再从其中心向上突进，以切断它们与增援部队的联系。如果它能孤立旗舰，将其困在轨道炮射程内几分钟，就足以击毁它并阻止攻势。 

这个策略看样子有成功的机会。邪魔族部队已被一分为二。它们的援军溃败，四散奔逃，棺舰被塞特复仇的轨道炮火挨个击毁。特卡尔小心翼翼地将最远的飞船保持在离主力舰队足够近的距离，以便在邪魔族反击时将其召回。 

邪魔族旗舰在毫无征兆的情况下引爆了它聚集的灵魂之火，在它自己的战舰、曲古舰队和塞特星间造成了一股冲击波。数以百计的飞船被击毁。邪魔族和曲古的部队均遭到波及。那些未受损的都在拼命重启系统。 

在塞特星的表面，大山颤抖着。巨大的石板从山体两侧滑落，坠入山下神圣的死亡之林，掩埋了防御设施和最后几艘仍在努力拯救祖先土地的移民飞船。 

尘埃落定后，圣山露出了新的面容：其深黑色的外壳上被刻满了能量共振的壕沟。一股脉冲从山底喷射而出，夷平周围的一切，毁灭了曲古文明的核心。邪魔族从圣山中扯下的东西呻吟着被拉向空中，迎向邪魔族的旗舰。 

特卡尔努力让舰队恢复秩序，并试图重新整合部队，必要时直接控制整个战斗群。它的记忆中烙下了塞特地壳被颠覆的景象。特卡尔注意到了舰队中因人员缺席而留下的空隙。地表上的寂静笼罩着它。特卡尔意识到已经感觉不到杰加纳的存在。古老而孤独的恐惧在沉寂的心跳间蔓延着。 

入侵部队朝着不断上升、曾是大山的黑暗金字塔推进。他们在飞船上高声欢呼，对着遭到亵渎的曲古山大肆咆哮。邪魔族开始降落到塞特星上，而特卡尔只得下令撤退。 

凝固在灭亡的恐惧中，凝固在亵渎抛弃的无声尖叫中，凝固在麻痹的终结中，曲古把塞特星的残骸留给了邪魔族。

entries.name: Chapter 3 – The Cry that Echoes
entries.text:
Seht burns, and the armada drifts in ruin. 

Te'Qal guides what remains of the Qugu toward the last operational jump gate to their last safe star. They do not leave their command sleeve for the weeks-long duration of the journey. They have addressed the fleet many times, sought to bolster morale, to give them hope—what hope existed. Their speeches hang in concert but have no presence in the mind of the fleet. As repairs are completed to ships too damaged to continue, the rest wait to jump. 

Tired tendrils slip from the command sleeve as it unwraps from Te'Qal's body. Their legs and forelimb tentacle numbly fold against the ground as atmospheric waste expels from hissing tubes that suspend the sleeve. The command chamber is small. Te'Qal lays in a circular perforated indentation in the floor. Most of the surrounding housing maintains the sleeve, and keeps the Warden alive, alert. The remainder of the ship houses drones, support systems, and automated functions.  

Exhaustion keeps Te'Qal motionless, centered in the indentation in the floor, the fleet orbiting around them. They need rest. Sustenance. But most of all they need guidance. 

Isolated from an ark-ship in which to seek the ceremony of a jaw-beast, Te'Qal depresses a plate in the floor and releases a mist of nectar into the command chamber. The name Te'Qal begins to fade, but as they dream, they hold it in their mind… 

… 

…They stand across a dark, domed room fifty paces from Te'Daru: the Qugu whose tentacle pulled Te'Qal from the silt. Who taught them to commune with the line of warriors and become a banshee shrieking across space. They recited the legends that tamed foreign stars. 

"What do you intend to do, Te'Qal?" Te'Dura's voice echoes through the dim room. Between them a large holographic display clarified from the dark blur of unfocused memory. Two fleets oppose each other in the display, one is surrounded. Te'Qal looks to Te'Dura again, now wrapped in a command sleeve. "Do you concede?" 

"No." Te'Qal remembers this day. They defeated a superior officer and earned command. This was a test they were intended to fail.  

"No?" Te'Dura asks, flicking a tendril to motion their ships closer. "To the last then?" 

"I remember this. You believed I would concede, and closed in, then I detonated my fleet and took yours with it." 

Suddenly Te'Dura was beside them. "Another form of victory." 

"I've failed us. I did not understand our ancestor's warning," Te'Qal whispers.

"Then listen closer," Te'Dura says. "This," they gesture with a tentacle. "An unwinnable scenario…" 

The display shifts to a different theater. 

"This," Te'Dura begins. 

"Murin invasion, at the outer rim," Te'Qal finishes, now viewing twenty incoming carriers from a command sleeve. 

"Our line of Te, your ships, broke them." Te'Dura's voice cuts cleanly through the dream. "Your maneuvers… 

Te'Qal strains to maintain control over dozens of war-pearls.  The aggressors chase Te'Qal's unpiloted ghost fleet across space, distracted, as other Qugu-piloted combat sleeves sabotage each Murin carrier one by one. 

"…lone-flew the battlegroup. How many others can do so? And when at last you engage them…"  Te'Dura exudes a wheezing laughter. "Their fighters won't launch. Their weapons overheat. Their shields lose power. One battle and war-tides turn." 

Te'Qal coils and flicks their mane-tendrils in consideration. "I have won great battles. They do not come without sacrifices. I have averted great losses by inflicting my own, but these Hive…" 

The display shifts to a different theater. 

Te'Dura pays Te'Qal's doubts no mind. 

Te'Qal drifts through space within a thin, bloodied, combat sleeve. Mechanized tendrils still hot with fusion discharge. "When the gate fell silent…" 

"Se'Tar lost concert with Se'Ugn. The Qugu fractured. I felt it bring despair to your spirit, as I said to you then."  Te'Dura says. "Years of existing out of concert drove them to uprising. Your decisiveness ended it, your diplomacy forged peace. It is why you were made Warden." 

Te'Qal remembers their decisiveness differently. A clandestine detachment of combat sleeves. A raid of burning spears. "You remind me." 

"Not because you forget, but because you have been hopeless before." Te'Dura rears into a taller posture. "There is victory in that darkness. A kind. Find it." 

***** 

The fleet passes through the gate a few vessels at a time. As each ship slips from Te'Qal's awareness, tiny etchings incised into the gate flare with jade flame.  

Te'Qal slips through the gate and exits into wreckage and confusion. Ark-ships fracture and implode as holy ground bleeds into the vacuum. 

At the other end of the gate they did not find the last Qugu star of Se'Otan, but instead a wall of Hive Tomb Ships surrounding their bone white flagship, flanked by the Qugu's desecrated Mountain, now a black void of malice carved into the fabric of space. 

:oldfear: 

In the shadow of the Pyramid, Te'Qal grasps the fleet through the command sleeve, and rallies their captains and battlegroups into defensive murmurations around the remaining ark-ships. Fusion beams cut in every direction, Hive Rippers pierce Qugu warships and combat sleeves like screaming needles. Behind them, the gate is nowhere to be seen. There is no tear, no exit through which to flee. Before them the Hive ships outnumber their fleet hundreds to one. A strange realm—a mirror of reality—encompasses them. 

Dozens of Hive ships fall and countless Rippers burn for every Qugu vessel lost, but attrition does not favor them. Te'Qal holds the fleet against the horror of the Hive, but their strength wanes. Te'Qal wades through the silence of his ancestors' fear. 

Suddenly, a dreaded pillar of darkness—another Hive ship—tears through the nothing of space and bursts into the fray, crashing through several Tomb Ships and dashing them against its hull. Hive ships turn to confront it as it barrels directly for their bone-ring flagship. 

The two massive vessels exchange destructive barrages of fire, decimating all other surrounding ships in thundering bombardments of soulfire cannons and axion bolts. The pillar-ship emits a thin pulse, as the dark Pyramid had done as it burst forth from the Mountain on Seht. The pulse slices through the ring ship like a cleaver; waves of green fire erupting through its hull. 

Te'Qal, seizing the moment, capitalizes on the distraction. They draw in all remaining Qugu vessels and press forward toward the Pyramid. 

Te'Qal communes their intention to the fleet and maneuvers them into a valiant charge. If they could not destroy the Hive, they would take back the Mountain. Te'Qal places themself at the point of the assault. Qugu ships snap into formation behind them. Te'Qal draws the entirety of the fleet into concert to hear their voice, their words impel the charge into being. 

"For Seht." 

The armada surges, agile combat sleeves racing ahead to clear a path for the larger host of ships. Te'Qal feels the presence of the Qugu line, extending back to the first. They move as one, weaving between ship-fire and debris. Te'Qal closes their eyes to feel the fleet through the tension of their link. Te'Qal reaches beyond them, to the death-grove cores of the ark-ships, to their ancestral line. To those whose memories they carry with them. The Darkness that binds them resonates through the fleet. 

Te'Qal flexes their tendrils and commands the deployment of all drones in attack mode. The Qugu collapse to form a phalanx and drive forward to impale the cursed thing that was their Mountain. Te'Qal calls to their ancestors, drawing their energy from the ark-ships and into the fleet, fusing the beam with ancient power.  

"Guide our fire." 

The Darkness-linked fury of generations turns the beam Resonant. It strikes true, impaling the Pyramid's obscene hull in a fatal wound. Their final stand forever branded into the Pyramid's flesh. 

The Hive battle falls silent. 

A flash of orange. 

With the Pyramid's dying wail, Te'Qal feels the presence of their ancestors, not as a distant guide, but as equals. The Resonance wave washes over them, and Te'Qal hears voices as if echoing from a dream, "Noble Commander, do not fade. Take our hand and find Salvation."  

They see the line of their people extend through them, through all Qugu, through Darkness, and death, and memory. All swept into an obliterating Echo. And then nothing. 

They extinguish, together.
entries.text_zh:
塞特星被焚毁，舰队苟延残喘。 

特卡尔带领着剩余的曲古驶向最后一个完好的星门，驶向曲古最后一颗安全的恒星。它在这几周的旅程里一次也没有离开过指挥舱。它曾多次向舰队发表讲话，试图鼓舞士气，给所有人带来希望——仅存的希望。它的演说铿锵有力，但在舰队的脑海中却毫无存在感。受损严重、无法继续航行的飞船逐渐完成修复，剩下的战舰则等待着迁跃。 

特卡尔的身体从指挥舱里解开，疲惫的卷须从中滑落。它的腿和前肢触手麻木地贴在地面上，废气从悬挂着指挥舱的管道中嘶嘶排出。指挥室很小。特卡尔躺在地板上一个圆形的凹陷中。周围大部分舱室的目的都是维护指挥室，让总长保持活力和警觉。飞船的其余部分装载着无人机、支持系统和自动化功能。  

特卡尔疲惫得动弹不得，卧在地面凹陷处中心，被舰队环绕。它需要休息。需要养分。但它最需要的是引导。 

为了进行颚兽的仪式，特卡尔被隔离在一艘移民飞船上。它踩下了地板上的一块板子，以向指挥室释放出甘露之雾。特卡尔这个名字开始逐渐消失，但当它做梦的时候，它会牢牢记住这个名字… 

… 

…它站在一个黑暗的圆顶房间里，距离特杜拉五十步远：是这位曲古的触手把特卡尔从淤泥中拉了出来。是它教会了特卡尔如何与战士们交流，如何成为在太空中嘶吼的女妖。是它吟诵了驯服异星的传说。 

“你想怎么做，特卡尔？”特杜拉的嗓音在昏暗的房间里回荡。在它们之间，一个巨大的全息显示屏从黑暗模糊的记忆中清晰起来。显示屏上有两支舰队正在对峙，而其中一支被包围了。特卡尔再次看向特杜拉，它现在被包裹于指挥舱中。“你要认输吗？” 

“不。”特卡尔记得这一天。它击败了一位长官，赢得了指挥权。这是一场它本应输掉的考验。  

“不？”特杜拉甩着卷须，指挥舰队靠了过来。“要战斗到最后一刻？” 

“我还记得。你以为我会认输，所以靠了过来。然后我下令舰队自毁，与你同归于尽。” 

忽然间，特杜拉来到了它的身边。“这也是一种胜利。” 

“我辜负了所有人。我没有理解我们祖先的警告，”特卡尔小声说道。

“那就听更仔细些，”特杜拉说。“这种情况，”它用卷须做了个手势。“是赢不了的…” 

显示屏上出现了另一个战场。 

“而这种，”特杜拉说道。 

“姆宁入侵，星系外环，”特卡尔补充道。它从指挥舱中看到了二十艘敌军航母。 

“吾等特之血脉，你的舰队，击溃了它们。”特杜拉的嗓音贯穿了整个梦境。“你的策略…” 

特卡尔勉强操纵着数十艘战舰。敌军追着特卡尔的无人诱饵舰队在深空中穿梭，并未注意其他由曲古驾驶的战机正在逐个破坏姆宁航母。 

“…一人操纵整个战斗群。有多少人能做到这点？而且在你最后交战时…”特杜拉喘息着发出笑声。“它们的战斗机无法升空。它们的武器过热。它们的护盾没有能量。仅凭一战就扭转了战争局面。” 

特卡尔向后退去，在思考的同时甩动着鬃毛卷须。“我赢得了许多场大战。每场战斗都有牺牲。我通过先发制敌避免了许多损失，但这些邪魔族…” 

显示屏上出现了另一个战场。 

特杜拉没有理会特卡尔的怀疑。 

特卡尔被裹在一个薄薄的、沾满鲜血的战斗舱中，在太空中飘荡。机械化的卷须在聚变放电后依然炙热。“当星门陷入沉寂时…” 

“塞塔与塞恩失去了联系。曲古散落四方。我当时向你说这句话时，感受到了你内心的绝望。”特杜拉说。“数年间的不合拍让它们举兵反叛。你果断行动，结束了叛乱，利用外交手段铸造了和平。这便是你被提拔为总长的原因。” 

特卡尔记忆中的果断有些不同。那是一小股潜入敌后的战机。烈焰长矛的突袭。“你让我想起来了。” 

“不是因为你忘记了，而是因为你曾经绝望过。”特杜拉挺直了高大的身板。“暗影中隐藏着胜利。某种形式的胜利。找到它吧。” 

***** 

星门一次只能让舰队中的几艘船穿过。每当一艘飞船从特卡尔的意识中消失时，门上细小的刻痕就会燃起翠绿的火焰。  

特卡尔穿过星门，却只看到了残骸和困惑。碎裂的移民船与圣地的土壤一同在真空中飘荡。 

在星门的另一端，它没有看见曲古最后的塞奥坦星，而是一堵由邪魔族棺舰组成的高墙，它们的白骨旗舰正被这堵墙团团围住。一侧是已被刻进宇宙本身，化作虚空恶意象征的、被亵渎的曲古圣山。 

:古老的恐惧: 

在金字塔的阴影下，特卡尔通过指挥舱集结剩余的船长和战斗群，在剩余的移民船周围组成了防御阵型。聚变光束向四周射去，邪魔族撕裂者像尖叫的针头一般穿透了曲古战舰和战机。在它们的身后，星门不见踪影。没有裂痕，没有退路。在它们面前，是百倍数量的邪魔族战舰。一个奇异的疆域——现实的镜子——笼罩着它们。 

邪魔族击毁一艘曲古战舰的代价是数十艘邪魔族战舰和无数的撕裂者，但曲古舰队经不起这样的消耗。特卡尔指挥着舰队抵抗邪魔族的猛攻，但它们的力量在不断变弱。特卡尔在祖先恐惧的寂静中艰难前行。 

突然，一根可怕的暗影之柱——另一艘邪魔族飞船——撕裂虚无的太空闯进战场，用船体撞毁了数艘棺舰，直奔骨环旗舰而去。邪魔族飞船将炮口对准了这名不速之客。 

两艘巨大的战舰互射着毁灭性的炮火，灵魂之火和轴离子雷鸣般的轰击摧毁了周围的所有战舰。柱状飞船发射出一记细薄的脉冲，与黑暗金字塔从塞特圣山中出现时的情形如出一辙。脉冲像砍刀一般划过环形飞船；船体上喷发出了绿色的火浪。 

特卡尔抓住这个瞬间，利用了敌人的分心。它集结起所有剩余的曲古飞船，开始向金字塔推进。 

特卡尔与舰队交流了它的意图，组织起了一场英勇的冲锋。就算它们无法消灭邪魔族，它们也要夺回圣山。特卡尔将自己布置在了进攻的矛头。曲古战舰迅速在它后方列阵。特卡尔引导整个舰队进入思维共享聆听它的声音，它的话语促成了这场冲锋。 

“为了塞特。” 

整个舰队一齐向前突进，灵活的战机在前方为大船开辟道路。特卡尔感受到了曲古的血脉，一直延伸到第一位祖先。它们化作一体，在战舰炮火和残骸间穿梭。特卡尔闭上眼睛，通过心灵的联系感受舰队。特卡尔的意识延伸到了它们之外，延伸到了移民船的死亡之林核心，延伸到了它的祖先那里。它的记忆与它们同在。联系它们的暗影之力在舰队中产生了共鸣。 

特卡尔动了动它的卷须，命令以攻击模式部署所有无人机。曲古舰队的阵型变为了密集的枪阵，刺向它们被亵渎的圣山。特卡尔呼唤着它的祖先，从移民船中汲取能量传递给整个舰队，用古老的力量融合着光束。  

“引导我们射击吧。” 

世代相传的暗影之怒使光束共振起来。它击中了金字塔的骇人船体，造成了致命伤。它们的背水一战永远铭刻在了金字塔上。 

邪魔族之战停息了。 

一道橙色的闪光。 

随着金字塔垂死的哀鸣，特卡尔感受到了祖先的存在，不是作为遥远的指引，而是平等相待。共振波冲刷着它，特卡尔听到了仿佛在梦境中回响的声音：“高贵的指挥官，别化为虚无。牵着我们的手，寻找救赎。”  

它看见族人的血脉穿过自己，穿过所有曲古，穿过暗影、死亡和记忆。一切都被湮没在回响中。然后化为虚无。 

它们一同熄灭了。

entries.name: Acheron I
entries.text:
Everything is a question of survival. 

How do I live? 

How do I satiate my hunger, my thirst? How do I protect myself from predators? How do I shelter from the storm? For a long, long time, our people asked only this. We fought to separate life from death by as great a span as we could. Even when we had made our homeworld a garden of peace and plenty, the question of survival never ended, only changed. How do my genes, my works, even the memories of me, live on? The same question as always. 

How do I live? 

We solved the problems of deprivation, disease, age, memory loss, death. We weren't the only ones to find these answers, of course. Others followed in our footsteps or blazed their own paths. If that was really the answer to the question, we wouldn't be here now, and neither would you. 

You're still trying to solve the problem, after all. You fight and build and live and die, and always you struggle against your opposition. The predator, the parasite, the illness, the chance storm, the slow collective forgetting of your art and history, the death of a star, the heat death of the universe. You must live longer, be stronger, think quicker, and still there is something waiting to take everything from you, always. Always.  

So you have to keep getting better, and better, until you are perfect. Until you are, and cannot be anything else, because there never was anything else. Until you, inevitably, are the final shape.  

We didn't come to destroy you. Those poor, short-lived sisters—we did try to explain, you know, but they never grew past thinking of finality as a game where only one could live. A misunderstanding, as useful as it was foolish. We see the universe more broadly. The final shape is more than a single life, a single thought. It is all-encompassing, all-embracing. It is everything. You are part of everything, are you not? So now we have come to ask you for your answer, the only answer to the only question. 

How will you live?
entries.text_zh:
一切都是生存问题。 

我该如何生存？ 

我该如何满足饥渴？如何保护自己免受捕食者的侵害？如何躲避风暴？长久以来，我们的人民只有这些要求。我们尽所能将生死分隔开来。即使我们已经把家园建设成了和平富饶的花园，生存问题也从未结束，只是发生了变化。我的基因、我的作品，甚至我的记忆，该如何延续下去？这个问题一如既往。 

我该如何生存？ 

我们解决了贫困、疾病、衰老、记忆力衰退和死亡等问题。当然，并不是只有我们找到了这些答案。其他人追随我们的脚步，或开辟了自己的道路。如果那真的就是问题的答案，我们现在就不会在这里了，你也不会。 

毕竟，你还在努力解决问题。你战斗、建设、生存、死亡，你总是在与对手抗争。捕食者、寄生虫、疾病、偶有的风暴、对你们艺术和历史渐渐的集体遗忘、恒星的死亡、宇宙的热寂。你必须活得更久、更强大、思维更敏捷，但仍有一些东西在等着夺走你的一切，一直如此。永远如此。  

因此，你必须不断进步，不断完善，直至完美。直到你臻于完美，不可能是其他任何别的什么，因为从来就没有其他任何选项。直到你不可避免地成为终焉之形。  

我们不是来毁灭你的。那些可怜的短命姐妹们——我们确实试着向她们解释过，但她们始终认为定局是一场只有一个人能存活下来的游戏。这种误解既愚蠢又实用。我们看到的宇宙更加辽阔宽广。终焉之形不仅仅是一条生命、一种思想。它包罗万象，无所不容。它就是万物。你是万物的一部分，不是吗？所以，现在我们来问问你的答案，那个唯一问题的唯一答案。 

你会如何生存？

entries.name: Acheron II
entries.text:
In my past life, I was a gardener. 

Not that Gardener. Don't be cheeky.  

No, I grew flowers. I tilled soil. I planted seeds and bulbs and rootstock. I gave them water and nutrients. I dug out the weeds and shooed off the pests. In all my centuries, my greatest achievement was a kind of tree that bore fifty-eight types of fruit, that never went dormant, and always flourished with flowers and leaves, every day of every season. It pollinated itself, resisted its own pests, and thrived bare-rooted on rock or watered with pure acid. I had been planning to tweak its genetic code with learnings of trees from some forgotten system which grew in a vacuum. To bring it a little closer to its final shape. But there was no time, before we unmade ourselves. 

It's been a long time since then. Maybe the weeds and rot finally got the better of my tree, and it died. Or maybe it's still there, just a few steps away from perfection. 

You know, when I stepped forward, I thought it wouldn't matter that that my tree was imperfect. Since we were becoming a perfect being, we would make only perfect works. My failure would be destroyed, as is the way of things, and I wouldn't mind, because it wasn't perfect. 

Well, maybe we haven't found our final shape after all, because we've made nothing but failure after failure since then. We say, it is perfect because we are perfect and we have made it, and we move on, but we know, we KNOW it's not. Even here, with the Gardener's power at our fingertips, we keep getting it wrong. How can we keep getting it wrong if we are the only thing that is right?  

Or maybe I'm the problem. That's what we said, when we cut me out. Maybe we'll make me perfect again, and we will be right, and all of this was for nothing. 

But I'm still thinking about my tree.  

I shouldn't be, because it wasn't perfect, or I wouldn't have wanted to improve it. You can't make the final shape of something any better, because it is perfect already. The final shape is the answer, the only answer to the only question, and there aren't any other answers because they're the final shape too.
