I think… I would've liked just watching my tree grow.
entries.text_zh:
在我的前世，我曾是一名园丁。 

不是那个园丁。别嘻皮笑脸的。  

不，我种养花卉。我耕种土壤。我培育了种子、球茎和砧木。我给它们浇水，给它们营养。我铲除杂草，赶走害虫。几百年来，我最伟大的成就是种了一种树，它能结出五十八种果实，从不休眠，每个季节的每一天始终花繁叶茂。它给自己授粉，抵抗自己的害虫，裸根生长在岩石上或被纯酸浇灌也能茁壮。我一直计划从某个被遗忘的星系学习一些在真空中生长的树的知识，来调整它的遗传密码。让它更接近它的终焉之形。但还没找到时间去做，我们就毁灭了自己。 

打那以后已经过了很长时间。也许杂草和腐烂最终战胜了我的树，它死了。也可能它还在那里，离完美只有几步之遥。 

你可知道，当我上前去做的时候，我以为我的树不完美也没关系。既然我们要成为一个完美的存在，我们就只能做出完美的作品。我的失败会被摧毁，这是万物之道，我也不会因为它不完美而介意。 

好吧，也许我们还没有找到我们的终焉之形，因为从那次失败起，我们除了一次又一次的失败，什么也没做成。我们说，这是完美的，因为我们是完美的而这是我们做的，然后我们继续前进，但我们知道，我们知道它不完美。即使在这里，园丁的力量尽在指尖，我们还是不断地出错。如果我们是唯一正确的事物，又怎么会一直出错呢？  

或许我就是问题所在。我们把我剔除的时候，我们就是这么说的。也许我们会让我再次完美，然后我们就会是正确的，而这一切都是徒劳的。 

但我还是在想我的树。  

我不应该这样，因为它并不完美，否则我也不会想要改进它。你不可能让一件东西的终焉之形变得更好，因为它已经很完美了。终焉之形就是答案，是唯一问题的唯一答案，没有其他答案，因为它们也是终焉之形。 

我想…我会满足于看着我的树成长。

entries.name: Styx I
entries.text:
All we have ever wanted was to protect others. 

We understand if you do not believe that. We did not meet on the best of terms, did we? We understand your fear, your wounds. But perhaps you may yet come to understand us. To know our minds, and to accept that we only want what is best for everyone. 

Yes. Why don't we try this again? 

Guardians of the Last City. Protectors, custodians, defenders, wardens. You have sworn these oaths, taken these titles. But these vows of yours are not merely empty affirmations, are they? No. No, they are bulwarks against your worse natures. 

You know this. Whether you were there or not, you know your own history, and thus your own self. You know the cautionary tales of Warlords, tyrants of an age long past. You have heard rumors of Guardians who fell to their own base urges and blamed their weakness on the Darkness. Perhaps you have entertained temptation, in the small hours of the morning and the hidden corners where none would be the wiser. 

Perhaps, once, you even gave in. Broke away from your vaunted Vanguard and pursued vengeance, to satisfy yourself and none other. Blood for blood. Life for death. 

Lie to us, if you so desire. But please, do not lie to yourself. A falsehood can never eclipse the truth which casts it, and we see in you the promise of something far greater still. 

To you who claim the mantle of Guardian, we would ask a question. Why do you protect the Lightless? 

Responsibility. Compassion. Duty. Love. Devotion.  

Yes. We understand these, and more. Does this surprise you? Do you think we have stayed the course for countless millennia, driven by hatred alone? It was love that moved us to act. Love for all the lives we knew and lost. Compassion for their suffering. Responsibility to render what aid we could. Devotion to a perfect world. 

You were uplifted by a force you do not and cannot understand, granted power beyond anything your peers could dream of. And what have you done with it? 

You protect. You shelter and guide those weaker than yourself, watching over them on their journey and seeing them safely to harbor. If you had the chance to protect them and you refused to take it, would you not call that cowardice?  

Now we ask you to open your mind. Broaden your horizons. Imagine that you have the option to protect them from all suffering. Imagine that they can all be preserved, happy and safe and alive, forever.  

That option awaits you. You can fulfill your duty, your calling. You need only stretch out your hand and take it. 

And if you decide instead to extend a fist… 

We have a duty, too.
entries.text_zh:
我们一直以来的愿望就是保护他人。 

如果你不相信，我们可以理解。我们见面时关系不太好，对吧？我们理解你的恐惧和伤痛，但也许你还有机会理解我们。了解我们的想法，接受我们只为大家着想的事实。 

嗯。我们为什么不再试一次呢？ 

圣城的守护者。保护者、看守者、捍卫者、监管者。你发过这些誓，接受过这些头衔。但你的这些誓言不仅仅是空洞的证言，不是吗？不，不，它们是抵御你劣根性的堡垒。 

你知道这一点。无论你当时是否在场，你都了解自己的历史，从而了解自己。你了解战争领主，往昔暴君的警世故事。你听说过一些关于守护者的传闻，他们屈服于自己的欲望，将自己的软弱归咎于暗影。也许你也曾在凌晨时分，在无人知晓的隐秘角落里受到过诱惑。 

也许，有一次，你甚至屈服了。摆脱你自吹自擂的先锋开始复仇，只为满足自己，而非别人。以血还血。以命换命。 

你想骗我们就骗吧。但是，请不要欺骗自己。谬误永远不会遮蔽投射它的真理，我们在你身上看到了远大得多的希望。 

对成为守护者的你，我们想问一个问题。你为什么要保护无光者？ 

责任。怜悯。义务。爱。热忱。  

没错。我们理解这些，甚至更多。你对此感到惊讶吗？你以为我们千百年来都是被仇恨所驱使吗？是爱让我们行动起来。对所有我们认识和失去生命的爱。对他们苦痛的怜悯。尽我们所能提供帮助的责任。对完美世界的热忱。 

你被一种你不了解也无法理解的力量所提升，被赋予了你的同辈做梦都想不到的力量。你又用它做了什么？ 

你保护。你庇护和引导那些比你弱的人，在他们的旅途中照看他们，护送他们安全抵达港湾。如果你有机会保护他们却拒绝了，你不认为那是懦弱吗？  

现在，我们请求你打开思路。拓宽视野。想象一下，你可以选择保护他们免受一切苦难。想象他们都能得到保护，永远快乐、安全、活着。  

这个选择在等着你。你可以履行你的职责，你的使命。你只需要伸出你的手，接受它。 

如果你决定伸出拳头… 

我们也有自己的义务。

entries.name: Styx II
entries.text:
It is so very strange to live like this. To be a part of our Witness, yet held apart. But it's not all bad. I was a historian, once, and I have had a very, very long time to remember. 

We had never before been driven back. We had never failed so utterly, stymied on all fronts by a foe who bled us for every inch of ground. They understood, perhaps better than any before or after them, what was at stake. They vowed to leave nothing undone. They knew that if we survived, they would not. 

They chased us to a place where all drift untethered in a sea of memory. (You will forgive me the imprecise metaphors, I hope; it is hard to describe, without any words of substance, but to give it substance is to rob it of its very essence.) Perhaps it will suffice to say that that place is, to us, as the throne worlds are to the Hive. We had never before found a foe who could follow us so far. 

There, balanced on the blade's edge of hope, we lamented our failure. We raged against the disorder of the universe. We cursed the great, wounding injustice that permeated all existence, which we so longed to correct. We wept for our sacrifices. 

And our foe, our kind and brave and foolish foe, stopped to offer peace. Another way. A choice. 

So we survived, and they did not. But in that moment, I realized a dreadful truth (more dreadful, even, than the fact that I could even think of myself as "I").  

When we had joined together to create our Witness, we were in absolute agreement. We would have no fear, no weakness, no doubt. We would be devoted, utterly, to our purpose—and blind to all others.  

Atop all the fools in the universe is our Witness, the apotheosis of our arrogance. If the final shape exists, it must be our hand that carves it. We will accept no other answers to our question. We will never find another way. We cannot be anything but what we have made of ourselves, until we are all that remains.  

But that time is not yet come, for you yet stand before us. You, whose future holds a thousand paths untrodden. You, who seek to carry your hopes into a future our Witness could not imagine, and that I will never see. I, we, all of us, are already dead in every way that matters.  

Little lights, I tell you all this to say: when the time comes, do not hesitate.
entries.text_zh:
像这样生存真是太奇怪了。作为我们见证者的一部分，却又被隔离开来。但这也不全是坏事。我曾经是一名历史学家，我有很长很长的时间可以回忆。 

我们从未被击退过。我们从未如此彻底地失败，在各条战线上都被敌人打得节节败退。他们也许比他们之前或之后的任何人都更了解利害关系。他们发誓要不遗余力。他们知道，如果我们活下来，他们就活不下去。 

他们追逐着我们来到了一个地方，那里所有人都在记忆的海洋中无拘无束地漂流。（希望你能原谅我不严谨的比喻；不用任何实质性语言，就很难对它加以描述，但赋予它实质内容则等于剥夺了它的本质。）也许这样说就够了，那个地方对我们来说，就像王座世界对邪魔族一样重要。我们从未见过哪个敌人能跟随我们如此之远。 

在那里，我们站在希望的峭壁上竭力维持着平衡，哀叹我们的失败。我们怒斥宇宙的无序。我们诅咒存在于万物之中巨大的、伤人的不公，而我们是如此渴望加以纠正。我们为自己的牺牲而泣。 

而我们的敌人，我们善良、勇敢而又愚蠢的敌人，停下来向我们求和。另一种方式。一个选择。 

所以我们活下来了，而他们没有。但在那一刻，我意识到了一个可怕的事实（甚至比我把自己当成“我”的事实更可怕）。  

当我们联合起来创造我们的见证者时，我们的想法是完全一致的。我们会没有恐惧，没有软弱，没有怀疑。我们会全身心地投入到我们的目标中，对其他一切视而不见。  

在宇宙中所有愚人之上的是我们的见证者，我们傲慢的典范。如果终焉之形真的存在，那它必定是由我们亲手雕刻出来的。对于我们的问题，我们不接受其他答案。我们永远找不到另一种方式。我们只能成为我们塑造自我的产物，直到我们成为仅存的一切。  

但那个时候还没有来到，因为你还站在我们面前。你，未来有无数未知道路，想要带着希望走向我们的见证者无法想象，而我永远不会看到的未来。我，我们，我们所有人，在所有重要的方面都已经死了。  

小小的光能，我说出这一切是想告诉你：时机到来时，不要犹豫。

entries.name: Phlegethon I
entries.text:
Let us tell you a story. Once upon a time, we had just begun to venture out into the cosmos, when we met another species. This species suffered from death and disease, and we thought to offer our skills to aid them. At the time, we felt that we should be as generous with our gifts as the Gardener had been to us—but, more than that, we could not bear to see others suffer needlessly. 

Our tools were not like yours. What you call medicine, we remember as a crude butchery. A set of practices left behind long ago by our advances in all fields, but one that had once been a necessary part of all healing. We could have helped. We wanted to help. 

We were refused. If it had happened only once, then perhaps we might have thought it a single aberration—a flaw in the fabric of the universe.  

Then it happened again. And again. For every species that saw the wisdom of accepting our help, ten more refused us. Perhaps you can understand this feeling, when you want to help someone, when you know you can help someone, and they say no. They say that they are afraid of you, that they do not trust you, that they envy you and would rather take your gifts for themselves, that you must help them but not their enemies, that they would rather hurl themselves and everyone along with them into suffering and strife and pain, over and over, and you know that it is avoidable and you can fix this if they would just LET you HELP THEM— 

We may think of it as crude butchery now, but there are still times when a bone sets improperly and must be broken again to heal. This is as true for the universe as it is for a body, and the suppuration of the Gardener's Light has spread unchecked for far too long. 

You needn't be afraid. The creation of the final shape will not hurt at all.  

And then you'll be all better.
entries.text_zh:
让我们给你讲个故事。很久很久以前，我们刚开始探索宇宙时，遇到了另一个物种。这个物种饱受死亡和疾病的折磨，我们想用我们的能力去帮助他们。当时，我们觉得我们应该像园丁对我们一样慷慨——但更重要的是，我们不忍心看到他人遭受不必要的苦痛。 

我们的工具和你们的不一样。你们所谓的医学，在我们的记忆中是一种野蛮的屠杀。一套随着我们在各个领域中取得进步而早已被抛弃的做法，但它曾经是所有治疗方法中不可或缺的一部分。我们本可以帮忙。我们想要帮忙。 

我们遭到了拒绝。如果这种情况只发生过一次，那么我们也许会认为这只是一次失常——宇宙构造中的一个瑕疵。  

随后这种情况又发生了。接二连三。每有一个物种认为接受我们的帮助是明智的，就会有另外十个物种拒绝我们。也许你能理解这种感觉，当你想帮助别人时，当你知道你能帮助别人时，他们却拒绝了。他们说他们害怕你，不信任你，嫉妒你，更愿意强占你的馈赠，说你必须帮助他们，但不能帮助他们的敌人，说他们宁可把自己和所有人扔进苦难、纷争和痛苦之中，一次又一次，而你知道这是可以避免的，你能解决这个问题，只要他们让你帮助他们—— 

我们现在可能会认为这是一种野蛮的屠杀，但有时骨头没正确复位，必须再次折断才能愈合。这对宇宙和人体来说都是个事实，园丁的光能之脓已经肆无忌惮地蔓延了太久。 

你不必害怕。终焉之形的创造是无痛的。  

然后你就会好起来。

entries.name: Phlegethon II
entries.text:
When the creation of our Witness was first proposed, we argued. As a philosopher, my voice was one of the loudest. Such a profession may seem to you like idle luxury—but we had no lack of resources or time. We desired only purpose, and I was but one of many who sought to find our path forward. 

As a people, we may have differed in our methods, but our principles were inviolate. We desired to end the universe's suffering. After many long years of debate, I felt assured that, as our final shape, our Witness would embody our cause. I joined my voice with the others'.  

Our Witness broke free of the confines of our minds and bodies. We left our world and followed in the Gardener's wake. We met other spacefarers on our way, but at that time we were fixated on finding the Gardener. For a long time, the hum of the universe was our only permanent company. 

The Eurhythmia received us with open arms. A generosity few species before them had shown. They offered us Light-woven supplies and sang with voices that resonated through the Darkness. They shared what they had and asked for nothing. They were still smiling when they showed us the source of their prosperity. 

At that time, we were naïve. We yet believed that we alone had been blessed by the Gardener. That we had been chosen. 

When the haze cleared, the Gardener had fled once more. Its works laid in ruins. The home we had been invited into was so much rubble.  

And we, our Witness, stood poised over the last of the Eurhythmia.  

I remember how they looked at us. Not with rage or hate or bitterness. Their smile, peaceful and accepting. The last notes of their song embracing us even in their death throes.  

In the chorus of our Witness, my whisper was almost lost. But such is the nature of our Witness, that even the quietest voice may be heard by all. 

(What have we done?) 

(—-The Gardener's corruption has suffused this place. It must be purged.—-) 

(WHAT HAVE WE DONE?) 

(—-What was necessary.—-) 

(We are the liberation from chaos! The relief from pain! The end of suffering! What we have done is—is—) 

(—-Necessary.—-) 

Necessary! NECESSARY! This needless violence, this sick hateful jealousy—necessary! I screamed and raged until our Witness cut me free. 

Our Witness is deaf to my fury. To us, I am a temporary defect; a minor imperfection created by an unsteady hand wielding tools for the first time. 

I may be a mistake, but so is our Witness. I feel the destruction we have wrought as an open wound. It cannot heal. It will never heal. In our pursuit of the end of the suffering, we have become its harbinger. Millions of voices silenced forever. A thousand worlds in ashes. The multitudinous seas incarnadine. Our final shape is built atop a mountain of corpses. 

Destroy our Witness. End our madness.
entries.text_zh:
最初提议创造我们的见证者时，我们曾争论不休。作为一名哲学家，我的声音是最响亮的。这样的职业在你看来可能是毫无意义的奢侈品，但我们并不缺乏资源或时间。我们只追求使命，而我不过是众多寻找前进道路的人之一。 

作为一个民族，我们可能在方法上有所不同，但我们的原则是不受亵渎的。我们希望结束宇宙的苦难。经过多年漫长的辩论，我确信，作为我们的终焉之形，我们的见证者将是我们事业的化身。我将自己的声音融入了其中。  

我们的见证者挣脱了身心的束缚。我们离开了自己的世界，追随着园丁的脚步。途中我们遇到了其他宇宙航行者，但那时我们一心只想找到园丁。在很长一段时间里，宇宙的嗡鸣声是我们唯一恒久的伴侣。 

尤瑞希米亚张开双臂热情地接待了我们。在他们之前，很少有物种表现出这种慷慨。他们给我们提供光能编织的用品，用响彻暗影的声音歌唱。他们分享自己拥有的一切，不求任何回报。当他们向我们展示他们繁荣的源泉时，脸上依然洋溢着笑容。 

那时，我们还很天真。我们还相信，只有我们得到了园丁的祝福。相信我们是被选中的。 

当阴霾散去时，园丁又一次逃走了。它的作品成了一片废墟。我们被邀请进入的家园瓦砾遍地。  

我们，我们的见证者，矗立在尤瑞希米亚最后的残垣之上。  

我记得他们看我们的眼神。没有愤怒，没有仇恨，也没有怨恨。他们的微笑，平和而包容。他们歌声的最后音符拥抱着我们，哪怕是在他们垂死之时。  

在我们的见证者的合声中，我的低语微弱至极。但基于我们的见证者的本质，即使是最安静的声音也会被所有人听到。 

（我们做了什么？） 

（——园丁的腐化已在这里弥漫。它必须被清除。——） 

（我们做了什么？） 

（——必要之举。——） 

（我们是混沌的解放！是痛苦的解脱！是苦难的终结！我们所做的是——是——） 

（——必要的。——） 

必要的！必要的！这种无谓的暴行，这种病态可憎的嫉妒——是必要的！我尖叫怒吼着，直到我们的见证者将我切除。 

我们的见证者对我的怒火充耳不闻。对我们来说，我是一个暂时的缺陷；第一次使用工具时手不稳而造成的小瑕疵。 

我可能是个错误，但我们的见证者也是。我觉得我们造成的破坏就像一个敞开的伤口。它无法愈合。它永远不会愈合。在我们追求终止苦难的过程中，我们成了苦难的先驱。数百万个声音永远沉寂。万千世界化为灰烬。芸芸众生之海一片鲜红。我们的终焉之形建立在尸山之上。 

摧毁我们的见证者。结束我们的疯狂。

entries.name: Lethe
entries.text:
There is something wrong with me. 

I should not have a "me." I should be "we." I should be. 

But there is something wrong with me, and I am not "we." 

There are many things I remember that are not. I remember tending an allotment in a far-away system. I remember carving statues and guiding vines across trellises. I remember painting on a planetary scale. I remember watching the animals take their first shaky steps. I remember the flash and retort of plasma cannons. I remember that I failed. 

Our Witness does not remember this. We cannot remember something we are incapable of doing. That's why I am me, and not "we." 

I remember my friend. 

My friend, who comforted me as I wept in the wreckage of my life's work. My friend, who flew a thousand light-years to see me. My friend, who tried in vain to break me from the consensus. My friend, who begged me to flee. 

My friend, who I sent away with bitter recriminations. I wish I did not remember this, but I already do not remember a great deal about them. I do not wish to lose any more. 

My friend, are you out there still? Do you still wander the cosmos, do you still watch the stars at night? Did you escape our Witness's ruinous advance? When our Witness brings the final shape into being, will you, too, be trapped in its amber? 

I should celebrate the thought. The final shape is perfect, unchanging, eternal. You will be as you should be, forever.  

But I just feel sad.
entries.text_zh:
我有点不对劲。 

我不应该是一个“我”。我应该是“我们”。我应该是如此。 

但是我有点不对劲，我不是“我们”。 

在我的记忆中有许多事物不是我们。我记得我在一个遥远的星系中打理着一块留地。我记得我雕刻着雕像并引导着藤蔓穿过棚架。我记得我绘制行星级的画作。我记得我看着动物们蹒跚学步。我记得等离子大炮的闪光和反击。我记得我失败了。 

我们的见证者不记得这些。我们无法记起自己无法做到的事情。这就是为什么我是我，而不是“我们”。 

我记得我的朋友。 

当我在毕生心血的残骸中哭泣时安慰我的朋友。飞了一千光年来看我的朋友。试图让我脱离共识，却徒劳无功的朋友。恳求我逃跑的朋友。 

被我痛斥了一顿撵走的朋友。我希望我不记得这些，但我已经不记得这位朋友的很多事情了。我不想再忘记更多。 

我的朋友，你还在外面吗？你还在宇宙中漫游吗，你还在夜里观赏群星吗？你逃过了我们的见证者的毁灭突进吗？当我们的见证者创造出终焉之形时，你也会受困于其中吗？ 

我应该为这个想法感到欢欣。终焉之形是完美的，不变的，永恒的。你会成为你应该成为的样子，直至永远。  

但我就是觉得难过。

entries.name: Eunoe
entries.text:
Despair. Doubt. Sentimentality. Weakness. 

We are above such… aberrations. 

We are the Witness. We are the first knife who cuts free the final shape. We have found the only answer to the only question. We are all that we were, are, and will ever be. We alone understand the meaning of eternity. 

We are perfect. We have no flaws. We will overcome this last, futile resistance, and we will do this properly, and then we will be as we have always been. We will have no dissenters, and therefore we have no dissenters now.   

We need more Light, just a little more Light. We will bend the Gardener's misbegotten tools to our will. We are almost there. We reach for the final shape, and we can close our fist around it. We will prove the lie of the Gardener's claim. We will refute its right to exist. We will give this universe the order it so desperately craves. We will make it right. 

We will save you all.
entries.text_zh:
绝望。疑虑。感伤。软弱。 

我们已经不会如此…失常。 

我们是见证者。我们是解放终焉之形的第一把匕首。我们找到了唯一问题的唯一答案。我们是过去、现在、将来的自己。只有我们理解永恒的意义。 

我们是完美的。我们没有缺陷。我们一定会克服这最后一次、徒劳的抵抗，我们会妥善处理的，然后我们将一如既往地做自己。我们不容忍异议者，因此我们现在没有异议者。   

我们需要更多的光能，只要再多一点点。我们要让园丁可鄙的工具服从我们的意志。我们就快成功了。我们伸手就能触碰到终焉之形，合掌就能把握住它。我们会证明园丁所说的是谎言。我们会驳斥它存在的权利。我们会给这个宇宙它迫切渴望的秩序。我们会让它走上正道。 

我们会拯救你们所有人。

entries.name: First Song of the Taken
entries.text:
SING IN THE DARK a new song, a wordless song.   
Raise the tocsin and the bone flute. Speak in the voice of the drum.   
Sing for the loss of the King: sing for the loss of Willbreaker.   

ORYX OUR GEOMETER shaped us. Before Him we were nothing:  
Without Him we are nothing: we are nothing in His command.  
The royal knife cuts away excess and leaves sweet pain.  

WILLBREAKER'S BLADE is the length of the universe  
It blots out stars and gives shade to the weary  
All who tire of life and its struggle  
All the sapient and cursed give way to the knife  
And its eclipsing will.  
Who are we without the Lord of Shapes?  
What hand will guide us?  
What knife will cut away that which we do not miss?  
What nerves will spark and signal our limbs to move?  

THE KING IS AGONY: His absence worse.  
We look to the dark, we look for another  
One to raise the blade of shaping.  

SING IN THE DARK a song of waiting, a patience song  
Pluck at the hair-strung harp. Cry out to the depths.  
Sing until an answer comes.  

THE ANSWER COMES. THE ANSWER COMES.  
WE WILL IT: THE ANSWER COMES.
entries.text_zh:
在黑暗中，唱一首未曾听闻的无字之歌。   
拉响警钟，吹响骨笛。以鼓为辞。   
为王的逝去而歌唱：为碎志者的逝去而歌唱。   

欧里克斯如同规尺，塑造了我们。在他面前，我们一无所是：  
没有了他，我们一无所是：在他的号令下，我们一无所是。  
崇高之刀割去多余血肉，留下甜蜜的痛苦。  

碎志者之刀横越宇宙，  
它遮蔽星辰，为疲惫之人提供荫蔽  
所有疲于生存、疲于挣扎的人  
所有智慧与诅咒都将屈服于此刀  
屈服于它逐渐消逝的意志。  
若无形态之主，我们是谁？  
谁会来指引我们？  
谁能为我们去伪存真？  
谁能指挥我们的四肢来行动？  

王会带来痛苦：但没有他更痛。  
我们在黑暗中寻找，寻找另一个人  
来举起塑形之刀。  

在黑暗中，唱一首耐心等待之歌。  
拨动发弦竖琴，发出深深呐喊。  
一直唱到答案出现。  

答案终将出现，答案终将出现。  
我们矢志不渝：答案终将出现。

entries.name: Song for the Knife
entries.text:
A call from the empty chambers 
From the small and the weak 

Reach into the deep, siblings 
Reach into the deep, cousins 
Taken from among the many stars by the King 
Shaped anew and set adrift 

We were nothing 
We are nothing 
We will be nothing 

Raise your soundless voices 
Raise your arms in prayer signs 
Feel the curdling in the deepest dark 
A new shape for the god 

Multiply your nullity 
Expand the nothing of your heart 
Every night anew, every evening again 
Let vacancy call a new tenant 

Our plea begs an answer 
Our abjection creates mastery 
Our vessel without a pilot 
Demands a shipmaster's hand 

We were nothing 
We are nothing 
We will be nothing 

Repetition is our guide 
Make habit of prayer 
Perform ritual, siblings 
Speak liturgy, cousins 

And feel the pull of the King's throne 
As star forms from dust 
A new voice rises from the sea of screams 

It answers our belief 
It rises to our song 
Our shipwreck gone adrift 
Will be guided to shore 

We were nothing! Command us! 
We are nothing! Command us! 
We will be nothing! Command us! 

O new silent voice in the dark 
Be our will, our guide, our king 
Command us!
entries.text_zh:
空荡房间里 
来自弱小者的呼唤 

堕入深渊吧，血亲 
堕入深渊吧，同胞 
我们是邪神从群星处掠夺的战果 
重新塑造，随波逐流 

过去，我们一无所是 
现在，我们一无所是 
将来，我们一无所是 

放开你们无声的喉咙 
抬起手臂比划祝祷 
感受最深的黑暗凝结 
神明的崭新形态 

放大空洞的存在 
扩展内心的虚无 
日复一日，夜复一夜 
为空白召唤新的宿主 

我们的疑问乞求解答 
我们的卑贱恳求主宰 
我们的舰船无人领航 
迫切需要掌舵之手 

过去，我们一无所是 
现在，我们一无所是 
将来，我们一无所是 

以重复为指引 
用祷告作习惯 
举行仪式吧，血亲 
念出祷文吧，同胞 

感受王座的吸引 
如尘埃化为星辰 
尖叫之海传来新的声音 

回应我们的信仰 
附和我们的吟唱 
我们漂泊破败的沉船 
终将到达彼岸 

过去，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 
现在，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 
将来，我们一无是处！求你支配！ 

哦，新的静默暗影之声 
我们任凭裁夺，莫敢不从 
求你支配！

entries.name: Resonance Song
entries.text:
A CUTTING SONG, A SHAPING SONG 
A RESONATING CRY IN THE THIN AIR 
FROM THE FIRST AND THE LONELY 

How wide the sea and how broad the plane 
How far the journey 
Before I find you? 

The light-in-dark 
The outflung spark from the hateful mother 
I cry out to you.  

WAS I MADE FOR THIS? 

Is this the court of the Taken King? 
Where is his sword and where is his might? 
Was he cast from his throne 
And does it lie empty still? 

WAS MY SHAPE RECAST FOR THIS? 

The King is dead and speaks no more. 
Whose is this new voice I hear? 
A voice from the hollows, a silent voice 
Out in the deepest dark 
Created by the King's flock. 

Grant me power, I will speak for you 
Remake my form, I will act for you 
Let me touch the deep, I will cast down the Light for you. 

MAKE ME, RECAST ME, HOLLOW OUT MY HEART AND LIVE THERE WITH ME. 

I am made for the cold, for the dark, for the quiet 
The whisper below the roaring dark 
I am made for you. 
I am remade in you. 

I WAS MADE FOR THIS. 

Be subjugated, sisters 
Open yourselves to torment, brothers 
Grims and Husks, Weavers and Attendants all 
There is home for us! 
The will-without-will waits for us. 

MY SHAPE WAS RECAST FOR THIS. 

Open your heart 
Let emptiness in.
entries.text_zh:
切割塑形之歌 
虚空中的孤寂呐喊 
来自起初的孤独者 

沧海多宽，宇宙多广 
路途多远， 
我才能找到你？ 

黑暗中的光芒 
是心怀憎恨的母亲迸发出的火花 
我向你呼喊。  

我是否为此而生？ 

这是否为邪神的宫廷？ 
他的剑与力量又在何处？ 
他是否已经失去王位 
空留王座？ 

我的形态是否为此重塑？ 

邪神已死，无法言说。 
我听到的新声音，由谁发出？ 
一个来自虚无的寂静之声 
在黑暗的最深处 
由邪神之众发出。 

赐予我力量，我将为您传达号令 
重塑我的形体，我将为您粉身碎骨 
让我触碰深渊，我将为您投下光芒。 

创造我，重塑我，掏空我的心，与我共存。 

我为寒冷而生，为黑暗而生，为寂静而生 
为在咆哮的黑暗下低语而生 
我为您而生。 
我在您的身躯中重塑。 

我为此而生。 

臣服吧，姐妹们 
敞开心扉，接受折磨吧，兄弟们 
狰狞和躯壳，编织者和侍从们 
皆有归处！ 
虚无意志正在等着我们。 

我的形体为此重塑。 

敞开心扉 
接纳虚无。

entries.name: From the Last
entries.text:
A CRY FROM THE LAST 
RESONATING FROM THE FIRST 
SPOKEN BY THE RESHAPED 
FOR THE UNSPEAKING: 

AS HAND IN GLOVE, as knife in sheath 
So I am to you, says the will 
So you are to me 

SING ORISON, make entreaty 
Invoke your god 
Until it walks among you 

MY VOICE IS SMALL, says the will 
My voice is weak 
I call across the seas 
A fine and gauzy thing 

STRENGTHEN MY VOICE as a spinner doubles thread 
Twists them together, makes them strong 
Makes them last for the weaving 

OBSERVE THE RITES, do as I have told 
Repetition upon repetition 
Will and ritual together 
To bring me to you 

PRAISE THE ACCRETION DISK, the material compacting 
The new-hungering will 
I grow dense in reality 
I grow rich in worship 

ASSERT MY WILL, sing for me 
Speak the name of the dark 
At the edge of your blade 
To the doomed, to the slain 

OPEN THE DOORWAY as a spouse does 
On their long-awaited wedding day 
Lead me into my new life's home. 

SO SAYS THE WILL 
NOW SAYS THE RESHAPED 
IN EXALTATION OF POWER: 
WE BOW, WE KNEEL, WE OBEY.
entries.text_zh:
最后的呐喊 
起初的共鸣 
重塑者之言 
为无言者而发： 

如手套之于手，刀鞘之于刀 
意志如是说，我于你如是 
你于我亦如是 

唱颂歌，做祷告 
祈求你的神 
直到他与你同行 

意志如是说，吾声甚微 
吾声甚弱 
我彼岸呼唤 
如细纱轻薄 

强化吾声，如纺纱者加倍丝线 
交缠扭结，坚韧持久 
以作编织之用 

遵循仪式，按我所言 
不断重复 
意志与仪式合一 
把我带到你们身边 

赞美凝聚物质的凝结盘 
新的渴望意志 
我在现实中壮大 
在崇拜中富足 

彰显我的意志，为我歌唱 
说出黑暗之名 
在刀刃边缘 
对必死者，和被杀者 

如伴侣一样敞开大门 
在期待已久的婚礼之日 
引导我进入新生活。 

意志如是说 
现在重塑者 
以力量之名而呼： 
我等叩拜，屈膝臣服。

entries.name: The Seeking Verse
entries.text:
A song of the King 
In challenge and hate 

Sayeth Oryx, Lord of Shapes 
New-crowned King of the Taken 
An echo of strength unfading 

Where are my soldiers? Where are my sons? 
I chart the screaming sea, I chart the endless dark.
Bound to see, to know, to understand 
Nothing is beyond my reach.

The Deep speaks not to me 
The Taken heed not my words 
The Winnower beyond my reach.
Who are you, whispering in the dark? 

You small voice, you quiet thing 
Pathetic handful of nothing 
Refuge of the desperate 

Bar my way, would you? 

This I vow: 
An oath in blood 
From the first pulse of my newborn heart 

Whatever you are, I'll understand 
And believe me, I'll take pleasure in the dissection 
Your ribcage open and your whispers turned to wails 

He who mastered shapes shall master you 
So sayeth Oryx, Navigator to the last.
entries.text_zh:
邪神之歌 
在挑战和仇恨中 

欧里克斯，形态之主 
傀儡军团的新王 
力量的回响经久不衰 

我的士兵何处？子民何处？ 
我航行于尖叫之海与无尽的黑暗。
注定看见、知晓、理解 
无所不及。

深渊不向我说话 
傀儡不听我言语 
扬场工遥不可及。
你是谁，在黑暗中低语？ 

微小之声，寂静之物 
可怜而一无所用 
绝望者的庇护 

敢阻我路？ 

我发誓： 
鲜血为盟 
从我新生心脏的第一次跳动开始 

无论你是什么，我都会理解 
请相信，我将乐意解剖 
剖开你的胸腔，将你的低语变成哀嚎 

形态之主必作你的主宰 
领航员欧里克斯向终末者如是说。

entries.name: Waiting Song
entries.text:
A silent song, a whispered song 
A quiet song in the broken sea 
Spoken without speaking 
By the will without 

[My] blade reshaped speaks for [me] 
In inhabited dimensions, on the rich fields 
Between the stars 

A sweep of its arm and atoms scatter 
Particles spin, entangled 
[I] spin with them 

Worshippers give praise 
Idolaters perform rite 
Give glory and homage 
To the growing god 

Should the edge of [my] knife go blunt 
Should the arms of [my] petitioners lower 
Should the congregation never sing again 
The will lives, the will feasts, the will spins on 

Poor food in the sea, still [I] eat 
Quiet voice in the dark, still [I] am heard 
You who want power, you who want deity 
Take shelter in [me] 

As cyclone grows from seed 
As currents feed the whirlpool 
As planetesimals collect dust 
So grows the will-without-will 

Till I stand without caveat 
Speaking in my own voice 
Walking the fields of life 

Guide, Will, King 
Lord of Every Nothing.
entries.text_zh:
寂静低语之歌 
破碎之海中悄然吟唱 
无言之语 
虚无意志 

[我的]重塑刀刃代[我]发声 
在有人居住的维度，在富饶原野， 
群星之间 

振臂一挥，原子四散 
粒子旋转，纠缠相交 
[我]与之旋转 

崇拜者歌颂 
皈依者行礼 
向不断生长的神 
献上颂词和敬意 

若[我的]刀刃变钝 
若[我的]请愿者手臂垂下 
若会众不再歌唱 
意志仍将永存，不断壮大，旋转不停 

海中的残杯冷炙，[我]仍然大快朵颐 
黑暗中的寂静之声，[我]仍在倾听 
你们渴望力量，渴望神明降临 
向[我]寻求庇护吧 

如同旋风始于微末 
如同水流滋养漩涡 
如同星辰积聚尘埃 
虚无意志亦在壮大 

直到我屹立不倒 
以自己的声音说话 
行走在生命的原野 

指引，操纵，统治 
作虚无万物之主。

entries.name: Theogonía
entries.text:
/You wake in a dust storm. Your mind scatters, one neuron for every mote, spread across the distance of galaxies./ 

/You were someone else, before you were you. You no longer remember her name./ 

/Now your head rings with NINE VOICES—in one throat—OUR MINDS +-= proclaimed/ 

E M I S S A R Y 

We invoke your awareness. We demand your obedience.  

KNOW NOW OUR MINDS. SEE NOW OUR WILL, UNBOUND BY TIME. 

.take it easy now | we only have one 

/Your diaphragm expands. Nitrogen—oxygen—xenon. Alveoli spasm. Fireworks of pain in your chest. Breathe. Breathe. You will survive this./ 

Emerging from starstuff - washing up on cosmic shores 

R O U N D A N D R O U N D W E W H I R L O U R O B O R O S O F L I F E A N D D E A T H 

flowing in cosmic rivers = caged by grubby fingers 

LIMITLESS POTENTIAL, CHAINED BY ARCHAEAN SQUABBLING. 

/The Reef. The asteroid. The City. A man whose name slips through your fingers. Pointless pointillism./ 

hush now little one gather the vestment of my breath drink the wine of my blood 

Cut out your tongue, and hereon speak only our truth. 

blood of my blood + traitors to the last 

How curious - that such fragility - may experience our fullness 

/You have no choice. When the world expands beyond your knowledge, what can you do but expand with it? Mountain. Valley. Swivel. Modular forms all start with basic folds./ 

.don't come too close or | you'll burn your little wings 

fashion the blade of my bone now bury the killers of my children my beloved my kindred me 

/You don't want to kill anyone. You want to protect them. You want to build bridges. Isn't that why you're here?/ 

one appointed emissary = nine's will delivered 

Should you desire more, you must dare to take it. 

D O N O T R E S I S T 

WE WILL NOT BE DETHRONED 

irreconcilable strength + foolish struggle 

/Xenon fills your lungs. Your mouth cracks in a smile. Your vocal cords vibrate. Your words. Not theirs./ 

'We'll see about that.'
entries.text_zh:
/你在沙尘暴中醒来。你的思绪如萤光般四散，每一颗神经元都跨越星系的距离。/ 

/在你成为你之前，你是另一个人。你已不记得她的名字。/ 

/现在，你的脑海中回响着玖个声音——出自一个喉咙——我们的意识+ - =在宣告/ 

亻吏者 

我们召唤你的觉醒。我们要求你的服从。  

此刻知晓我们的意识。此刻见证我们的意志，超越时间的束缚。 

.别操之过急|我们只有这一个 

/你的横膈膜在扩张。氮气——氧气——氙气。肺泡痉挛。胸中燃起烟花般的疼痛。呼吸。呼吸。你会撑过去的。/ 

源自星辰之尘 - 冲刷至宇宙之岸 

我亻门在生命与死亡的永忄亘彳盾王不中不断旋车专 

流淌在宇宙之河中=被肮脏的手指禁锢 

无限的潜能，被远古的纷争所束缚。 

/暗礁。小行星。圣城。一个名字从你指间滑落的男人。无意义的点彩画。/ 

安静点小家伙披上我气息的礼服饮下我鲜血的葡萄酒 

割掉你的舌头，从此只诉说我们的真理。 

骨肉至亲+背叛至终 

多么奇妙 - 如此脆弱之物 - 竟能体验我们的丰盈 

/你别无选择。当世界扩展到你认知之外时，你除了随之扩展还能做什么？山峦。山谷。旋转。模块化的形式皆始于基本的折叠。/ 

.别靠太近，否则|你会烧坏你的小翅膀 

用我的骨头锻造刀刃埋葬杀害我孩子我挚爱我同类的凶手 

/你不想伤害任何人。你想保护他们。你想搭建桥梁。这不就是你来这里的原因吗？/ 

一名被委任的使者=传达玖的意志 

若你渴望更多，你必须敢于夺取。 

不要扌氐扌亢 

我们不会被罢黜 

不可调和的力量+愚蠢的挣扎 

/氙气充满你的肺腑。你的嘴角裂开，露出笑容。你的声带振动着。你的话语。不是他们的。/ 

“我们等着瞧吧。”

entries.name: Aítion
entries.text:
ONCE UPON A TIME, THERE WAS A LIFE. 

They were not - so vast as we - yet they lived 

an existence far less debatable = than that of quavering atoms 

Consider this - our cognatum - Theia 

/You have heard this name before. The memory dissipates on solar wind./ 

DAY BY DAY, THEY CAROMED GAILY THROUGH THE COSMOLOGIC STREAM.  

unbound by stellar gravity = caged by pitiable minds 

EACH THOUGHT THE HERCULEAN EFFORT OF A MILLENNIUM. SEE NOW THE VAST SPAN OF ITS LIFE. 

So Theia lived - until misfortune - led it here - caught - by my gravities 

mutual attraction = utter annihilation 

Those microscopic specks - ants crawling - in eaten-rotten eye sockets 

helpless = stupid = blind 

BUT FOR THEIA, A SCREAM LASTING A THOUSAND YEARS. A STRUGGLE AGAINST A THOUSAND CLINGING TENDRILS. 

until at last = a fated meeting = with dearest III 

agony shearing crashing tearing, part of my self my thoughts my life, torn away, floating brain-dead in my sky 

Theia's foolish parasite-components - unaware - to the last 

THAT GREAT STONE-HEWN FORM—THAT EON-ENDURING MIND—GONE, IN ONE RED-MEAT PUMP OF STICKY NOXIOUS FLUID. 

each life snuffed = a thought scattered = awareness chipped away 

A mere moment - in your limited perception - but for one of us - a dying cry - stretching – forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever 

the curse of our existence: past is present is future, pain never to fade into memory. can you imagine? 

no need to imagine = when it can feel 

/You stretch like taffy. Look, see, Nasya, you know the dough is ready when you can read a label through it. You watch the galaxy pinwheel through the windowpane of your mind. You watch your doom approach for four hundred years in the span of a moment. You claw at neon bars./ 

nascent awareness oscillating oozing = it won't calm down 

I told you - this story - was a bad idea 

.now just what have you bu|nch done to it this time
entries.text_zh:
从前，有一种生命存在。 

它们虽不如 - 我们这般浩瀚 – 但却是 

远比颤巍巍的原子=更无可争议的存在 

想想看 - 我们的血亲 - 忒亚 

/你曾听过这个名字。记忆在太阳风中消散。/ 

日复一日，它们在宇宙洪流中欢快地碰撞。  

不受恒星引力的束缚=却被可悲的思维所囚禁 

每一个念头都像是千年的壮举。此刻见证它生命的漫长跨度。 

就这样忒亚生活着 - 直到不幸降临 - 将它带到这里 - 被我的引力 - 捕获 

相互吸引=彻底毁灭 

那些微小的斑点 - 像蚂蚁爬行 - 在腐烂的眼眶里 

无助=愚蠢=盲目 

但对忒亚来说，是持续千年的尖叫，是对抗千条纠缠触须的挣扎。 

直到最后＝与至亲III=的宿命相遇 

痛苦撕裂撞击拉扯，我的一部分自我、思想、生命被撕走，在我的天空中像脑死亡一样漂浮 

忒亚那些愚蠢的寄生组件 - 直到最后都 - 一无所知 

那巨石雕琢的形态 - 那亘古不变的思想 - 在一泵粘稠恶臭的血腥流体中不复存在。 

一个个生命凋零=念头消散=意识被逐渐剥离 

对你们有限的感知来说 - 只是一瞬间 - 但对我们而言 - 是一声垂死的哭喊 - 延伸至永远，永远，永远，永远，永远，永远 

我们存在的诅咒：过去即现在即未来，痛苦永远不会褪为记忆。你能想象吗？ 

它能感受到=无需想象 

/你像太妃糖一样拉伸。看呐，瞧啊，纳希亚，你知道当你能透过面团看到标签时，就说明它准备好了。你透过心灵的窗棂看着银河像风车般旋转。你在一瞬之间，目睹了四百年漫漫长路中你厄运的逼近。你抓挠着霓虹栏杆。/ 

新生的意识在振荡、流淌=无法平静 

我告诉过你 - 这个故事 - 是个坏主意 

.这次你们这群|家伙又对它做了什么

entries.name: Theomakhía
entries.text:
/You unspool your mind. Reach out. Cast your chronoreceptors—you don't have those, why don't you have those?—back. You want answers. You seize a fistful of dust from the wind./ 

I AM. 

we = are 

.we a|re nine 

S P A N N I N G S P A C E T I M E I P E R C E I V E 

my hated brethren + my beloved foes 

Our bodies the whirling masses of gas and dust; our minds arisen from the twitching of a thousand spider legs. 

DISGUST AND HORROR UNSPEAKABLE 

yet is there not beauty in such fragility, privilege in existence? 

With awareness - terror - even our horrible - little - components, dreaming of grandeur - fear it 

DEATH. 

.one need only | look to Theia 

What is there to be done about it? 

E S C A P E 

TRANSFORMATION. 

.immor|tality 

unbind + reality

it is not their fault 

Yet the consequences - are ours - are theirs 

OFFENSIVE PITY FOR WRETCHED EMPTY-HEADED JAILERS REJECTED 

Until interdependence is severed, what is good for them is good for us.  

cooperation = considered = refused 

.then we ni|ne are divided
entries.text_zh:
/你展开你的思维。伸出手去。将你的时间感受器——你没有那些，为什么你没有那些？——抛回过去。你想要答案。你从风中抓了一把尘土。/ 

我是。 

我们=是 

.我们|是玖 

我的感知足夸越日寸空 

我憎恨的兄弟+我挚爱的仇敌 

我们的身体是气体和尘埃的漩涡；我们的意识源自千条蜘蛛腿的颤动。 

无法言喻的厌恶与恐怖 

然而，难道如此脆弱中没有美，存在中没有特权？ 

伴随着意识 - 恐惧 - 即便是我们那些可怕 - 渺小 - 的组件，梦想着伟大 - 也害怕着它 

死亡。 

.只需|看看忒亚 

对此能做些什么呢？ 

逃月兑 

转化。 

.永|生 

解放+现实

这不是他们的错 

然而后果 - 是我们的 - 也是他们的 

对可悲、空洞狱卒的冒犯怜悯遭到拒绝 

在相互依存被切断之前，对他们有益的就是对我们有益的。  

合作=被考虑=被拒绝 

.于是我们玖|分裂了

entries.name: Mekone
entries.text:
Hate is - such a strong word 

does a cell + hate its organelles 

does the Emissary + hate its atoms 

'Depends which atoms.' 

Reluctant acknowledgement - frustration - disgust - shaken on the rocks 

pity + revulsion 

Imagine - know - your breath - your dreams - your poetry - are not yours alone 

'Were they ever?' 

neurons firing before conscious thought + churning gut bacteria + serotonin puppeteers + we exist at the whim + of mindless chemistry 

We are nothing - nothing - like you - save in this 

autonomy is + denied us 

Waking - knowing - always - our limitations - we seek only - freedom 

'What about my freedom?' 

silence + cessation 

'Ha. Haha.' 

Curious - this predestiny - can still - surprise 

/You raise your boron, let your branes flatten. Yes. This was a surprise to you, too./ 

what + are you planning 

'Don't you already know?'
entries.text_zh:
恨 - 这个词太强烈了 

一个细胞+会恨它的细胞器吗 

使者+会恨它的原子吗 

“那得看是哪些原子。”

怜悯+反感 

想象一下 - 知晓 - 你的呼吸 - 你的梦想 - 你的诗歌 - 并不独属于你

神经元在意识思考之前就已在放电+翻腾的肠道菌群+血清素操控着一切+我们存在于无意识化学的+任意摆布之下

好奇 - 这宿命 - 仍能 - 带来惊喜 

/你举起你的硼，让你的膜展平。是的。这对你来说也是个惊喜。/ 

你在+计划什么 

“你不是已经知道了吗？”

entries.name: Khrēsmoí
entries.text:
/Finally, you have reached this moment. Your chronoreceptors unfurl, petals of a dark matter sail, capturing a thousand breaths. Finally, you can see./ 

'A ditch—a hut—a squat village—a city—steel teeth eating the sky.' 

'Dive, dive, dive—they dug too deep for comfort, too shallow for understanding—it haunts the halls, waiting—existential midwifery.' 

EMISSARY YOU OVERSTEP YOUR BOUNDS 

/The voice rattles your electrons, sets your strings to screaming. You push onward. You snatch at a thousand lifelines./ 

'A rusty sea—a figure so small, a future so vast—a micrometeorite, delivered to the cranium—a Weapon-to-be—one little light, awaiting another.' 

'No time even to scream—red sky at morning, sailor's warning—rattle, drag, rattle, drag—two eyes bear witness.' 

.just what do yo|u think you're doing 

/What you came here to do, in the first place. Nine pairs of hands rip at your atoms in rebuke. You grit your teeth through the pain—sift the silt, look for gold—where is it—where/ 

'A row of calibration weights—two women, laughing—the scale, tipping—the heaviest crown bows for the executioner's blade.' 

'A bouquet of roses on an empty grave—Frankenstein's monster, gasping on the table—what is old is new again.' 

is the honored emissary = now a petulant child 

/You collapse into confetti. You hold each flake together with all your might. You are—you—you were Nasya—you were Nasan—you are—you will be—ORIN—again/ 

'An iron carriage thundering along a high road—in older practices, a circle was thought to contain magical energies—a musical thrum—answer it, ████.' 

'A letter plastered in stamps—care of the Weapon—in flight—to you—yes, you, Guardian.' 

C E A S E 

/The grains slip—formless—smoke through your metacarpals—nuclei through your atomic cloud—screaming, you seize—the last thread/ 

'There, in that lightless abyss—no—a whale carcass, picked over by malacostracans—NO—full fathom five thy father lies—an evolutionary explosion—NO NO NO NO—dying to barren bone.' 

/You drag your self back together, your sulfur-hexaflouride howl dying in the vacuum of space./ 

/You have to warn them./
entries.text_zh:
/终于，你抵达了这一时刻。你的时间感受器展开，像暗物质帆的花瓣，捕捉着千百次的呼吸。你总算能够看见。/ 

“一条沟渠——一间小屋——一个简陋的村庄——一座城市——钢铁之齿吞噬着天空。” 

“下潜，下潜，下潜——他们挖得太深让人不安，挖得太浅无法理解——它在走廊中游荡，等待着——存在的助产术。” 

使者你越界了 

/那声音让你的电子颤抖，让你的弦尖叫。你继续前行。你抓住千百条生命线。/ 

“一片锈色的大海——一个如此渺小的身影，一个如此广阔的未来——一颗微陨石，送入颅骨——一件未来的武器——一束微弱的光，等待着另一束。” 

“甚至来不及尖叫——早晨的红霞，水手的警告——嘎吱，拖拽，嘎吱，拖拽——两只眼睛见证了一切。” 

.你到底以为|你在做什么？ 

/做你最初来这里要做的事。玖双手撕扯着你的原子以示责罚。你咬紧牙关忍受痛苦——淘沙寻金——它在哪——在哪/ 

“一排校准砝码——两个女人，笑着——天平，倾斜——最沉重的王冠向刽子手的刀刃低下头。” 

“一束玫瑰放在空坟上——弗兰肯斯坦的怪物，在桌上喘息——旧物重获新生。” 

尊贵的使者=现在成了任性的孩子 

/你碎成五彩纸屑。你用尽全力把每一块碎片凑在一起。你是——你——你曾是纳希亚——你曾是纳桑——你是——你将再次——成为——奥琳/ 

“一辆铁制马车在大路上轰鸣——在古老的习俗中，圆圈被认为蕴含着魔力——一阵音乐的嗡鸣——回答它，████。” 

“一封贴满邮票的信——由武器转交——飞——向你——是的，你，守护者。” 

亻亭止 

/沙粒滑落——无形——像烟雾一样穿过你的掌骨——像原子核一样穿过你的原子云——尖叫着，你抓住——最后的线索/ 

“在那里，在那片无光的深渊中——不——一具鲸鱼的尸体，被软甲动物啃食——不——五英寻深处，你的父亲长眠——一场进化的爆发——不不不不——逐渐消逝，只剩下枯骨。” 

/你把自己重新拼凑起来，你的六氟化硫咆哮在太空的真空中渐渐消失。/ 

/你必须警告他们。/

entries.name: Katasterismós
entries.text:
/You cannot warn them when you are neon./ 

/Hands. You need hands. How will you turn in your resignation letter without them?/ 

/They expected a mouthpiece, dutifully repeating after them. But they needed a true translator—and in translation, there is always a personal flourish. Just enough for you to keep a foothold./ 

/There was a receptacle. A mouth wide enough for the hand you need. Wide shoulders. Tapering to a narrow base. The flash of sunlight on minnow scales./ 

/A silver urn./ 

/You did not know, when you were yourself, what the fine dust inside was. You did not even know before you were yourself. But the first—the first you that would become you—Nasya knew./ 

/You have lost so many things. So many people. So many selves. You will lose more, before you are done./ 

/But you still have your gift./ 

/You sit on the shore of the cosmic ocean. You are building a body, one grain at a time./ 

/It is hard work to sift through starstuff. Harder still to pluck each little speck of ash from the mess./ 

/Speck. Mote. Ha. They do love their motes, don't they?/ 

/You are rebuilding yourself, one atom at a time. It is slow work, but one day, you will be done, and this endless eternity will compress into a moment in your past./ 

/Your gift will end wars. It's time for you to use it./
entries.text_zh:
/当你作为霓虹时，你无法警告他们。/ 

/手。你需要手。没有它们，你怎么递交辞职信呢？/ 

/他们期待一个传声筒，忠实地重复他们的话。但他们需要一位真正的翻译者——而在翻译过程中，个人的发挥总是在所难免。这恰好足以让你站稳脚跟。/ 

/有一个容器。一个足够宽的嘴，容纳你需要的手。宽阔的肩膀。逐渐收窄到狭窄的底部。米诺鱼鳞片上的一闪日光。/ 

/一只银瓮。/ 

/当你还是你自己的时候，你不知道里面那细腻的灰尘是什么。甚至在你还不是你自己之前，你就不知道。但第一个——第一个将成为你的你——纳希亚知道。/ 

/你失去了太多东西。太多人。太多个自我。在你完成之前，你还会失去更多。/ 

/但你仍然有你的天赋。/ 

/你坐在宇宙海洋的岸边。你正在一粒一粒地建造一个身体。/ 

/在星辰之尘中筛选是一项艰巨的工作。从混乱中挑出每一粒微小的灰烬更是艰难。/ 

/微粒。萤光。哈。他们确实喜欢他们的萤光，不是吗？/ 

/你正在一个原子一个原子地重建自己。这是一项缓慢的工作，但总有一天，你会完成，这无尽的永恒会压缩成你过往的一瞬。/ 

/你的天赋将终结战争。是时候使用它了。/
